title: Backend Engineer II - Data Platform
description:
Every dataset at Spotify, from the data behind creator royalties to the signals powering recommendations, is registered, published and traced through systems our team builds. We're the source of truth for what data exists at Spotify, where it lives, who owns it, and how it flows from one pipeline to the next.
   

  

 These systems sit on the critical path of the platform. Data teams use them every day to publish and find data, and other platform teams build on them for access, retention, governance and incident response. That means our work is judged on correctness and reliability, because every system built on top of ours is only as good as the metadata we provide.
   

  

 This is a backend role focused on data management, working on the problems at the core of any large data platform: running a data catalog that stays accurate at scale, capturing lineage across batch and streaming workloads, managing schemas as they evolve, and guaranteeing that consumers only read complete data. We build on open standards like OpenLineage and Apache Iceberg, and define the internal standards for naming, storage and metadata that the rest of Spotify builds against. As the platform takes on new storage technologies and new kinds of data assets, those standards and the systems behind them have to evolve with it, and you'll help decide how.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Build and Evolve Core Services: Design, build and operate the backend services and APIs behind our data catalog, lineage and publishing systems, and evolve them as the platform adopts new storage technologies and new kinds of data. Hold them to a high bar for correctness, performance and reliability.
* Build Data Pipelines: Develop and run the batch and streaming pipelines that keep our metadata current, processing platform events and audit logs to capture how data is created and changed, and turning lineage and metadata into data products other teams build on.
* Own Projects End to End: Turn what the teams using our platform need into technical designs, drive them through delivery and rollout, and own the results once they're in production.
* Keep the Platform Healthy: Take part in on-call for critical services, build in observability and quality checks by default, and use automation, including AI tooling, to reduce toil for the team and our users.


 Who You Are
   

  

* You have solid experience building and running backend services and APIs in production with Java, and you care about API design, versioning and backward compatibility.
* You're comfortable with SQL and have worked with data pipelines or a cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery, Snowflake or Databricks. Hands-on experience with batch or streaming frameworks like Beam, Flink or Spark is a plus.
* You have a working understanding of data engineering concepts such as orchestration, metadata management, data quality, governance and lineage.
* You break problems down into clear, shippable steps, reasoning through tradeoffs and risks and converging on clear recommendations.
* You own the quality of what you ship, including code written with AI assistance, and you care about operating it well after launch.
* You are a strong communicator and collaborator who enjoys working across teams, and you're comfortable in a dynamic platform environment where many engineers depend on what you build and priorities evolve with the business.


 Where You'll Be
   

  

* This role is based in Stockholm or London.
* We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.


 Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
   

  

 At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Find our AI notice here: https://lifeatspotify.com/ai-notice

title: Software Engineer

 As Europe's leading digital healthcare provider and one of the largest healthcare providers in Sweden, we believe that providing accessible and affordable healthcare has never been more important. title: Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack)
description:
**Who We Are**
 4C Strategies builds readiness and resilience software for defence, public safety and critical infrastructure organisations in more than 70 countries. Our Exonaut® platform is used to plan, run and evaluate large-scale training, exercises and capability evaluations, and our consultants and engineers work alongside those organisations across Europe, North America and beyond.
   

  

**What We're Building**
 We're building the evidence layer for defence experimentation and evaluation. When an organisation tests a new capability — a sensor, an autonomous system, a different way of operating — it has to be able to defend the result afterwards, to someone who was not there and who has every reason to challenge it. Today that evidence lives in spreadsheets, documents and standalone survey tools, and it cannot be traced from a conclusion back to the observation that supports it.
   

  

 Our platform fixes the structure before the data is collected, captures evidence from people and from machines, fuses it into chains that carry their own provenance, and keeps every finding traceable to its source. The hard part is not the plumbing. It is holding one coherent model steady while every customer arrives with their own vocabulary, their own method and a reasonable-sounding request for one more special case.
   

  

**How We Build**
 Modern Java — currently 25 — and Spring Boot on a modular JPMS architecture, an Angular 21 single-page application, PostgreSQL with PostGIS, deployed to Kubernetes.
   

  

 The principles are conservative on purpose. Dependency inversion at every module boundary: contracts in an API module, implementation separate, no reverse dependencies. Schema evolution is explicit and reversible, through migrations with rollback scripts and no auto-DDL in any environment. Evolutionary change over rewrites, with a staged path when a domain concern outgrows its boundary. Structural decisions are argued in RFCs and recorded in ADRs, and changes to the core domain model go through that process rather than around it — because that model is the product, and it is the thing most easily damaged under delivery pressure.
   

  

 Three constraints shape most of what we do. It runs inside the customer's own environment: single-tenant, sovereign, accredited, sometimes with no route to the internet at all, so nothing may assume a managed cloud service. Evidence has to be captured where the work happens, which means a tablet in a field with no connectivity and a sync that loses nothing. And the audit trail is immutable — evidence cannot be quietly deleted or backdated, and no automated process publishes a conclusion without a person taking responsibility for it.
   

  

**You**
 We are a small team, so you will work across the stack rather than behind a specialism. Substantial experience in either Java or TypeScript, and a genuine willingness to be useful in the other. Sound judgement about data modelling, because most of the interesting problems here are modelling problems wearing engineering clothes. Comfortable with ambiguity: requirements move, and the shape of the answer is often the work.
   

  

 A real advantage, though none of it is required: sovereign, air-gapped or accredited deployments; offline-first or sync-heavy applications; geospatial data; sensor, telemetry or simulation integration; audit and traceability requirements. The domain is learnable, the judgement less so.
   

  

 The team is small enough that your work is visible and your arguments carry. Your designs will be challenged and you will be expected to challenge back — including on scope.
   

  

 Research shows some people only apply when they meet every requirement. If you don't tick every box but recognise yourself in much of the above, please apply anyway. We'd genuinely like to hear from you.
   

  

**Security and citizenship**
 This role supports defence work, so the successful candidate must hold Swedish citizenship and pass Swedish security vetting (säkerhetsprövning). We will explain what the check involves early in the process rather than late — a requirement like this should never be a surprise at offer stage.
   

  

 This requirement comes only from the security rules that govern defence work, not from personal preference.
   

  

**Why it matters**
 Capability decisions get made on this evidence. When an organisation concludes that something is ready, or that it is not, that judgement has consequences for the people who depend on it. Making it defensible is the whole point.
   

  

**How We Hire**
 Every interview has a written script and a scored rubric, applied the same way to every candidate.
   

  

* Hiring Manager Screen — a conversation about your experience, how you work and what


 you want next.
   

  

* System Design — a design discussion drawn from problems like the ones above.
* Programming — a hands-on session in a language of your choice (Java, C#, TypeScript,


 Python or Go).
   

  

* Culture Interview — how you collaborate, disagree and make decisions with others.
* Candidate Q&A — your time to interrogate us. We expect you to use it.


 We then debrief as a panel and decide. We review applications on a rolling basis.
   

  

**What You Can Expect From 4C Strategies**
* Stockholm-based, with hybrid working.
* Competitive salary, reviewed annually.
* Occupational pension (tjänstepension).
* Wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag).
* Healthcare insurance, including insurance for treatment.
* Parental pay.
* Vaccinations.
* A supportive, collaborative team building meaningful products for mission-critical work.


**Why join 4C Strategies**
 This is a small team with a large surface. You will not be handed a narrow lane: the platform is still being shaped, the domain model is still being argued about, and the person who makes the argument well is the person who decides. If you would rather own a hard, open problem end to end than take tickets from a backlog, that is the job.
   

  

 The work matters: what you build helps defence, public safety and resilience organisations prepare for the situations they hope not to face.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 To apply, click the Apply today button and submit your CV. A short cover note on your experience and motivation is welcome but not required. We review applications on a rolling basis, so please apply as soon as you can.
   

  

 4C Strategies is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Senior Fullstack AI Developer (Python/React)
description:
**A Different Kind Of Job Description**
 At Filed, we believe in radical transparency. Everything is open: company finances, team salaries, stock options, anonymous team feedback. That extends to how we talk about this job, so what you'll read here looks a little different from other job ads. It starts with why this is a terrible job. Then it explains why it might be the best career move you'll ever make.
   

  

**Why this is a terrible job**
 This is an incredibly high-paced, high-tempo environment. We're making a generational bet to change all of our lives, and generational bets are not comfortable.
   

  

 You will build agents for subjective workflows. Tax law is objective, but what applies under it and how professionals interpret it is full of judgment. You can give two tax professionals the same task and get two different results where both are right. We're building agentic systems that have to reach their level of accuracy, not a level we decided is good enough. From an engineering standpoint, this is the hardest thing most of us have ever built. At times it will feel like hitting your head against the wall.
   

  

 Customers will sometimes get frustrated, because they expect deterministic results from probabilistic systems, and we're managing the expectations of some of the biggest firms in the world, including the Big Four.
   

  

 And the rhythm is real: we get to the office, we work, we go home and spend time with our families, and then many of us get back online to support our customers in US hours. It's tough. It's relentless.
   

  

**Why it might be the best career choice you'll ever make**
 It's addictive to be part of a business when you know you're winning. Filed is adding millions of dollars of revenue every quarter, customers are signing up in numbers, and in under two years we've become the market leader in a space with entrenched incumbents and a drastic need for new AI tools. When we come into head-to-heads with competitors, we win every time, because our product is superior. And we stay focused and diligent: we only work with tax firms that have the right expectations, which is why our typical customer is mid-market and enterprise.
   

  

 The industry looks boring from the outside, but the problem is unsolved, and the space has been riddled with products below the mark for decades. When you push through the wall, there's a spark of joy: a customer says "wow, this is phenomenal." That keeps happening.
   

  

 The opportunity here is not only to make a great deal of money. It's to have real impact on our mission: making this profession extraordinary. Nobody became a tax professional for the admin. They got into this work to be creative with tax law, to have fun, and to change the fabric of society. Filed enables them to do exactly that.
   

  

 We've raised $17.2 million to date, led by Northzone, and you can read the story in TechCrunch. Our focus now is to deliver the roadmap and continue to win.
   

  

**What You'll Build**
 As a Senior Full Stack AI Developer, you'll build the agentic systems at the heart of Filed:
   

  

* Agentic workflows that mirror how tax professionals actually work, judgment call by judgment call
* Evaluation and verification systems that measure our accuracy against professional standards, not benchmarks we invented for ourselves
* The model integrations and tooling that turn probabilistic systems into something firms trust with high-stakes work


 You'll work at the frontier of applying AI to subjective domains, where two different answers can both be correct, and where shipping means earning the trust of professionals who scrutinize every output.
   

  

**What You'll Be Responsible For**
* Building and maintaining fullstack features across our AI tax prep, planning, and review products
* Owning the UX and backend logic for the workflows tax professionals use every day
* Shipping fast, watching metrics, and deciding what to improve next, without being told
* Making LLMs work for our customers to achieve higher accuracy and transparency
* Keeping the codebase clean, typed, and fast as we scale


**Your Hard Skillset**
* Comfortable in TypeScript, React, and Python: you've built complex, data-heavy UIs and backend services before
* Familiar with cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud and/or Azure
* Bonus if you've worked in fast-paced startups or regulated industries
* Even bigger bonus if you've taken a product from 0 to 1 and watched real users depend on it


**Your Soft Skillset**
* Comfortable being uncomfortable and making calls with incomplete data
* Empathetic and curious: building for the user, not just for clean code
* Highly collaborative across product, engineering, and tax
* Detail-oriented but pragmatic: you know when polish matters and when to ship
* You own your work and welcome the accountability that comes with it


**A championship team**
 We think of ourselves as a sports team. Incredibly high performance, incredibly high standards, and real success to show for it. Being a championship team means working with people who are deeply proud of the work they do and have great fun doing it together.
   

  

 We measure employee happiness constantly, and our eNPS is +60. We don't say that to brag. We say it because a team playing at this tempo only holds together if people genuinely love being on it. Every four months, the whole company comes together for an offsite.
   

  

**What Filed Stands For**
 Not posters. Not corporate language. Real operating standards.
   

  

* No problem is someone else's problem If you see it, it's yours. Bugs, customer confusion, missed expectations, internal friction. We don't pass problems sideways and we don't hide behind roles. You fix the typo even if you didn't write it, jump into a customer issue even if it's not your department, escalate early, and close loops fully. Ownership means you drive resolution, not that you suffer silently or burn out doing everything alone.
* Waiting is not a strategy Momentum is our advantage. We don't wait for perfect information or stall because something is unclear. You ship a V1 instead of debating V5, test instead of theorize, run small experiments instead of requesting big approvals, and propose solutions instead of just naming blockers. Speed is powerful. Sloppiness is not, and recklessness has no place in a high-trust industry.
* We run toward the fire When something breaks, we move. Tax is high-stakes and trust is fragile. We acknowledge issues immediately, communicate clearly and often, prioritize customer-impacting problems fast, and stay on it until it's fully resolved. Firefighting is a strength, not panic, and never an excuse for preventable mistakes.
* We win on customer experience AI will commoditize. Features will copy. Pricing will compress. Experience won't. We respond faster than customers expect, communicate proactively, think like a partner rather than a ticketing system, and anticipate needs before they're raised. Overdelivering means raising the standard of care, not overpromising, hero culture, or burning the team out.


**Who This Suits**
 This is a very fun environment, but it only suits people who meet the criteria we're looking for:
   

  

* People who want to win
* People who have a point to prove
* People who want to write their own job descriptions


**How We Pay**
 Nothing at Filed is behind closed doors. Everyone here sees everyone else's salary, because we believe transparency creates trust, and trust is the foundation of excellent teamwork. Compensation isn't a negotiation. Depending on your location, everyone receives the same three offers, and all of our offers are above market benchmarking.
   

  

 This role is assessed at Level 4 (Senior). The salary and equity bandings are:
   

  

* Most Equity: 82,500 SEK per month + $180,000 of equity
* Great Equity: 90,000 SEK per month + $120,000 of equity
* Good Equity: 97,500 SEK per month + $60,000 of equity


 We run performance reviews every four months. Meet your goals and you can expect to double your equity by the end of your first year.
   

  

 One more thing, in the spirit of transparency: some people who apply for this role will be assessed at a different level. If the team determines your level of responsibility sits differently, we'll adjust the offer accordingly. If you're earlier in your journey than this role expects, that's not a problem. Apply to the Fullstack AI Engineer role instead.
   

  

**Benefits**
* A minimum of 30 days of holiday per year, whether you're in Europe or the US
* In the US: fully covered medical expenses on platinum-level plans, with 100% coverage for your dependents as well
* In Europe: the full set of mandatory benefits, and more on top
* Company-wide offsites every four months


**The process**
* Quick intro call (30 minutes)
* Technical walkthrough and async task (60 minutes)
* Final round with our team (120 minutes)


 In just 3.5 hours, you'll be wanting early access, just like the rest of our team, to get into the stack and start building a generational company, even before your first day.
   

  

**About Filed**
**Filed is the AI tax preparer trusted by America's accounting firms.**
 Taxes might seem boring, but they are the $5 trillion backbone of the US economy. Globally, nearly $15 trillion in taxes is collected every year. Behind every dollar of it sits a professional making judgment calls, and the industry that does this work is breaking under a talent shortage no one has solved. We're fixing it. Today, hundreds of firms run Filed inside the systems they already use, and we're backed by Northzone, Neo, Analog, and Raine.
   

  

 There has never been a more exciting time to work on a problem this complex. Join us while "I was there when it all started" is still true.

 What you’ll do

description:
***Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.***








**Who We Are…**





 When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the
 *storytellers* 
 bringing our characters to life, the
 *creators* 
 bringing them to your living rooms and the
 *dreamers* 
 creating what’s next…
 









 From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.
 




  


 Warner Bros. has been entertaining audiences for more than 90 years through the world’s most-loved characters and franchises. Warner Bros. employs people all over the world in a wide variety of disciplines. We're always on the lookout for energetic, creative people to join our team.
 




  


**Senior Software Engineer for Cluster Engineering**




  


**Meet our team:** 




 The Direct to Consumer (DTC) Group is a technology company within Warner Bros Discovery. We are building a global streaming video platform (OTT), and a suite of applications to support all of our network’s brands globally. We are building modern container-based micro-services operated on AWS. Our platform covers everything from search, catalogue, video transcoding, personalization, to global subscriptions, and really much more. We build user experiences ranging from classic lean-back viewing to interactive learning applications.  We build for connected TVs, web, mobile phones, tablets, and consoles for a large footprint of WBD owned networks (Max, Discovery, Food Network, Golf TV, MotorTrend, Eurosport, Discovery Play, and many more).  This is a growing, global engineering group crucial to WBD’s future. 
 







 We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer within the DTC Operational Engineering group with focus on Cluster Engineering. The team is dedicated to provide a secure, efficient and easy-to-use container runtime platform. We build automation for expanding it to new markets, tenants and geographical regions, bootstrapping a fully featured container runtime ready for back-end development teams to use.
 



 We team up with other platform teams, manage the lifecycle of critical platform components and work closely with SRE to improve reliability and efficiency of the platform.
 



 We provide strategies and processes for lifecycle management of the container runtime environment. We own critical components, assess when we should introduce new ones, and set the bar for quality. We focus on reducing security incidents while ensuring cost-effectiveness and supporting business needs.
 







 Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, operating Kubernetes clusters (version upgrades and managing critical Kubernetes components like Karpenter), security vulnerability mitigations (rolling out security patches to Kubernetes nodes) and cost optimizations (scaling of our thousands of servers running hundreds of in-house built services, supporting millions of customers across the globe).
 



  


**Your new role:** 








 As a Senior Software Engineer on the team, you will work with Kubernetes cluster operational tasks like upgrading the Kubernetes version. This includes performing an analysis of what is changing in the new version and how it affects the workload running on each cluster, e.g. deprecated k8s APIs and controller compatibility. You’ll use tools to scan clusters for finding things that need remediation, define actions for it, as well as executing them. As part of rolling out upgrades to hundreds of clusters, some ranging up to a thousand nodes, you will identify automation opportunities to reduce the amount of toil needed.
 



 To achieve your goals, you’ll innovate using AI and improve existing processes and operations using agentic workflows. You’ll also contribute to the organization’s AI skills and plugins and advocate AI best practices across the wider organization.
 



 In order to keep our runtime cost low, you will take part in cost optimization efforts, like tweaking the Karpenter node scaling strategies, increasing the bin-packing efficiency of pods on nodes, ensuring the right node family type is used (m, c, r, spot and Graviton/ARM) and identifying over scaled infrastructure.
 



 To enable faster time to new markets and onboarding of new tenants to our streaming platform, you’ll work on automating the creation of new Kubernetes clusters together with bootstrapping of critical platform capabilities like service mesh, deployment systems and the observability stack.
 



  


**Preferred Skills:** 







* Kubernetes experience.
* AWS experience.
* Software development, infrastructure management, or operations experience.Experience with Kubernetes.
* Experience with AWS.
* Experience in software development, infrastructure management, or operations.
* Ability to write code for automation in python, bash or golang.
* Experience with designing infrastructure CI/CD pipelines, e.g. Jenkins or GitHub Actions.
* Experience with IaC, preferably Terraform.
* Used to Helm templating for k8s manifests.
* Understanding how GitOps tooling like ArgoCD or Flux works.
* Experience in rolling out infrastructure changes to production by following a change management workflow.
* Knowing what metrics to monitor during a change rollout to identify problems.
* Strong ownership mentality during rollouts, stop/rollback and fix if problems occur or escalate to management/on call if getting stuck.
* Strong sense of security, always using least privileges access and firewall configurations when needed for maintenance.
* Understanding how running workloads on the Kubernetes clusters may be affected by cluster changes or node rotations.
* Willingness to talk to service development teams and understand their challenges when they report problems during maintenance windows.
* Ability to define and measure KPIs and honor SLAs for infrastructure maintenance.
* Experience with Git and GitHub PR workflows.
* Experience working with Agile – Sprints, Epics/Stories, Jira.
* Experience working with AI tools for day-to-day tasks, e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, or similar.
* Understanding Agentic Workflows.

title: Fleet Platform Engineer (Backend / Cloud), onsite in Stockholm
description:
We have shipped more than 50,000 sensors. They sit in apartments, villas and utility networks across Europe, most of them on batteries and most of them behind someone else's WiFi. We're hiring the engineer who owns the software that keeps them running.
 



  





 🌏 About Quandify
 



 We make hardware for water leak detection and water monitoring, and the platform behind it. Our sensors catch leaks early, and our CubicSecure valve can shut the water off automatically. Customers have cut their water use by up to 30%, and our devices prevent water damage in homes and buildings across Europe.
 



  





 📡 The role
 



 The fleet grows every week through insurers, utilities and installation partners. You own the backend and cloud software that runs it: provisioning, firmware rollouts, telemetry ingestion, monitoring, and the internal tools our support and partner teams use every day. You build these systems and you run them in production.
 



  





 Our backend developers own the product side: the app API, accounts, properties and notifications. You own the fleet underneath. The two areas overlap, but the split is clear from your first week.
 



  





 💻 What you'll do
 



 - Build backend services for device provisioning, lifecycle management and fleet configuration.
 



 - Own the staged OTA pipeline, from targeted rollout through monitoring to rollback.
 



 - Build alerting and dashboards that show us a device is in trouble before the customer notices, whether the cause is connectivity, bad data or a dying battery.
 



 - Scale telemetry ingestion and time series storage as the fleet grows.
 



 - Automate operational work so the fleet can grow faster than the team.
 



 - Build fleet reporting and APIs for our partners, together with the rest of engineering.
 



  





 🧩 What makes it interesting
 



 - A Water Grip runs on two AA batteries and reports once an hour. You can't poll it or ask it to retry, so your design decisions show up directly in battery life.
 



 - A CubicSecure is a valve that shuts off the water in someone's home. A false alarm leaves a family without water and a missed one floods the floor, so the platform has to know the moment it acts and why.
 



 - A CubicDetector sits on the floor for months without anything happening. When it finally gets wet, that one message has to get through immediately.
 



 - When a firmware rollout goes wrong, fixing it can mean sending an installer out in a van.
 



 - Our devices live behind consumer routers. When one goes offline, the cause is usually the customer's WiFi, and telling that apart from a platform problem across tens of thousands of devices is a hard data problem.
 



  





 🧰 Your skillset
 



 - Strong backend development in TypeScript/Node or Java. Today's platform is TypeScript on Node 20, and the next generation is Java 21 on Quarkus. You'll work in both, so depth matters more to us than which one you know now.
 



 - Solid GCP experience: Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Cloud SQL, Secret Manager and GKE.
 



 - PostgreSQL, plus a time series database such as InfluxDB or TimescaleDB.
 



 - Hands-on experience with Grafana and Prometheus, and good judgement about what deserves an alert.
 



 - Terraform, K8s and GitLab CI.
 



 - Experience with MQTT or device management at scale is a strong plus. We run EMQX for our WiFi devices, and our LoRaWAN devices come in through partner network servers.
 



  





 🎁 What we offer
 



 - Ownership of a critical part of the platform, from design to production.
 



 - A small, senior engineering team where your work reaches production the same week.
 



 - Hardware, firmware, backend, app and commercial in the same building, so you can walk over and ask.
 



  





 📍 Location
 



 This role is onsite at our office in Bromma, Stockholm. We move faster when the people building the platform sit next to the people making the hardware, so we're only considering candidates who can work from our office. You need an existing right to work in Sweden, as we can't sponsor work permits for this role.
 



  





 🤔 Not a 100% match?
 



 Few people have done all of this before, because few companies have this mix of problems. If you've done most of it and want to learn the rest, apply anyway.

title: Integrationsspecialist
description:
**Erfaren Integrationsspecialist inom Microsoft Azure** 




  





 Miljontals resor med Stockholms tunnelbana varje vecka vilar på att system och integrationer fungerar, dygnet runt. Som integrationsspecialist på Connecting Stockholm blir du en nyckelperson i vår fortsatta digitaliseringsresa - du blir en del av vårt utvecklingsteam, tre utvecklare som tillsammans med vårt BI-team formar tekniska lösningar som skapar värde för hela verksamheten. Här får du arbeta i en tekniskt stark miljö, med korta beslutsvägar och möjlighet att påverka både integrationsarkitektur och arbetssätt. Vi sitter centralt i Stockholm och du jobbar hos oss i en hybridmodell.
 



  





**Ditt fokus** 



* Designa, utveckla och förvalta skalbara integrationslösningar i Azure - bland annat Logic Apps, Azure Functions och API Management
* Bygga och underhålla REST-API:er med fokus på kvalitet, säkerhet och skalbarhet, inklusive API-policies
* Arbeta med dataströmning och event-baserade lösningar (Event Hub)
* Säkerställa god säkerhet i integrationerna, bland annat autentisering och auktorisering
* Bidra till nyutveckling och modernisering av befintliga integrationer, och agera tekniskt bollplank för kollegor



  





**Vem är du?** 




 Du har flera års erfarenhet av att designa, utveckla och förvalta integrationslösningar i Microsoft Azure, med stark kompetens i C#/.NET, REST-API:er och eventdriven arkitektur. Du är van vid att arbeta i agila team genom hela utvecklingslivscykeln - från kravdialog och design till driftsättning och förvaltning - och att kommunicera tekniska beslut till både tekniska och icke-tekniska intressenter.
 



  





 Du är initiativrik och trygg i att fatta egna arkitektoniska vägval, och ser lika mycket värde i att lösa dagens problem som i att bygga något skalbart och robust som håller i längden.
 



  





**Vi söker dig som har** 



* Relevant högskoleutbildning inom systemutveckling/datateknik, eller motsvarande lång dokumenterad erfarenhet
* Flera års erfarenhet av att designa, utveckla och förvalta integrationslösningar i Microsoft Azure
* Mycket god kompetens i C#/.NET, REST-API:er och eventdriven arkitektur
* Erfarenhet av Azure API Management, inklusive OpenAPI/Swagger och API-policies
* Erfarenhet av dataströmning eller event-baserade plattformar, t.ex. Kafka eller Event Hub
* Flytande svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift



  





*Meriterande:* 
 Azure Integration Services (AIS), Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, Terraform eller ARM Templates), Azure Service Bus/Event Grid, AI-assisterad utveckling (t.ex. GitHub Copilot), integrationer mot verksamhetskritiska system.
 



  





**Varför Connecting Stockholm?** 




 Vi kombinerar erfarenhet och nytänkande för att skapa en tunnelbana som är trygg idag och hållbar för framtiden - och som integrationsspecialist är du en del av just den resan, med stort utrymme att forma både arkitektur och arbetssätt. Vårt uppdrag handlar om mer än trafik: det handlar om människor, ansvar och tillit, och vi drivs av utveckling - både av vår verksamhet och våra medarbetare. Hos oss får du växa och vara med och forma framtidens kollektivtrafik, i en samhällsbärande verksamhet som hundratusentals stockholmare är beroende av varje dag.
 



  





**Inför din ansökan** 




 Vi tillämpar kompetensbaserad rekrytering och strävar efter en rättvis och inkluderande process. Har du frågor om tjänsten är du varmt välkommen att höra av dig till ansvarig rekryterare Caroline Kylbergh på caroline.kylbergh@ants.se.
 



  





 Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

title: Staff / Principal Software Engineer, Security
description:
**TL;DR:** 
 We're looking for an exceptional senior engineer and technical leader for the security team to help make Lovable the most secure AI-powered software creation platform on the planet.
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

**What We’re Looking For**
* 10+ years of engineering experience shipping production-grade products at high velocity, with a track record operating at senior engineering levels.
* Deep, fluent command of React/TypeScript on the frontend and Golang on the backend.
* Experience in one or more of: product security features (audit flows, compliance tooling, scanner interfaces), or code security and static analysis (SAST, linters, vulnerability scanners, or similar).
* Solid understanding of systems design, performance tradeoffs, and scalable architecture.
* Strong product sense - you can take something complex and make it feel simple and actionable for the user.
* Familiarity with AI/LLM-powered tooling, or a background that involved dense algorithmic or systems work.
* You're comfortable navigating ambiguity and driving clarity at an organisational level, not just technically.
* You're based in Stockholm or ready to relocate - this is an on-site, 5-days-a-week role.


**What You’ll Do**
**In one sentence:** 
 Build the security features and systems that make Lovable the most trusted AI software creation platform in the world.
   

  

* Build security product features end-to-end - audit flows, security scanner UI, compliance tooling, design and implement static analysis and more.
* Integrate AI/LLM capabilities into security workflows to detect, explain, and remediate vulnerabilities.
* Ship across the full stack as part of a small, self-sufficient team, owning your work from the first commit to production.
* Advocate for secure coding practices, conduct security-focused code reviews, and raise the bar across the engineering org.
* Influence our technical direction and product strategy with a security-first mindset.


**Our tech stack**
* Frontend:React and Typescript.
* Backend:Golang and Rust.
* Cloud:Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, multiple LLM providers.
* DevOps & Tooling:GitHub Actions, Grafana, OTEL, infra-as-code (Terraform).
* Data:Clickhouse, Firestore, Spanner, BigQuery.


 And we’re always exploring what’s next!
   

  

**About Your Application**
 Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.
   

  

 We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.
