title: Lösningsarkitekt Gemensamma funktioner
description:
**Bakgrund & Uppdragsbeskrivning**
 Uppdraget innebär att agera i rollen lösningsarkitekt inom avdelningen Verksamhets- och ITutvecklingsstöd. Avdelningen förvaltar och vidareutvecklar interna stödsystem för hela Svenska kraftnät. Som lösningsarkitekt arbetar konsulten nära domänarkitekterna. Utöver ansvaret inom avdelningen deltar konsulten även i det övergripande IT-arkitekt teamet på Division IT.
   

  

 Arbetet utförs både inom IT-förvaltningen och i projektform, där arbetet planeras tillsammans med beställare och teamet samt i nära samarbete med domänarkitekt och övriga lösningsarkitekter.
   

  

 Rollen innebär ett övergripande och strategiskt ansvar för lösningsarkitekturen inom HRsystemområdet. Konsulten förväntas hantera komplexa beroenden mellan verksamhetsbehov, informationshantering, lönesystem, HR-system, ERP-system, integrationer, informationssäkerhet och Svenska kraftnäts målarkitektur. Konsulten ska fungera som stöd till domänarkitekter för att säkerställa att långsiktiga arkitekturval är realiserbara, hållbara över tid och stödjer verksamhetens mål. Konsulten förväntas även hantera verksamhetens behov inom AI-området.
   

  

**Som lösningsarkitekt inom Verksamhets- och IT-utvecklingsstöd på Svenska kraftnät kommer arbetsuppgifterna bland annat att innefatta:**
* Ansvara för att ta fram och kvalitetssäkra lösningsarkitektur inom ramen för projekt och förvaltning, i linje med övergripande arkitektur, styrande principer och riktlinjer
* Tekniskt kravarbete, d.v.s. att bidra i kravarbetet med att omvandla verksamhetsbehov till mer


 systemnära krav.
   

  

* Analysera behov (funktionella, icke funktionella) ur såväl strategiskt, taktiskt som operativt


 perspektiv.
   

  

* Leda och driva framtagandet av lösningar som integrerar verksamhetsbehov,


 informationshantering och teknikval.
   

  

* Ta huvudansvar för strategiska arkitekturval inom HR-systemområdet och bereda


 beslutsunderlag för styrande forum.
   

  

* Hantera komplexa beroenden och verksamhetsrisker mellan HR-system, ERP-system,


 integrationer, informationssäkerhet och angränsande IT-stöd.
   

  

* Säkerställa att lösningar är realiserbara, hållbara över tid och utformas i enlighet med Svenska


 kraftnäts målarkitekturer, standarder och verksamhetsmål.
   

  

* Skapa, kvalitetssäkra och kommunicera arkitekturleverabler till relevanta målgrupper på


 strategisk, taktisk och operativ nivå.
   

  

* Representera lösningen i arkitektforum och andra styrande eller beslutande forum.
* Rekommendera lämpliga vägval för att nå projekt-, förvaltnings- och strategiska mål.
* Kvalitetssäkra andra arkitekters och teams lösningsförslag samt vid behov leda och coacha


 arkitekter och tekniska specialister.
   

  

* Samarbeta nära utvecklingsteam, projektledare, domänarkitekter och andra arkitektroller.

title: Laser Engineer
company: Cobolt AB, a part of HÜBNER Photonics
description:
**Have you ever considered a career in advanced fiber amplifier development?** 




  





 HÜBNER Photonics is expanding its R&D organization and is looking for a motivated Laser Engineer to join the R&D team at Cobolt AB in Stockholm, Sweden. As part of HÜBNER Photonics, Cobolt develops, manufactures, and supplies high-performance lasers and laser systems for demanding applications, including life sciences, AR/VR, quantum technologies, and semiconductor manufacturing. Our products are used by system suppliers and leading research institutes worldwide and are recognized for their exceptional quality and reliability.
 



  





**About the role** 




 As a Laser Engineer, you will be at the forefront of developing advanced laser systems based on fiber amplifier technology. You will work closely with colleagues across optics, electronics, software, and mechanical engineering to design, develop, and continuously improve high-performance laser systems. From initial concepts and optical design to prototyping, testing, characterization, and product implementation, you will play an integral role throughout the development process. The role offers a hands-on opportunity to work with advanced fiber amplifiers and laser technology in a highly collaborative, multidisciplinary environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Designing and developing new laser products based on fiber optics.
 



 • Developing customer-specific solutions and adaptations
 



 • Further developing and improving existing products
 



 • Building and evaluating prototypes in a laboratory environment
 



 • Performing testing, characterization, and verification
 



 • Supporting production and sales with your technical expertise
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 We believe you are a structured and analytical engineer who enjoys hands-on technical work and solving complex problems in a multidisciplinary environment. You communicate effectively, take initiative, and are comfortable taking responsibility throughout the product development process. We also expect you to have:
 



  





 • A PhD or MSc in Physics, Optics, Photonics, or a related field, with a strong theoretical foundation.
 



 • Extensive experience working with optical fibers, fiber amplifiers, or other advanced fiber-based
 



 optical components and systems.
 



 • Strong knowledge of fiber optics, laser technology, physical optics.
 



 • Experience with laboratory work, including building, testing, characterizing, and evaluating fiber
 



 optic and laser-based systems and prototypes.
 



 • Excellent written and spoken English and Swedish skills.
 



  





**What we offer** 




 At Cobolt AB, you will be part of the development, manufacturing, and sales of advanced laser products. Our Stockholm site brings together R&D, Manufacturing, Marketing and Sales, and Administration, creating a close connection between product development and production. Our R&D department in Solna consists of about 15 engineers specializing in CAD, laser optics, software, and electronics. You will join a professional and inclusive environment with high-level, complementary expertise, where employees take responsibility, share knowledge, and work together to solve challenging technical problems and turn innovative ideas into successful products. We offer a competitive compensation package, including pension contributions, healthcare insurance, and a wellness allowance, as well as opportunities for professional development and training.
 



  





**Contact** 




 This recruitment process is handled by TB-Group, and all questions regarding the position should therefore be directed to TB-Group.
 



  





 We review applications on an ongoing basis and may remove the advertisement once a sufficient number of candidates have reached the final stages of the recruitment process. If you have any questions or would like further information about the position, you are very welcome to contact the responsible recruiter, Sara Tecsi, at sara.tecsi@tb-group.se.
 



  





**About us** 




 HÜBNER Photonics is an international organization with offices in Stockholm (Sweden), Kassel and Hannover (Germany), and San Jose (CA, USA), and is a corporate division of the privately held HÜBNER Group, headquartered in Kassel. The Stockholm office is represented by Cobolt AB, which has been a subsidiary of the HÜBNER Group since 2015. Cobolt AB is responsible for the development, product management, and manufacturing of the Cobolt and C-FLEX product lines, while also hosting HÜBNER Photonics’ sales office for the Nordic countries and the UK. Both HÜBNER Photonics and Cobolt AB are currently experiencing strong growth and are financially very stable. Cobolt AB is ISO 9001 certified for quality management and holds an AAA credit rating.

title: Revops Specialist (Salesforce and Marketing Operations)
description:
📍
 **Stockholm (Hybrid / Flexible)**
**About B2b At Precis🏢**
 Precis is a digital marketing agency built on transparency, data, and a deep understanding of how to drive growth for our customers. B2B is one of the fastest growing business areas where we have the privilege of working with a portfolio of ambitious, large b2b brands across Europe. Our 50+ team consists of passionate individuals and caring team members who thrive on delivering great business value to our clients through innovation, taking responsibility, and collaborating in a highly dynamic and cross functional unit where there’s a lot of freedom and opportunity to influence where we go next and how.
   

  

**THE ROLE📜**
 CRM and Revenue Optimisation are the bedrock for sustainable growth for any b2b company, yet most companies fall short of delivering on the desired level of alignment that can propel the business forward. If you are the right candidate for the job, you’ll already have experienced this first hand and actively helped create synergies across Sales, Marketing and Service.
   

  

 As a team, we support clients with varied tech stacks: We see a mix of Salesforce Marketing and Sales Cloud, HubSpot Marketing and Salesforce Sales Cloud as well as a host of other tools.
   

  

 As a RevOps Specialist (L3), you will be acting as our Salesforce expert, helping us to shape our growing CRM offering. You will work as a sparring partner and a hands-on technical expert for our clients. This role blends your deep Salesforce platform expertise with your understanding of how Marketing, Sales and Services teams operate and what they need to work together. You are combining tangible marketing automation and marketing operations solutions with strategic insight, allowing you to connect the dots between client operational efficiency and tangible revenue results. Your stakeholders are Marketing leaders who need to drive operational efficiency to prove the value of their investments.
   

  

 Precis was founded in Stockholm, and Sweden is where many of our most ambitious collaborations are situated. While our internal language is English and we serve a portfolio of international clients, fluency in Swedish is a big plus for this particular role.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing 💼**
* Client Consulting: Work with key clients to understand and diagnose pain points in order to deliver technical and process improvements ensuring improved ROI on Marketing activities.
* Campaign execution: Design and build automated journeys, emails, set up segmentation or build multi-channel workflows using the client’s existing solutions.
* Platform Optimisation: Audit existing setups and make recommendations on how to improve lead management, nurture flows, reporting or automation setups based on the client’s overall goals.

* Integrations: Ensure key integrations are set up optimally.
* Data & Reporting Excellence: Partner with our Media and Analytics team to ensure data integrity, build reporting frameworks, and support clients in improving data quality. Built reports and dashboards in Salesforce.
* Internal and external enablement: Educate our clients around the solutions we build for them. Act as an internal subject matter expert, training wider client teams to understand CRM opportunities.


**What We Are Looking For ✔️**
* A team player. We are on a mission to build a world class B2B agency and team within Precis, and other than craft, we’re looking for kindness, ambition, and empathy.
* A minimum of 4 years domain experience working with Marketing teams and aligning with Sales and Customer Success teams.
* Deep Platform Expertise: Strong hands-on, configuration, and integration experience with Salesforce, Marketing is priority, Sales is a huge plus. Even better if you can also navigate HubSpot.
* Growth Mindset: An entrepreneurial spirit who is excited by ambiguity and eager to actively participate in building out processes for an expanding service line.
* The Strategic Doer: You love jumping between high-level business processes and diving deep into platforms to problem-solve and configure workflows yourself
* Revenue/Marketing Operations Background: A proven track record in Marketing and Sales Operations with a clear understanding of how to drive efficiencies through technical solutions when working with Marketing leaders.
* Client-Centric Consultant: Strong communication skills with a demonstrated ability to gather requirements in a complex environment and the ability to translate between process needs and technical requirements.
* Fluency in English and Swedish.


**What We Offer🌟**
*You can read our full offering in our* 
*handbook* 
*.*
* We offer a dynamic, curiosity-driven culture where innovation is at the forefront. You’ll work with some of the industry’s best in digital marketing and martech, all driven to explore new frontiers in a supportive, collaborative environment.
* An intense learning environment where you will be able to grow and develop your skills and passions alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry.
* Transparent salary setting, you can find all our salary bands in our Handbook - this role is an L2 or L3 role (depending on the final candidate's background) within the Media column. Check it out!
* 30 days paid leave, flexible public holidays, parental pay, a solid pension scheme and key insurances. Or different offices also offer different perks such as massage, health care contributions, free book orders, healthy snacks & great coffee, EAP programs and your choice of PC or Mac.
* A diverse environment with a high focus on inclusion and belonging. We speak over 27 native languages around Precis and our internal inclusion score is 4.3 out of 5.


*We are committed to building an inclusive and fair workplace that attracts talent and advances its people, regardless of their background, experiences or perspectives. We believe that a diverse set of minds will continue to contribute to our innovative culture and our ability to reinvent ourselves constantly.*
 🇬🇧 To make things as smooth as possible, please ensure your CV is in English.

title: Junior Elektronikutvecklare för uppdrag inom försvarsindustrin
description:

 AFRY är ett ledande europeiskt företag med global räckvidd inom teknik, design och rådgivning. Vi accelererar omställningen mot ett hållbart samhälle.
   

  

 Vi är 19 000 hängivna experter inom industri, energi och digitalisering, som skapar hållbara lösningar för kommande generationer.
   

  

**Jobbeskrivning**
 Är du i början av din karriär inom elektronik och vill arbeta med teknik där både precision och funktion är avgörande? På AFRY söker vi nu en junior elektronikutvecklare till ett spännande uppdrag inom försvarsindustrin.
   

  

 Här får du arbeta nära hårdvaran och fördjupa dig i hur elektronik faktiskt fungerar – i verkligheten.
   

  

 I den här rollen arbetar du i gränslandet mellan elektronikdesign och produktion, med fokus på hur kretskort och elektroniska system realiseras och fungerar i praktiken.
   

  

 Du kommer att arbeta med
 **kretskortsproduktion, elektronikflöden och tekniska beredningar** 
 , där du säkerställer att konstruktionen är korrekt implementerad, testbar och robust. Mycket av arbetet sker i
 **MES-system** 
 , där du definierar och strukturerar hur elektroniken ska byggas och verifieras.
   

  

 Rollen är tekniskt bred och ger dig en djup förståelse för hela kedjan – från konstruktion till färdig produkt.
   

  

 Arbetet sker
 **på plats hos kund** 
 och kräver att du genomgår en säkerhetsprövning.

* Arbeta med teknisk beredning kopplat till kretskort och elektronik

* Felsöka, testa och verifiera elektronik
* Bidra till förbättring av elektronikdesign och tillverkningsmetoder

* Erfarenhet av t.ex. lödning, montering eller liknande är meriterande
* Grundläggande förståelse för PCB/PCA och elektronikkonstruktion är ett plus
* Svenskt medborgarskap (enbart) samt möjlighet att genomgå säkerhetsprövning (krav för tjänsten)

**Ytterligare information**
 Hos AFRY får du arbeta i teknikintensiva projekt där du utvecklas snabbt och bygger en stark grund inom elektronik. Här får du kombinera teori med praktik och arbeta tillsammans med erfarna kollegor i uppdrag som verkligen ställer krav på kvalitet och precision.Uppdraget är
 **säkerhetsklassat** 
 , vilket innebär att omfattas av en
 **säkerhetsprövning** 
 .
   

  

 Låter det intressant? Tveka inte att höra av dig – vi ser fram emot att få veta mer om dig!

 Stockholm, Sverige

 Omgående, med hänsyn till uppsägningstid

 Stockholm

 Enligt överenskommelse

 Heltid
   

  

**Kontaktperson för frågor:**
**Maja Lindqvist**
 Recruitment Partner
   

  

 maja.lindqvist@afry.com
   

  

*På AFRY driver vi förändring i allt vi gör. Vi anser att förändring sker när modiga idéer möts, när vi samarbetar, skapar innovation och omfamnar kreativa lösningar, det är så vi skapar framtiden. Vi söker konstant kvalificerade kandidater som vill ansluta sig till våra inkluderande team runt om i världen. Bli en del av oss och påskynda den gröna omställningen*

title: Cloud Solution Architect
description:
**Are you passionate about cloud technology and helping customers innovate?** 




  





 Join
 **CloudZone** 
 , a global leader in multi-cloud services and one of the world's leading partners of
 **AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure** 
 .
 



  





 For over
 **14 years** 
 , we've been helping organizations of all sizes accelerate innovation, modernize their applications, optimize cloud environments, and maximize the value of their cloud investments. Our customers trust us to solve complex technical challenges, design scalable cloud architectures, and guide them through every stage of their cloud transformation journey.
 



  





 At CloudZone, we believe technology is only part of the story. What truly sets us apart is our
 **awesome vibe, outside-the-box thinking, colourful professionalism, and unwavering customer obsession** 
 . We foster a collaborative culture where talented cloud professionals continuously learn, share knowledge, and work together to solve real customer challenges.
 



 As we continue expanding across Europe, we're looking for an experienced
 **Cloud Solutions Architect** 
 to join our growing team in Sweden.
 



  





 In this role, you'll combine technical expertise with customer engagement, partnering with customers, sales teams, and cloud specialists to design scalable, secure, and high-performing AWS solutions. You'll act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the pre-sales journey, helping organizations modernize their infrastructure, accelerate cloud adoption, and unlock new business opportunities through cloud technologies.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Serve as a
 **trusted technical advisor** 
 throughout the pre-sales lifecycle, partnering closely with customers, Account Executives, and business stakeholders.
* Lead
 **technical discovery workshops** 
 to understand customer business goals, technical challenges, and cloud strategies.
* Design and present
 **secure, scalable, resilient, high-performing, and cost-optimized AWS architectures** 
 aligned with customer business outcomes.
* Own the solution design process from discovery through proposal, Proof of Concept (PoC), and successful deal closure.
* Deliver technical presentations, architecture reviews, whiteboarding sessions, customer workshops, demonstrations, and technical deep dives.
* Guide customers through
 **cloud adoption, migration, application modernization, infrastructure modernization, DevOps transformation, and AI-driven initiatives** 
 .
* Advise customers on
 **cloud architecture best practices, security, governance, scalability, reliability, performance, cost optimization, and operational excellence** 
 .
* Collaborate closely with Engineering, Delivery, Customer Success, and Professional Services teams to ensure a seamless transition from solution design to implementation.
* Build reusable solution frameworks, reference architectures, technical assets, and best practices that accelerate customer success.
* Stay current with AWS services, cloud-native technologies, AI innovations, DevOps methodologies, and industry trends.
* Act as the
 **voice of the customer** 
 , helping shape CloudZone's cloud and AI offerings by sharing technical insights and customer feedback.
* Contribute to CloudZone's technical community by creating technical content, mentoring colleagues, and sharing best practices.



  





**Who You Are** 




 You enjoy solving complex technical challenges while building trusted relationships with customers.
 



 You are comfortable switching between executive business conversations and technical deep dives, translating customer requirements into scalable cloud solutions that deliver measurable business value.
 



 We're looking for someone with:
 


* 2–3 years of experience as a
 **Cloud Solutions Architect, Solutions Engineer, Pre-Sales Architect, Sales Engineer, Technical Consultant, or Customer Solutions Architect** 
 .
* Strong hands-on experience designing and implementing AWS cloud solutions (Azure and/or GCP experience is an advantage).
* Experience supporting enterprise customers throughout technical sales engagements.
* Strong understanding of
 **cloud architecture, distributed systems, networking, security, compute, storage, and cloud-native technologies** 
 .
* Knowledge of
 **DevOps practices** 
 , Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar), and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with containers and Kubernetes is an advantage.
* AWS Certifications (Solutions Architect Associate or Professional) are highly valued.
* Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and consulting skills.
* The ability to translate complex business challenges into practical, scalable technical solutions.
* Fluent English is required;
 **Swedish proficiency is required** 
 .
* Additional Nordic, Baltic, or Benelux languages are considered a strong advantage.



  





**Bonus Points** 



* Experience working with multiple cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, or cloud-native application architectures.
* Experience in consulting, managed services, or cloud partner environments.
* Experience leading workshops, enablement sessions, or customer technical training.
* Passion for continuous learning, mentoring, and knowledge sharing.

title: Senior Solution Architect (m/f/d)
description:

 The world's largest manufacturers leverage Aras Innovator to manage complex product lifecycles, accelerate innovation, improve operational efficiency, and bring products to market faster.  Are you an experienced Senior Solution Architect who would enjoy leading the technical implementation team in the planning, elaboration, design, construction, and transition of PLM solutions that exceed customer requirements? Then you might be our new Solution Architect.
   

  

 As a Senior Solution Architect at Aras, you have the overall ownership of the solution delivery. Demonstration of technical leadership, organization skills, and the ability to collaborate with key customer stakeholders and internal project managers are essential in ensuring success.

* Lead a technical implementation team in all aspects of solution delivery

* Lead as well as support the development of requirements specifications, Use Cases, and functional specifications

* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science or Engineering (or equivalent experience)
* Experience in any of the following verticals: Automotive, Consumer Products, High Tech Electronics, Medical Devices, Aerospace, Defense, Shipbuilding
* Strong relationship building skills with both colleagues and external customers.
* Must be an effective communicator in difficult customer situations
* Highly organized and self-motivated with the ability to prioritize, meet deadlines, and manage changing priorities
* Ability to contribute to creating clear and understandable Requirements, SoW’s, Specification Documents and Use Cases
* Fluent in English and Swedish for communication in an international environment
* Willingness to travel up to 25% within the Nordic region


 Swedish citizenship is required – since security clearance in Sweden will be needed for some assignments
   

  

 Preferred candidates will bring experience in several of the following areas: Engineering Design, Engineering Change Processes, Phase Gate Project Management, Quality Systems Processes, Manufacturing Process Planning, CMII Change Management, Systems Engineering, Requirements Engineering, Maintenance Design, Planning and Execution, Configuration Management, Variant Management
   

  

**What We Offer**
* Dynamic, open-minded & international team
* Development opportunities in a high growth environment
* Work remotely or in one of our modern offices
* Flexible working time models
* Extensive Onboarding
* Great team spirit and warm, inclusive work environment.


 Please visit our Privacy Notice
   

  

 Aras is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Principal Enterprise Architect
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
   

  

**The Role:**
 We are looking for a curious, smart, and “learn it all” Architect with proven experience and a passion for designing transformative solution architectures for our prospects and customers. This high-impact role demands a unique blend of deep technical expertise and executive presence, requiring you to confidently present to
 **C-level executives** 
 and translate their strategic goals into actionable technical plans. You will work with technical teams at our prospects and customers to design architectures that drive
 **enterprise modernization** 
 , leveraging techniques like
 **capability mapping** 
 and exploring innovative solutions with
 **Agentic AI** 
 .
   

  

 Your primary goal is to support our growing sales team in achieving revenue goals by unlocking technical blockers and partnering closely with our Sales, Value Engineering, Product Management, Data Ops, and Information Security teams. You will be responsible for supporting engagements with new prospects as well as existing customers that look to expand their footprint. Measures of success include new customer acquisition rates, retention, up-selling, and contribution to overall sales team and business success.

title: Senior React Native Engineer
description:
Anyfin is building the next generation of consumer finance. We’re profitable, scaling quickly and now operating with a banking license which opens up a lot of technical complexity.
   

  

 We’re looking for a senior react native engineer who enjoys moving fast, taking real ownership and building things that actually have an impact. We work from the office because we think it makes us better, especially at this stage.
   

  

 If that sounds like your kind of environment, keep reading. Because honestly, it’s not a role for everyone.
   

  

**Small team, high responsibility**
 We hire carefully. We’re not a company that grows by adding headcount everywhere, we grow by keeping the bar high and building a team where every person matters.
   

  

 This isn’t a place where you disappear into a big org. If you join, you’ll have real influence on what we build and how we build it.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 You’ll take a leading role in building and evolving our mobile applications across iOS and Android.
   

  

* Building and shipping new mobile features in React Native.
* Designing reusable components and scalable mobile architecture.
* Collaborating closely with design to deliver polished, accessible user interfaces.
* Integrating with our GraphQL APIs to power seamless user experiences.
* Making architectural decisions that improve performance, maintainability and developer experience.
* Running experiments and iterating on features to improve user engagement and retention.
* Writing and maintaining automated tests to ensure reliability across releases.
* Mentoring other engineers and helping raise the bar for mobile development.


**Tech Stack**
**Mobile:** 
 React Native, TypeScript, Apollo Client (GraphQL)
   

  

**Backend you'll work closely with:** 
 Node.js/Express, GraphQL Federation, PostgreSQL, Redis
   

  

**Infrastructure:** 
 GCP, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions
   

  

**Product tooling:** 
 Storybook, GrowthBook
   

  

**How We Think About Building**
 We’re pragmatic. We like speed, but we also care about building things that last.
   

  

 AI is already part of how we build and not an aspiration. We use Claude, OpenAI, and Mistral in our product, and we expect our engineers to actively explore how AI tooling removes friction from day-to-day work: in code review, test writing, and prototyping. We're looking for someone who sees AI as an amplifier of craftsmanship and not a substitute for it.
   

  

 No ego. Just good judgment and high output.
   

  

**You’ll thrive here if you…**
* Have strong experience building mobile apps with React Native.
* Care about craftsmanship, performance and user experience.
* Take responsibility naturally and don’t wait to be told what to do.
* Enjoy collaborating closely with design and product.
* Like being part of an ambitious team working together in the office.
* Want to build and improve products, not just maintain them.


**You’re Comfortable With Things Like**
* React Native and modern TypeScript-based development.
* Mobile architecture and reusable component design.
* API integrations (GraphQL or REST).
* Testing strategies for mobile applications.
* Shipping real products to real users.


**A few practical notes**
 Stockholm and we're office-based, because we believe that great products and culture are better built when you meet in person. There is flexibility of course, but you should want to work on site with the rest of us most days of the week.
   

  

**Why Anyfin?**
 Because this is one of those moments where a company is about to level up: Banking license secured, expansion ahead and a lot to build.
   

  

 If you want to be part of a small, high-trust team doing meaningful work, we’d love to hear from you. Apply only if you want the responsibility that comes with real impact.
   

  

 Anyfin is a fintech on a mission to simplify loan repayments and improve the financial well-being of millions. We help consumers reduce the costs of high-interest loans, and take control of their repayment plan.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
**Senior AI Engineer - AI grounding infrastructure for enterprise! 💡** 




  





 Want to join a company tackling one of the biggest issues for Enterprise AI today? Look no further 💡
 



  





 My client is a well-established SaaS provider HQ'd in Stockholm, with a leading product trusted by enterprise companies globally to optimise the way in which they handle and share their information.
 



  





 They are now looking for a Senior AI engineer to join their newly established AI R&D lab, a small, autonomous task force building AI grounding infrastructure for enterprise & spearheading the company's product strategy!
 



  





 ✅The role sits at the centre of that effort and would involve:
 



  




* Designing and evolving the knowledge graph architecture
* Owning retrieval systems end-to-end (RAG, hybrid retrieval, embeddings, re-ranking and evaluation)
* Determining when graph-based retrieval outperforms vector approaches and vice versa
* improving retrieval quality, hallucination reduction, latency and cost efficiency
* Working directly with early lighthouse customers to shape the product
* Making key architectural decisions for the company's long-term AI strategy



  





 🔥What you bring"
 



  




* 5+ Years as a software engineer, working full-stack and in close-proximity to product
* Demonstrably experience architecting, designing & building RAG systems into production
* Hands-on, production experience with vector databases, Semantic technologies, retrieval evaluation & embeddings
* Strong understanding and experience with knowledge graph, graph databases and similar
* Experience and comfortable with: Typescript, Python, (Rust although not necessary to have experience in this, but you'll be able to work with it!), AWS, Iaac
* SaaS experience



  





 This isn't just a role where you will using AI for the sole purpose of speeding up your code, but rather an opportunity to tackle some super challenging & exciting problems and think deeply on AI for enterprise.
 



  





 You'd sit as part of a small, super talented team (approx. 6 people), where the CEO handles the product management. Your work would play a huge impact on the future direction of the company, and essentially you'd be able to have the autonomy and impact of a startup, with the backing and sponsorship of an established SaaS company!
 



  





 This is a permanent role (hybrid) in Stockholm. A strong salary package, ITP1 pension, 30 days vacation and an employee-focused benefits package to compliment this exciting role!

title: Principal Engineer - High growth scale up- Stockholm
description:
**🚀 Principal Engineer role - High Growth scale-up - Stockholm 🚀** 




  





 The title can be interchangeable, but what is a given is that this role is the opportunity to be at the tip-of-the spear within one of Stockholm's most exciting and high-impact startups right now!
 



  





 This role is for someone who wants to be at the forefront of technical discovery, AI application, solving complex, unexplored problems, exploring and spearheading new product & engineering initiatives which translate into real-world commercial impact!
 



  





 You won’t be joining to own a particular engineering team or simply deliver against an existing roadmap. You’ll operate across the organisation, working closely with the CTO, head of product, business leadership and an exceptional product-minded engineering org, to identify opportunities, challenge assumptions and figure out what should be built next!
 



  





**What Makes This Role Different ✅** 




  




* A newly created, foundational position with significant freedom to shape the role and having a transformative impact on a company already leading the pack in its field
* Operating across the organisation rather than within a single engineering team
* Close partnership with senior technology and product leadership
* Exposure to complex technical, product and commercial challenges
* Significant autonomy to explore, experiment and influence direction
* The opportunity to work on problems where there is no obvious playbook
* A position at the intersection of technology, product, AI and business strategy



  





**Your Mission ✅** 




  





 Your role will be to find and solve the problems that sit beyond the boundaries of individual teams.
 



 You’ll have the agency to:
 



  




* Explore complex business and technical challenges
* Identify opportunities where technology can create meaningful new value
* Lead early-stage discovery, experimentation and validation
* Turn promising ideas into prototypes, products or new capabilities
* Challenge existing thinking and introduce new approaches
* Influence technical and product strategy
* Connect engineering capability with wider business opportunities
* Help identify potential new products, markets and revenue streams



  





 The emphasis is on discovery and problem solving rather than execution against a predefined backlog.
 



  





**AI & Emerging Technology ✅** 




  





 AI will be an important part of the role and our strategy going forward, but this is not simply an AI engineering position. You’ll be expected to understand where AI and emerging technologies can genuinely change how the organisation operates, what it builds and how it creates value. AND, be able to decide when AI isn't the solution!
 



  





**This could include: ✅** 




  




* Identifying unconventional opportunities for AI across the business
* Exploring emerging technologies and their practical applications
* Rapidly prototyping new concepts
* Evaluating whether an idea has genuine customer or commercial potential
* Taking successful experiments through to production
* Helping shape the broader technology and AI strategy
* Focusing on measurable outcomes rather than experimentation for its own sake



  





**How You'll Work✅** 



* You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy and work horizontally across engineering, product and business functions.



  




* You should be comfortable moving between high-level business problems and deep technical detail, and knowing when to stay strategic versus when to get hands-on.



  




* You won't be expected to manage a large team. Instead, your impact will come through the problems you solve, the direction you influence and the leverage you create for others.



  





**The Ideal Profile ✅** 




  





 You may currently be a Principal Engineer, Staff Engineer, Distinguished Engineer, VP of Technology or another senior technical leadership position, a founder trapped within a slow moving enterprise org, or maybe you've been a founding engineer or CTO within a high growth startup!
 



  





**More important than your current title is that you: ✅** 




  




* Have significant experience building software and designing complex systems
* Have operated successfully in high-growth or high-change environments
* Enjoy ambiguity rather than needing a clearly defined scope
* Have experience taking ideas from 0→1
* A track record / examples of taking product/engineering initiatives from idea to launch, getting stakeholder buy in and taking it to production.
* Combine strong technical depth with product and commercial thinking
* Can understand a business problem before jumping to a technical solution
* Have strong architectural judgement and systems thinking
* Are comfortable influencing without formal authority
* Know when to experiment, when to move quickly and when something needs to be built properly
* Are naturally curious about emerging technology and what it could enable



  





**Technology ✅** 




  





 The existing environment includes:
 


* Node.js / TypeScript
* AWS
* MongoDB
* Cloud-native architecture
* Modern engineering practices and tooling



  





 The technology stack is not restrictive. You’ll have the freedom to introduce new technologies where they make sense for the problem being solved.
 



  





**What Success Looks Like ✅** 




  





 Success won't be measured simply by the number of tickets delivered or systems owned.
 



 It will look more like:
 



  




* Complex problems being turned into clear opportunities
* New ideas moving from discovery → prototype → production
* Technology creating measurable new business or product value
* AI being applied in places where it genuinely changes outcomes
* New product or revenue opportunities being identified and validated
* Senior leadership having a trusted technical partner for difficult, ambiguous problems
* The organisation becoming faster and more capable at exploring what comes next



  





 This is a role for someone who wants to be
 **at the frontier of what the organisation could become** 
 , rather than simply maintaining what already exists. Like we mentioned, high ownership, high agency and autonomy, startup ambiguity with an established engineering team and successful product, with a tonne of room to impact!
 



  





 This is a hybrid role, 3 days/week in Stockholm office generally. Unable to assist in Visa sponsorship or extensions at the moment.
 



  





 Compensated with an attractive salary & compensation offering!

title: DevOps/SecOps
description:
Vill du kombinera DevOps, cloud och cybersecurity? Som DevOps/SecOps-konsult bygger du automatiserade och säkra leveransmiljöer för kunder i olika tekniska miljöer.
   

  

 Vad kommer du att arbeta med?
   

  

 I rollen designar, administrerar och optimerar du moderna utvecklings- och driftmiljöer. Säkerhet integreras genom hela utvecklings- och leveransprocessen, från kod och beroenden till driftsatt infrastruktur.
   

  

 En viktig del av vardagen är att utveckla CI/CD-pipelines med automatiserade säkerhetskontroller, sårbarhetsskanning och secrets management. Du arbetar också med Infrastructure as Code, konfigurationshantering och automation för att skapa reproducerbara, skalbara och säkra miljöer.
   

  

 Containerteknik och orkestreringsplattformar är centrala i uppdragen. Här bidrar du med drift, säker konfiguration och härdning av container- och Kubernetesmiljöer. Monitorering, loggning och observability hjälper dig att identifiera avvikelser, sårbarheter och potentiella säkerhetshot.
   

  

 Uppdragen varierar mellan olika tekniska miljöer och branscher. Det ger dig utrymme att fortsätta utvecklas inom DevOps, cloud security och cybersecurity samtidigt som du skapar lösningar som fungerar i kundernas vardag.
   

  

 För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:
   

  

* Erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling, scripting och automation, exempelvis med Python, samt god förståelse för DevSecOps-principer.
* Erfarenhet av att administrera, utveckla och optimera CI/CD-pipelines samt implementera säkerhetskontroller som SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, container scanning eller secrets scanning.
* Kunskap om Git repository management, Git workflows, branchingstrategier och säker hantering av repositories, kod, beroenden och artefakter.
* Erfarenhet av Infrastructure as Code med exempelvis Terraform samt konfigurationshantering och automation med Ansible, Puppet, Chef eller liknande verktyg.
* Erfarenhet av Docker och Kubernetes, inklusive hardening, RBAC, secrets management och sårbarhetshantering, samt kunskap om IAM, least privilege och role-based access control.
* Kunskap om monitorering, loggning och observability, vulnerability management och patchning samt grundläggande förståelse för cloud security och nätverkssäkerhet, exempelvis brandväggar, segmentering, TLS, certifikat och säker kommunikation mellan tjänster.


 Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt.
   

  

 Meriterande
   

  

* Erfarenhet av Azure, AWS eller Google Cloud med fokus på säkerhet samt säkerhetsverktyg för SAST, DAST, Software Composition Analysis, container scanning eller secrets scanning.
* Erfarenhet av SIEM, centraliserad logghantering, Security Operations, incidenthantering, incident response eller security monitoring.
* Kunskap om policy as code och automatiserad kontroll av att infrastruktur och deployment följer definierade säkerhetskrav.
* Fördjupad erfarenhet av Kubernetes security, exempelvis network policies, RBAC, admission policies eller runtime security, samt secrets management med HashiCorp Vault eller motsvarande.
* Erfarenhet av Golang eller CI/CD-automationsflöden som omfattar egen hårdvara, exempelvis egenutvecklade testriggar.
* Erfarenhet av säkerhetsstandarder eller ramverk som ISO 27001, NIST, CIS Benchmarks eller OWASP.


 Vad får du hos oss?
   

  

 Du blir en del av ett kompetent team där samarbete och kunskapsdelning är en naturlig del av arbetet. Kombinationen av varierande kunduppdrag och tekniskt utmanande projekt ger dig möjlighet att bredda och fördjupa din kompetens inom automation, cloud, DevOps och cybersecurity.
   

  

 Här möts teknik, säkerhet och kreativitet i en lärande miljö där du kan bidra med din erfarenhet och fortsätta utvecklas tillsammans med kollegor och kunder.
   

  

 Ansökan
   

  

 Låter rollen intressant? Välkommen att skicka in din ansökan. Vi ser fram emot att höra mer om dig och din erfarenhet.
   

  

 Om Knowit
   

  

 Jobba hos oss på Knowit Connectivity, där vi arbetar med tekniskt avancerade system inom embedded och uppkopplade lösningar. Hos oss får du arbeta med komplexa produkter tillsammans med erfarna ingenjörer i uppdrag som ligger i teknisk framkant.
   

  

 Knowit är ett nordiskt konsultbolag som hjälper företag, myndigheter och organisationer att lyckas i den digitala transformationen. Med expertis inom systemutveckling, AI, cybersäkerhet, molntjänster, digitala kundupplevelser och managementkonsulting utvecklar vi lösningar som bidrar till ett mer hållbart och mänskligt samhälle.
   

  

 Vi är cirka 3 700 medarbetare och arbetar genom våra affärsområden Solutions, Experience, Connectivity, Insight och Products – främst i Norden, men även i Polen, Serbien och Tyskland.
   

  

 We don’t wait for the future. We build it.

title: Master Thesis: Systematizing Neuro-Symbolic AI for Autonomous Network Management
description:
**Join our Team**
**About this opportunity:**
 Ericsson Research Area Security provides Ericsson business and development units with security competence, architectures, and solutions for platforms, networks, and services. Our research covers cryptography, secure networking, AI/ML security, service and application security, identity management, privacy, and methods for developing and evaluating security systems. We focus on new concepts and methods, patents, and standardisation.
   

  

 This Master's thesis will be hosted by Ericsson Research in Kista and will be part of an international team of world-class researchers with expertise in machine learning and network security.
   

  

 The objective is to conduct a systematic mapping and systematization of knowledge on neuro-symbolic AI, with particular attention to its potential role in autonomous and intent-based networking. The thesis will investigate the existing research landscape and develop a structured understanding of the field. The expected primary contribution is a taxonomy and knowledge structure derived from existing research and relevant standards.
   

  

**What you will do:**
 The thesis will follow a Systematic Literature Review (SLR) or Systematisation of Knowledge (SoK) methodology and investigate:
   

  

* What classes of neuro-symbolic AI approaches have been proposed, and how do they represent knowledge, entities, states, transitions, or constraints?
* How are responsibilities divided between neural and symbolic components, and how are they evaluated?
* Which approaches are potentially applicable to autonomous or intent-based networking, and how do concepts in the literature relate to models defined by relevant networking standards?
* What research, engineering, or standardisation gaps can be identified from this comparison?


 You will review and classify relevant research, analyse applicable standards, develop the taxonomy and knowledge structure, and document the findings in a Master's thesis.
   

  

**The skills you bring:**
* You are enrolled in a Master's programme in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Machine Learning, or an equivalent field.
* You have solid software-development experience.
* You are interested in one or more of the following areas: neuro-symbolic AI, large language models, autonomous systems, automation, or security.
* You have strong analytical, research, and technical writing skills.


 Experience with systematic literature reviews is considered a plus. Relevant project experience is highly valued, so please describe completed projects and your specific role in them. Technical reports, such as school assignments or blog posts, may also be included as supporting material.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Data Scientist
 



  





 Business-Focused | Marketing Analytics | High Ownership | Scale-Up Environment
 



  





 We’re partnering with a fast-growing, data-driven company that is expanding its Data Science team. This is an opportunity to join a highly collaborative environment where data plays a central role in shaping commercial and marketing decisions.
 



  





 This is not an ML engineering role.
 



  





 We’re looking for a
 **business-oriented Data Scientist** 
 who thrives on solving real commercial problems - someone who can translate ambiguity into structure and turn data into measurable value.
 



  





 Why this role is exciting?
 


* You’ll work directly with senior stakeholders and marketing teams.
* You’ll build new capabilities in an area that’s still largely untapped.
* You won’t be siloed in an isolated data team - you’ll operate as a strategic partner.
* You’ll have the autonomy to define problems, shape solutions, and influence outcomes.
* You’ll join a lean, collaborative environment where impact matters more than hierarchy.



  





 If you enjoy working hands-on, owning problems end-to-end, and seeing your work drive commercial outcomes - this will suit you well.
 



  





 What you’ll be doing?
 


* Translating business and marketing challenges into structured data science problems
* Defining success metrics and measurable impact
* Designing and executing analytical approaches (segmentation, prediction, experimentation, optimisation)
* Working closely with commercial and marketing stakeholders
* Communicating insights clearly to non-technical audiences
* Contributing to both new marketing initiatives and existing ML use cases



  





 You’ll be treated as a thought partner - not just someone who “builds models.”
 



  





 What we’re looking for?
 



 Core Profile
 


* 2+ years of experience in a Data Science or advanced analytics role
* Strong foundation in mathematics, statistics, or a related quantitative field (Master’s preferred)
* Confident in Python for data analysis and modelling
* Experience turning vague business questions into structured analytical solutions
* Ability to clearly explain complex ideas to non-technical stakeholders



  





 You’ll likely thrive here if:
 


* You enjoy smaller, agile environments over large corporate silos
* You’ve worked close to marketing, growth, or commercial teams
* You care about measurable business impact - not just model accuracy
* You take initiative rather than waiting for detailed instructions
* You’re comfortable operating with ambiguity
* You prefer ownership over rigid structure



  





 Bonus Points for
 


* Marketing analytics or performance marketing exposure
* Experience measuring campaign performance or customer segmentation
* A/B testing and experimentation experience
* Cloud familiarity
* Experience working in companies where Data Science is embedded in business teams rather than isolated



  





 This role is probably not for you if:
 


* You’re primarily an ML engineer focused on deployment, infrastructure, or MLOps
* You prefer highly defined tickets over open-ended problem solving
* You’ve worked exclusively in research or academic environments without commercial exposure



  





 The Team & Environment:
 



 You’ll join an established Data Science function working alongside experienced colleagues. The team balances traditional ML use cases with new marketing-focused initiatives - and this hire is key to scaling that capability.
 



  





 Data Science here is collaborative, commercially focused, and less onboarding-heavy than large enterprise environments. You’ll be contributing meaningfully from early on.
 



  





 The Opportunity...
 



 This is a chance to step into a role where:
 


* Your thinking matters as much as your technical skills
* You influence strategy, not just implementation
* You help build new data capabilities from the ground up
* You grow alongside a scaling, ambitious team



  





 If you’re a problem solver who enjoys bridging business and data - we’d love to speak with you.

 Denna tjänst kräver att du genomgår en säkerhetsprövning baserad på gällande regler kring/av säkerhetsskydd. För tjänster som kräver säkerhetsprövning kan ytterligare krav på medborgarskap gälla.

 Seeking an experienced Data Architect to lead Azure and Databricks data platforms, data products, governance, security, CI/CD, unstructured data, GenAI and LLM initiatives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 Data Architecture & Strategy; Data Product Development; Data Sourcing & Integration; Databricks Lakehouse; Unity Catalog Governance; Access Management & Security; CI/CD & DevOps; Unstructured Data Management; GenAI & LLM Solutions; Stakeholder Leadership.
 



  





**Required Technical Skills** 




 Azure, Databricks, Unity Catalog, Spark/PySpark, Delta Lake, Azure OpenAI, Data Products, Data Mesh, CI/CD, Terraform, Entra ID, RBAC/ABAC, RAG, Vector Databases.
 



  





**Required Qualifications** 




 Bachelor or Master degree.
 



 8-10 years experience in Data Architecture/Data Engineering.
 



 Proven enterprise Azure and Databricks expertise.
 



  





**Preferred Certifications** 




 Azure Solutions Architect, Azure Data Engineer, Azure AI Engineer, Databricks certifications.
 



  





**Nice to Have** 




 Microsoft Fabric, MLOps, Data Mesh implementations, GenAI-powered data products.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Equal IT are hiring for a small, sharp engineering team building enterprise-level products used by some pretty big brands and agencies.
 



  





 The team is hybrid and based in Stockholm.
 



  





 There are two tracks open right now for
 **frontend-heavy or backend-heavy,** 
 and we are happy to speak to strong engineers on either side.
 



  





 What matters more than the stack is how you work.
 



  





 We are looking for someone who drives things forward, someone who pushes back on scope when it makes sense, leads the technical conversation, and makes the engineers around them better.
 



  





 AI is part of the picture too, not feaure-lead but embedded in engineering workflow. We want to hear about what you have actually done. Real AI workflows, real guardrails, real examples of where something went wrong and what you did about it.
 



  





**Frontend-heavy** 



* We are looking for someone who is genuinely strong in frontend architecture, not just someone who makes things look good.
* Angular experience is ideal, or something close enough.
* You will also need enough backend experience to comfortably cross over when needed.



  





**Backend-heavy** 



* Strong .NET/C# experience, with real production scale behind you.
* Microservices, distributed systems, systems running under load. Stuff you have built and operated.
* You do not need to be a frontend specialist, but you should be able to hold your own when you need to jump across.



  





 The engineering culture is collaborative and consensus-driven, which we like. But consensus doesn’t mean everyone agreeing for the sake of it. We want someone comfortable taking a position, defending it, and changing their mind when the evidence says they should.
 



  





 If that sounds like you, we’d be interested in talking.

title: Senior mjukvaruutvecklare
description:
*Vill du påverka och göra skillnad på riktigt? Här bidrar du till att skapa trygghet för människor och samhällen. Det du gör spelar roll.*
**Din roll**
 Vår avdelning utvecklar och levererar världsledande ledningssystem som används av både det svenska flygvapnet och internationella kunder. Här får du möjlighet att arbeta med teknik som spelar en avgörande roll för Sveriges luftförsvar och förmåga att övervaka och skydda vårt luftrum.
   

  

 Du kommer främst att arbeta med Sveriges ledningssystem för luftbevakning och flygstridsledning, ett avancerat och verksamhetskritiskt system där information från bland annat radar, radiosamband, telefoni och färdplanssystem samlas för att ge operatörer rätt beslutsunderlag i realtid. Kraven på tillförlitlighet, robusthet och säkerhet är mycket höga, vilket gör arbetet både tekniskt utmanande och meningsfullt.
   

  

 Som en viktig del av vårt mjukvaruteam kommer du att vara med och utveckla nya funktioner, förbättra befintliga lösningar och integrera dem i ett komplext system med många olika gränssnitt. Du arbetar nära erfarna kollegor i en miljö där samarbete, teknisk kompetens och kvalitet står i fokus.
   

  

 Vi har ett nära och gott samarbete med både kund och operatörer med kontinuerlig dialog kring prioriteringar, planering och innehåll i kommande releaser. Samarbetet är genomgående i hela projektorganistionen från ledning ned till enskilda utvecklare, för att säkerställa att operatörerna får den bästa funktionaliteten för att utföra sitt uppdrag.
   

  

 Eftersom arbetet sker i miljöer som hanterar försvarshemlig information bedrivs huvuddelen av arbetet på plats på kontoret. Det skapar samtidigt goda möjligheter till nära samarbete, kunskapsutbyte och gemenskap i teamet.
   

  

 Framför oss ligger flera spännande satsningar, både vidareutveckling av befintliga system och utveckling av nästa generations lösningar.
   

  

**Din profil**
 Vi söker en positiv och strukturerad mjukvaruutvecklare med flerårig erfarenhet och ett starkt intresse för tekniskt avancerade system. Du trivs med att analysera komplexa problem och utveckla robusta lösningar med hög kvalitet, prestanda och tillförlitlighet.
   

  

 Du är en lagspelare som uppskattar nära samarbete med kollegor och kunder, samtidigt som du tar eget ansvar och driver ditt arbete framåt. Du motiveras av att arbeta med samhällsviktiga system där teknik, säkerhet och verksamhetsnytta står i centrum.
   

  

 Din bakgrund är troligtvis civil- eller högskoleingenjör inom datavetenskap, teknisk fysik eller närliggande område och du har flerårig erfarenhet av professionell mjukvaruutveckling.
   

  

**Krav**
* Goda färdigheter i flera programmeringsspråk (t ex Rust, Ada, C/C++, Java)
* God förståelse för datastrukturer, operativsystem och systemnära mjukvaruutveckling
* Erfarenhet av utveckling i Linux
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift


**Meriterande med erfarenhet inom**
* Utveckling av komplexa samhällskritiska eller flygsäkerhetskritiska system
* Erfarenhet av utveckling inom försvar / transport / telekom
* Integration i Linux (Bash, installations-paket, nätverk)
* Designutredningar och specifikationer
* Taktiska datalänkar, färdplanssystem, eller radarsystem


 Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.
   

  

**Vad du blir en del av**
 Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.
   

  

 Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med syfte att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidra till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 28 000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld.
   

  

 Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här
   

  

 Om du är intresserad av vilka förmåner som du kan ta del av som anställd på Saab i Sverige, kan du läsa om dem här
   

  

 Vänligen observera att vi arbetar med löpande urval och att tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum har gått ut.

title: Senior Pega Developer
description:
*Vill du vara med och utveckla digitala lösningar som gör verklig skillnad för människor och samhället? Vi får människor och företag att växa. Tillsammans driver vi förändring, utvecklar nya arbetssätt och skapar lösningar som gör att Sverige kan fortsätta framåt. Vi söker nu en Senior Pega utvecklare som vill vara med och göra verklig skillnad.*




  

  





**Vilka är vi**




 På avdelningen Digital förmedling inom IT arbetar cirka 450 medarbetare med att utveckla framtidens digitala arbetsförmedling. Vi befinner oss i en omfattande digital transformation där vi skapar moderna lösningar som förenklar vardagen för både arbetssökande och arbetsförmedlare.
   

  





 Du blir en del av sektionen Bedömning, ett team med 15 engagerade kollegor som utvecklar ett centralt beslut- och ärendehanteringssystem. Lösningen stödjer bedömningen av arbetssökandes behov och upprättandet av handlingsplaner samt möjliggör ett effektivt informationsutbyte mellan arbetssökande, Arbetsförmedlingen och fristående aktörer. Utvecklingen sker främst i Pega, men även i Java.
   

  





****Vem söker vi****




 Som Senior Pega Developer tar du stort ansvar för din prestation och leverans. Du har god kommunikativ förmåga, samarbetar väl och bygger goda relationer såväl inom teamet som utanför teamet. Du drivs av att ständigt utveckla dig och dina leveranser. Du har koll på mål och planen framåt för den utveckling du och ditt team jobbar med.
   

  





 Du kommunicerar på ett enkelt och begripligt sätt vad som är gjort, vad som återstår och hinder/risker att leverera det som är planerat till berörda parter. Du har förmåga att förmedla kunskap och information på ett pedagogiskt och tydligt sätt och har ett coachande förhållningssätt till mer juniora kollegor.
   

  





****Vårt erbjudande****




 Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid som inleds med sex månaders provanställning. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Placeringsort är Arbetsförmedlingens huvudkontor i Solna.
   

  





 Vi erbjuder förmånliga semesteravtal, friskvård på arbetstid samt friskvårdsbidrag. I denna tjänst erbjuder vi möjlighet att arbeta på distans upp till 49 procent på årsbasis.
   

  





 Jag som rekryterar heter Anders, är en nyfiken, friluftsälskande före detta norrlänning. En anledning att jag jobbar på arbetsförmedlingen är att vi hjälper företag och människor att växa! Mejla mig så kan vi prata mer.
   

  





 Läs mer om vår organisation och vårt uppdrag på vår webbplats 
   

  





 Mer om att jobba hos oss 
   

  





  
   

  





****Grundläggande krav för tjänsten****



* Systemvetenskaplig utbildning, alternativt motsvarande kunskaper förvärvade på annat sätt och som bedöms som likvärdiga
* Certifierad PCSSA
* Minst 6 års arbetslivserfarenhet som SSA
* Omfattande erfarenhet av att ha jobbat med produktionssupport (ex. incidenthantering och hantering av teknisk skuld)
* Erfarenhet av att bygga säkra API:er och säkra system
* Arbetslivserfarenhet av relationsdatabaser och kunskap inom SQL
* Arbetslivserfarenhet av tillämpning av ”Pega best practice” så som till exempel komponentarkitektur för återanvändning
* Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga i svenska och/eller engelska i både tal och skrift



  
   

  





****Övriga meriter för tjänsten****



* Erfarenhet av arbete på Arbetsförmedlingen med utveckling av system som stödjer arbetsförmedlare, arbetssökande eller fristående aktörer
* Kunskap om Pega Constellation
* Certifiering i SAFe eller Scrum
* God kunskap om JMS
* God kunskap om Kibana



 Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet där kommunikations- och samarbetsförmåga är viktigt.
   

  





 Den statliga värdegrunden guidar oss i vårt dagliga arbete. Som anställd hos oss förväntas du arbeta rättvist, opartiskt och med hög integritet, samt bidra till att upprätthålla och stärka förtroendet för vår myndighet.  
   

  





 Utöver detta har du personlig förmåga och fallenhet att arbeta i enlighet med Arbetsförmedlingens medarbetarkriterier. Läs mer om den statliga värdegrunden och våra medarbetarkriterier på vår hemsida.
   

  





 Som medarbetare på Arbetsförmedlingen förväntas du vara:
   

  





**Ansvarstagande** 
 – ta ansvar för ditt arbete, samarbeta och bidra till en god arbetsmiljö.
   

  





**Handlingskraftig** 
 – ta initiativ, bidra till förbättringar och hantera förändringar.
   

  





**Resultatfokuserad** 
 – planera, följa upp och bidra till verksamhetsnytta och resultat.
   

  





****Ansökan****




 Låter det här som en tjänst för dig?
 **Välkommen med din ansökan senast 2026-10-14.**




 Bifoga ditt CV där du specificerar årtal, månad och arbetsuppgifter för varje anställning, samt intyg som styrker kraven om utbildning och/eller arbetslivserfarenhet i din ansökan. 
   

  





 Det är viktigt att du besvarar urvalsfrågorna detaljerat och sanningsenligt, för att vi ska få en tydlig bild av din erfarenhet. Om efterfrågad information inte framgår riskerar du bli bortsållad i urvalet. Du behöver inte skicka in ett personligt brev.
   

  





 Under rekryteringsprocessen kan urvalstester förekomma. Vi kommer att hålla dig informerad genom hela rekryteringsprocessen. Mer om vår rekryteringsprocess. 
   

  





 Har du skyddade personuppgifter kontaktar du den rekryteringspartner som finns namngiven i annonsen så får du hjälp med att skicka in din ansökan.
   

  





 Vi arbetar aktivt för att vara en myndighet fri från diskriminering. Det är viktigt för oss att all kompetens tas tillvara och vi välkomnar alla sökande. Vi ser positivt på om du har kunskaper i något av våra nationella minoritetsspråk.
   

  





 Välkommen till oss – vi jobbar för ett Sverige i arbete! Här arbetar du på regeringens uppdrag för en väl fungerande arbetsmarknad. Målet är att korta tiden i arbetslöshet genom att matcha arbetssökande med arbetsgivare. Våra insatser riktas i första hand till dem som står längst ifrån arbetsmarknaden och till de arbetsgivare som är öppna för att anställa dem med störst behov av stöd. Vi motverkar felaktiga utbetalningar och brott mot välfärdssystemen så att våra skattemedel används effektivt till det de är till för. Vi samarbetar med många andra aktörer och tillsammans hittar vi lösningar som gör skillnad - för ett Sverige i arbete.
   

  





 Mer om vår organisation och vårt uppdrag

title: Senior Fullstack Developers – Test Automation (Stockholm)
description:
**About Justera Group**
 Justera Group AB is a leading Swedish IT consulting firm with great experience specializing in building high-performing technology teams and delivering end-to-end IT solutions. Led by dynamic female executives, Justera Group focuses on helping businesses harness the power of digital technologies to continuously evolve in today’s rapidly changing economy. The company has deep expertise in IT consultancy, software development, and recruitment services, providing clients with purpose-driven, well-trained consultants who consistently deliver efficient and effective results. Justera Group manages the entire talent lifecycle, from hiring to ongoing management, ensuring the right fit for each project on time and within budget. With their strong commitment to quality, collaboration, and client success, Justera Group is a trusted partner for technology innovation across Sweden.
   

  

**About the Role:**
 We are looking for Senior Fullstack Developers with strong test automation skills to join a development team working on a modern financial trading platform.
   

  

 You will play a key role in developing and rebuilding solutions for processing external mutual fund orders across multiple Nordic markets. The role combines hands-on software development with a strong focus on automated testing and quality throughout the development lifecycle.
   

  

 You will work with modern technologies including Java 21, Spring Boot, microservices, Microsoft SQL, REST APIs, Kafka and React.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Design, develop and maintain scalable backend services, integrations and frontend functionality.
* Write clean, maintainable and testable code using sound object-oriented design principles and patterns.
* Develop and maintain automated tests covering functional, regression, integration, API and UI scenarios.
* Use tools and frameworks such as JUnit, Cucumber and other relevant testing technologies.
* Validate REST APIs, Kafka-based event flows and database integrity as part of feature development.
* Contribute to reusable test automation frameworks, test data preparation and reliable test execution within CI/CD pipelines.
* Perform manual and exploratory testing when automation is not feasible or cost-effective.
* Analyze test results, troubleshoot defects and work closely with developers, DevOps, Product Management and other stakeholders.
* Help improve development, testing and delivery processes by identifying opportunities for automation.
* Contribute to a strong quality culture throughout the software development lifecycle.


**Requirements:**
* Strong professional experience with Java 21+ and Spring Boot.
* Experience designing and developing microservices and distributed backend systems.
* Solid knowledge of REST APIs, Kafka and event-driven architectures.
* Strong SQL skills and experience with Microsoft SQL or other relational databases.
* Experience writing unit, integration and acceptance tests using JUnit and Cucumber.
* Proven ability to design maintainable automated tests alongside production code.
* Experience with API testing tools such as REST Assured or similar.
* Experience testing asynchronous flows and validating data across services, messages and databases.
* Working knowledge of UI test automation using Playwright, Selenium or similar.
* Experience with Git and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, including integrating automated tests into delivery pipelines.
* Experience developing or improving reusable test automation frameworks.
* Understanding of OpenAPI and AsyncAPI specifications.
* Ability to design and execute structured manual and exploratory tests when required.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a quality-focused mindset.
* Strong English communication skills.
* Experience with React and frontend development.
* Experience with Hibernate or similar persistence frameworks.
* Knowledge of mutual funds, investment funds or financial services.
* Experience with cross-border payments or financial transaction processing.
* Experience working collaboratively across Development, Test, DevOps and Product Management.
* Adaptability, attention to detail and a commitment to continuous learning and automation.


**What We Offer:**
* A dynamic and innovative workplace driving advancements in cutting-edge robotic technologies
* The opportunity to collaborate with talented cross-functional teams on meaningful and impactful projects
* Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package
* A supportive culture that fosters continuous learning, growth, and professional development
* Flexible hybrid working model for an optimal work-life balance
* 25 days of annual leave to recharge and relax
* An annual wellness allowance of 3,500 SEK to support your health and wellbeing

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.
   

  

**Your role** 

 We are now looking for AI Engineers to scale our Data & AI Capabilities within the Engineering Practices of Capgemini. You will be part of a diverse and inclusive team of Data Scientists, Data Engineers and Software Engineers, working on a variety of Client Challenges within the Automotive, Manufacturing, Life Science, Defence and Retail Industries.
   

  

 You will deliver value to Nordic clients through senior-level assignments, contribute to solution design and presales activities, and act as a Subject Matter Expert in Data, AI & ML. Collaboration with other engineering practices to optimize operations is key.
   

  

*In this role you will play a key role in:*
* Lead client projects and provide technical expertise.
* Support presales and solution architecture discussions.
* Represent the organization as a thought leader in Data, AI & ML.
* Collaborate across engineering domains to implement data-driven optimizations.
* Design and own end-to-end AI solutions, from data pipelines to deployment, monitoring, and governance.
* Build and evolve MLOps and CI/CD capabilities for automated model deployment and lifecycle management.
* Define architecture standards and security controls for Generative AI, LLM, and RAG solutions.


**Your profile**
* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, Biology, Engineering, or a related field, with 5+ years of relevant industry experience.
* Strong programming and analytics expertise in Python, R, C++, and statistical data analysis.
* Hands-on experience with SQL, Elasticsearch, Databricks, Snowflake, and large-scale data pipelines using Spark, PySpark, Kafka, and Hadoop.
* Proficiency with ML and AI technologies, including PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and agentic AI frameworks such as LangChain, AutoGen, and OpenAI Agents SDK.
* Deep understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, MCP-based agentic workflows, ETL processes on cloud platforms, and the ability to collaborate effectively with external technology stakeholders.


 We value flexibility to adapt in high-paced working environments. Ability to lead own tasks and coordinate others. Excellent English communication skills, both writing and speaking. We are reviewing candidates continuously and will be flexible to discuss contracts with later start dates. Most of our clients are based in Gothenburg; however, we do have opportunities in other locations. Therefore, we are open to reviewing candidates who are based out of Gothenburg, if they can travel for the needs of their assignments as per client request. Candidates based in Gothenburg will be prioritized.
   

  

*In this recruitment process, we might ask about your current citizenship. This is due to some of our projects being aimed at the military and defence industry. For those openings, a Swedish citizenship is needed. We will also perform an ID-check during the interview phase for all candidates.*
 Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Inom Data och Analys arbetar vi med att bygga, förvalta och vidareutveckla tekniska lösningar åt våra interna kunder. Just nu är vårt fokus att skapa en ny, modern analysplattform som samlar Folksams all analysdata på ett ställe. Det ger våra interna kunder tillgång till kraftfulla verktyg och bättre beslutsstöd.
 



  





 Vi söker nu en erfaren Data Engineer som vill vara med och forma både plattformen och våra arbetssätt. Välkommen till Folksam – där du växer och gör skillnad.
 



  





**Det här gör du som Data Engineer på Folksam** 




 Som Data Engineer hos oss har du en nyckelroll i att forma och optimera hur vi informationsförsörjer med data för analys och rapportering, machine learning och AI. Du arbetar med att extrahera, transformera och vidareförädla data från både strukturerade och ostrukturerade källor – allt för att möjliggöra analyser och värdefulla insikter som driver affärsbeslut.
 



  





 Vår analysplattform byggs i Azure och vilar på Delta Lake-arkitektur, där du får använda de senaste verktygen inom Azure och Databricks. Vi jobbar agilt, och du blir en del av ett drivet Scrumteam där samarbete och innovation står i fokus. Vår analysplattform är relativt ny och vidareutvecklas ständigt vilket gör att du kommer att kunna vara med och påverka dess utformning. Några programmeringsspråk och verktyg som vi använder: Python, SQL, Microsoft Azure, Databricks & Spark, Unity Catalog, Airflow, dbt, GIT, Terraform.
 



  





 Fokus i denna roll ligger främst på data pipelines då du kommer att ingå i det team som är ansvarigt för vårt data pipeline-ramverk även om bredd är väldigt meriterande då vi vill minska beroenden mellan teamen och att vår ambition är att teamen ska kunna ta leveranser från ax till limpa med så få beroenden som möjligt.
 



 Du har nära kontakt med olika intressenter för att förstå deras behov och krav, samt anpassa din kommunikation efter deras tekniska bakgrund.
 



  





 Om du brinner för att arbeta med data och vill vara med och bygga något riktigt spännande, då är det här rätt roll för dig!
 



  





 Nyfiken på att redan nu veta mer om hur det är att jobba hos oss?
 
 Här
 
 kan du läsa en intervju med Emil, kanske är han din nya kollega?
 



  





**Är du den vi söker?** 




 Vi ser att du har:
 


* IT-utbildning inom området eller motsvarande.
* Flerårig erfarenhet av att jobba med data och analys i komplex systemmiljö.
* Flerårig erfarenhet av programmering i Python, datalager och datamodellering.
* Erfarenhet av arbete med data pipelines, orkesteringsverktyg, databashantering.
* Flytande i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.



  





 Du är en noggrann och analytisk person som med nyfikenhet tar dig an nya uppgifter. Vi söker dig som gillar utmaningar och problemlösning, är orädd och som kan lyfta blicken och se helheten. Vi förväntar oss att du självklart är nyfiken på ny teknik, gillar att lösa problem, är innovativ och tänker utanför givna ramar.
 



  





 Du har en förmåga att bidra till en god stämning på arbetsplatsen, med en öppen och tillåtande kultur och är inte rädd för att testa på nya saker. Du har en driftkraft med ditt team att skapa värde för våra interna kunder.
 



  





**Här kan du göra skillnad** 




 Välkommen till Folksam – här driver du viktiga frågor framåt. Från de avgörande detaljerna till de stora perspektiven, med fokus på att förenkla våra kunders vardag. Det gör att du bidrar till något större, oavsett roll. Här finns det många roliga, utvecklande jobb och du har goda chanser till en spännande karriär.
 



  





 Vi tror på ett hållbart arbetsliv och jobbar aktivt med inkludering och mångfald. Våra moderna kontor bjuder in till samarbete och lärande, här får vi saker att hända! Du har flexibiliteten att kunna varva arbete på kontoret med att jobba hemifrån, utifrån verksamhetens behov.
 



 Läs mer och se filmer om livet hos oss på
