title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Avalanche Studios Group is looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our Data and Insights team!
   

  

 This role is responsible for designing, developing and maintaining scalable data pipelines and state-of-the-art data processing technologies. You will play a key role in our Data Engineering team, ensuring that our data infrastructure is reliable, performant, and successfully tied to delivering better data systems for our games and publishing activities. This role requires a deep understanding of data engineering methodologies/frameworks in a big-data environment ; coupled to a strong collaborative spirit.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Develop and implement processes to extract, clean, and transform data from various sources to ensure it is ready for modelling/consumption.
* Collaborate with analytics engineers, data scientists/analysts and product stakeholders to understand their data needs and provide them with reliable data solutions ; capturing a complete ecosystem view of in- and out-of-game user behaviors.
* Architect and implement robust, maintainable, and high-performance ETL/ELT pipelines and data systems ; ensuring accuracy, compliance, scalability, and long-term usability.
* Create and maintain comprehensive data documentation, including data dictionaries, schemas, and metadata. Ensure that data definitions are consistent and easily accessible to all stakeholders.
* Monitor data pipelines and systems to ensure high availability and performance alongside our analytics engineer ; implement automated data quality checks, validation processes and alerts ensuring the accuracy and reliability of data.
* Write efficient, maintainable, and scalable code using best practices. Conduct code and SQL reviews and provide feedback to ensure high standards of code quality within the team.
* Stay updated with the latest trends, technologies, frameworks and best practices in data engineering / analytics / AI and share knowledge with the team.


**Who You Are**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field ; with 8+ years experience in data engineering or a related field.
* Strong proficiency in big-data technologies and languages, such as Python, Spark, Scala, SQL, and Java.Experience with ETL/ELT processes and tools (e.g. Apache Airflow, Talend, DBT… DBT being a big plus).
* Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms (e.g. AWS, GCP, Azure… GCP being a big plus) ; and experience with “Infrastructure as Code” process (e.g. Terraform).
* Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail ; coupled with strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
* Passion for gaming and a deep understanding of the gaming industry is a plus!


 Note: Research shows under-represented groups in the industry might not apply to a job if they don’t check off every requirement. At Avalanche, we’re more about your drive to learn and interest in tackling challenges than what’s on your resume! So don’t stress if you don’t tick every box— shoot us your application anyway! Diverse opinions and different experiences are what make our teams so great, not itemized lists of qualifications.
   

  

**The Stockholm location**
 Our Stockholm office is situated in Södermalm, the beating heart of the city’s game industry. It’s a physical representation of our games – the lush vegetation of Just Cause and theHunter: Call of the Wild meets corroded metal straight out of Mad Max. Our hybrid model requires you to be in the office on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays to foster collaboration and creativity.
   

  

**Our values**
 At Avalanche Studios Group, we create worlds beyond limits. But that’s not exclusive to our games, so we’re committed to developing a diverse and inclusive workplace. All Avalanchers have a shared responsibility to create an open work environment where everyone is treated equally and respectfully. Being part of our world is not contingent on your heritage, your gender, or sexual orientation. It’s all about your passion and creativity.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 To apply for this position, please register below and provide your CV in English. We review applications continuously. All further studio-related information is provided under a non-disclosure agreement.
   

  

 At Avalanche Studios Group we're always on the lookout for talented individuals to join our passionate team, but please note that relocation assistance is not available for this role.

title: Produktägare it-infrastruktur
description:
Är du en tydlig och ansvarstagande ledare med ett stort intresse för teknik? Lockas du av en roll där du leder team till att skapa så mycket värde som möjligt samtidigt som du är med och bidrar till Sveriges säkerhet? Nu har du möjlighet att söka rollen som produktägare it-infrastruktur hos Säkerhetspolisen. Välkommen med din ansökan.
 



  





 Tillsammans skyddar vi Sverige.
 



  





 Ort: Stockholm
 



 Sista ansökningsdag: 2026-10-26
 



  





**Det här är ditt uppdrag** 




 I den här rollen som produktägare it-infrastruktur ligger fokus på att leda teknikteam och att säkerställa en effektiv leverans. Du ansvarar för planering, koordinering och uppföljning i det dagliga arbetet, samt leder mindre uppdrag i samarbete med andra team.
 



  





 Du säkerställer att teamen skapar så mycket nytta och värde som möjligt för verksamheten och till hjälp har du ett nära samarbete med din produktledare (product manager).
 



  





 Du stöttar produktledaren med att utveckla och forma långsiktiga mål och visioner som reflekterar krav och önskemål från hela verksamheten. Din uppgift är att på ett pedagogiskt sätt förmedla dessa mål och visioner till teamen och säkerställa att de får förståelse för var vi är på väg på både kort och lång sikt.
 



  





 Du kommer att arbeta i renodlade teknikteam som har mer fokus på tjänster och fysiska produkter. Här ansvarar du för att teamet arbetar i linje med produktledarens roadmap och strategi. Du driver kravmöten i nära samarbete med verksamheten och teamet för att tillsammans förstå behov.
 



  





 Din placering är på huvudkontoret i Solna och arbetet utförs på plats, vilket innebär att du inte har möjlighet att arbeta på distans. Resor inom Sverige kan förekomma.
 



  





**De här kvalifikationerna söker vi hos dig** 



* Akademisk utbildning inom it, datavetenskap, teknik eller annan arbetslivserfarenhet som Säkerhetspolisen bedömer likvärdig
* Erfarenhet av arbete i rollen som produktägare, teknisk projektledare eller liknande ledande roll
* God förståelse för infrastruktur inom områden som lagring, server och backup
* God förmåga att nätverka, förstå behov och översätta behoven till kravställningar
* Mycket god förmåga att kommunicera på svenska i tal och skrift
* God förmåga att kommunicera på engelska i tal och skrift



  





 Anställningen kräver svenskt medborgarskap.
 



  





 Du som söker kan också ha kompetens som tillför bredd och kompletterande perspektiv. Kan du bidra med något eller flera av följande är det meriterande:
 


* Erfarenhet av arbete i en organisation med höga säkerhetskrav
* Erfarenhet av att arbete på statlig myndighet
* Erfarenhet av agila arbetsmetoder



  





**Det här är kollegan vi söker** 




 Vi fäster stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper och söker dig som är en ansvarstagande och strukturerad lagspelare som trivs i en flexibel och föränderlig miljö.
 



  





 Du har lätt för att samarbeta, skapa goda relationer och du bidrar till ett gott arbetsklimat. Din kommunikativa förmåga är god och du är trygg i att fatta beslut och förankra dem till teamen.
 



  





 Som person är du positiv, lösningsorienterad och ser samarbete, engagemang och gemensamma mål som viktiga delar av att lyckas tillsammans. Du trivs med att vara spindeln i nätet och drivs av att se ditt team lyckas.
 



  





 Säkerhetspolisen ställer höga krav på säkerhet och sekretess, därför förutsätter vi att du har ett högt säkerhetsmedvetande.
 



  





**Anställningsvillkor och förmåner** 




 Anställning vid Säkerhetspolisen innebär inplacering i säkerhetsklass som kräver svenskt medborgarskap. För anställning krävs också godkänt resultat i säkerhetsprövningen med registerkontroll, som genomförs i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagen.
 



  





 Det här är en tillsvidareanställning som inleds med sex månaders provanställning. Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning. Med anställning följer en skyldighet att krigsplaceras.
 



  





 På vår hemsida,
 
 www.sakerhetspolisen.se
 
 , kan du läsa mer om hur det är att arbeta hos oss samt om våra förmåner.
 



  





**Så tar du kontakt med oss** 




 Du är välkommen att ringa ansvarig rekryterare, tfn 070-833 54 41. För information om rekryteringsprocessen, kontakta HR-enheten, tfn 010-568 70 06.
 



  





 Fackliga företrädare: Polisförbundet, tfn 010-568 70 03, SACO, tfn 010-568 70 04 och ST, tfn 010-568 70 02.
 



  





**Så ansöker du** 




 Ansökan sker via vår hemsida,
 
 www.sakerhetspolisen.se
 




 Ansökan ska ha kommit in senast
 **2026-10-26.** 




  





 Ansök genom att bifoga ditt CV (i den här rekryteringsprocessen önskar vi inget personligt brev) och besvara urvalsfrågorna nedan. Frågorna utgår från kravprofilen för den här rekryteringen och dina svar ligger till grund för det urval som sker i processen.
 **Att besvara frågorna är en förutsättning för att din ansökan ska anses komplett.** 
 Det är därför viktigt att du svarar tydligt och utförligt på frågorna och inte hänvisar till andra handlingar t.ex. CV.
 



  





**Vänligen bifoga ett separat dokument (pdf eller word) med svar på urvalsfrågorna nedan som du skickar in i samband med din ansökan.** 




  





**Urvalsfrågor** 
 :
 


1. Har du akademisk utbildning inom it, datavetenskap, teknik eller annan arbetslivserfarenhet som Säkerhetspolisen bedömer likvärdig? Om ja, beskriv din utbildning/erfarenhet.
2. Har du erfarenhet av arbete i rollen som produktägare, teknisk projektledare eller liknande ledande roll? Om ja, beskriv din erfarenhet.
3. Har du god förståelse för infrastruktur inom områden som lagring, server och backup? Om ja, beskriv din erfarenhet.
4. Har du god förmåga att nätverka, förstå behov och översätta behoven till kravställningar? Om ja, beskriv din erfarenhet.
5. Har du mycket god förmåga att kommunicera på svenska i tal och skrift?
6. Har du god förmåga att kommunicera på engelska i tal och skrift?
7. Har du erfarenhet av arbete i en organisation med höga säkerhetskrav? Om ja, beskriv din erfarenhet.
8. Har du erfarenhet av att arbete på statlig myndighet? Om ja, beskriv din erfarenhet.
9. Har du erfarenhet av agila arbetsmetoder? Om ja, beskriv din erfarenhet.



  





 Urval och intervjuer kan ske löpande.
 



  





  





**Övrig information** 




 Du bör inte berätta att du sökt tjänst hos Säkerhetspolisen för andra personer än dina närmast berörda. Det beror på att vi har tjänster som omfattas av sekretess.
 



  





 I våra rekryteringar använder vi arbetspsykologiska tester.
 



  





 Vi har redan gjort våra val av annonskanaler. Vi undanber oss därför samtal från rekryteringsföretag och annonsförsäljare.

title: Senior Application Security Engineer
description:
**Vill du vara med i framkant och skydda vårt samhälle mot cyberhot? Vi söker en Senior Application Security Engineer som vill bli en del av ett passionerat team av cyberspecialister inom vårt Secure Development-område.**
**Om Truesec – ett ledande cybersäkerhetsföretag**
 Sedan 2005 har Truesec varit ett renodlat cybersäkerhetsföretag, drivet av ett tydligt syfte: att skapa trygghet och hållbarhet i en digital värld genom att förebygga cyberintrång och minimera deras påverkan.
   

  

 Genom åren har vi vunnit förtroende hos organisationer världen över och byggt ett starkt internationellt anseende. Vårt team består av engagerade specialister som täcker hela cybersäkerhetsspektrat – med kompetens inom Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond och Recover.
   

  

 Idag är vi omkring 400 medarbetare – och i takt med att cyberbrottsligheten ökar behöver vi också växa. För att stötta den utvecklingen söker vi nu en Senior Application Security Engineer som vill göra verklig skillnad.
   

  

**Secure Development**
 Produkter, applikationer och leveransflöden blir allt oftare måltavlor för hotaktörer, vilket gör säkerhet till en avgörande del i varje steg av modern utveckling. Som en del av Truesecs Secure Development-team hjälper våra specialister inom produkt- och applikationssäkerhet kunder genom tekniskt kodnära stöd, praktiska workshops, utbildning inom säker utveckling och DevSecOps samt längre uppdrag där de blir en integrerad del av team som bygger säkra lösningar från grunden. Med stöd av erfarenhet, egna verktyg och våra tjänster hjälper vi kunder att stärka sitt försvar och säkerställa robusta, framtidssäkra applikationer. Hos oss får du möjlighet att göra verklig skillnad tillsammans med engagerade experter i ett ledande cyber tech-bolag med ett viktigt uppdrag.
   

  

**Rollen**
 Som Senior Application Security Engineer på Truesec kommer du att arbeta nära olika kunder för att stärka deras utvecklingsorganisationer genom skräddarsydda tekniska lösningar. Rollen innebär att identifiera sårbarheter i system, genomföra kodgranskningar och guida kunder i säkra utvecklingsmetoder.
   

  

 Du kommer att analysera kod och arkitektur, ge råd kring hantering av tekniska risker och sårbarheter, leda hotmodelleringssessioner och driva workshops för att höja säkerhetsmedvetenheten. Vi uppmuntrar till kontinuerligt lärande genom löpande utbildning och branschevent, så att du alltid kan ligga i framkant inom cybersäkerhet. Här får du möjlighet att vara med och bygga säkra, motståndskraftiga system – både självständigt och tillsammans med vårt expertteam.
   

  

**Din potentiella bakgrund**
 Applikations- och produktsäkerhet är ett brett område, och vi välkomnar kandidater med olika typer av bakgrund. Tillsammans hjälper vi kunder uppnå relevanta säkerhetskrav genom hela utvecklingskedjan, både för applikationer och fysiska produkter.
   

  

 Du kan till exempel vara en applikationssäkerhetsexpert med erfarenhet av hotmodellering, sårbarhetsbedömningar, kodgranskning och säker mjukvaruutveckling.Kanske är du utvecklare med ett starkt säkerhetsintresse och kunskap inom säker kod, inputvalidering, accesskontroll, molnsäkerhet eller kryptografi.
   

  

 Om du är penetrationstestare med kodintresse ser vi mycket positivt på din förmåga att identifiera och exploatera sårbarheter för att tydliggöra deras affärspåverkan. Har du även erfarenhet av utveckling av inbyggda system ser vi positivt på kunskaper inom hårdvarusäkerhet och analys av säkerhetsrisker i hårdvaruplattformar. Vi ser gärna att du har god kunskap i både engelska och svenska i skrift och tal.
   

  

**Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av**
* Säker utveckling och DevSecOps
* Mjukvaruarkitektur och design
* Programmeringskunskaper i ett eller flera språk, till exempel Java, C#, C/C++, Python, JavaScript, Rust eller Go


**Meriterande erfarenhet**
* Kryptografi, autentisering och auktorisering
* Distribuerade system, Linux, Docker, Kubernetes
* Molnplattformar (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Hotmodellering och säkerhetsbedömningar
* Säker användning av agentisk AI
* OAuth 2, OpenID Connect, JWT och liknande autentiserings- och auktoriseringsmetoder
* Verktyg för automatiserad sårbarhetsidentifiering
* Penetrationstestning
* Hårdvarusäkerhet och analys av säkerhetsrisker i hårdvaruplattformar
* Sårbarhetshantering
* Produktsäkerhetsstandarder och regleringar (till exempel Cyber Resilience Act, CRA)


 På grund av uppdragens känsliga karaktär behöver du ha svenskt medborgarskap, medborgarskap i ett EU-land eller ett giltigt svenskt arbetstillstånd.
   

  

**Bli en del av vår resa mot en säkrare digital framtid**
 Om du verkligen vill göra skillnad och bidra till att göra världen lite säkrare, då är det här rätt plats för dig. På Truesec får du vara med i frontlinjen i kampen mot cyberbrottslighet i stället för att bara läsa om den i nyheterna. Det här är din chans att bli en del av en spännande resa i ett ledande cybersäkerhetsföretag – och att lära av några av de främsta inom sitt område.
   

  

 Så, är du redo att teama upp med ett av de mest engagerade expertteamen och bli en del av ett meningsfullt uppdrag? Då ser vi fram emot att lära känna dig!

title: Senior Fullstack Developer (Python/React)
description:
**A Different Kind Of Job Description**
 At Filed, we believe in radical transparency. Everything is open: company finances, team salaries, stock options, anonymous team feedback. That extends to how we talk about this job, so what you'll read here looks a little different from other job ads. It starts with why this is a terrible job. Then it explains why it might be the best career move you'll ever make.
   

  

**Why this is a terrible job**
 This is an incredibly high-paced, high-tempo environment. We're making a generational bet to change all of our lives, and generational bets are not comfortable.
   

  

 You will build agents for subjective workflows. Tax law is objective, but what applies under it and how professionals interpret it is full of judgment. You can give two tax professionals the same task and get two different results where both are right. We're building agentic systems that have to reach their level of accuracy, not a level we decided is good enough. From an engineering standpoint, this is the hardest thing most of us have ever built. At times it will feel like hitting your head against the wall.
   

  

 Customers will sometimes get frustrated, because they expect deterministic results from probabilistic systems, and we're managing the expectations of some of the biggest firms in the world, including the Big Four.
   

  

 And the rhythm is real: we get to the office, we work, we go home and spend time with our families, and then many of us get back online to support our customers in US hours. It's tough. It's relentless.
   

  

**Why it might be the best career choice you'll ever make**
 It's addictive to be part of a business when you know you're winning. Filed is adding millions of dollars of revenue every quarter, customers are signing up in numbers, and in under two years we've become the market leader in a space with entrenched incumbents and a drastic need for new AI tools. When we come into head-to-heads with competitors, we win every time, because our product is superior. And we stay focused and diligent: we only work with tax firms that have the right expectations, which is why our typical customer is mid-market and enterprise.
   

  

 The industry looks boring from the outside, but the problem is unsolved, and the space has been riddled with products below the mark for decades. When you push through the wall, there's a spark of joy: a customer says "wow, this is phenomenal." That keeps happening.
   

  

 The opportunity here is not only to make a great deal of money. It's to have real impact on our mission: making this profession extraordinary. Nobody became a tax professional for the admin. They got into this work to be creative with tax law, to have fun, and to change the fabric of society. Filed enables them to do exactly that.
   

  

 We've raised $17.2 million to date, led by Northzone, and you can read the story in TechCrunch. Our focus now is to deliver the roadmap and continue to win.
   

  

**What You'll Build**
 As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you'll build the product surface and the platform underneath it:
   

  

* The workflows tax professionals live in every day, from document intake through review to delivery
* Deep integrations with the tax software firms already use, so Filed works where they work
* The pipelines that move documents, data, and returns reliably at scale, through the most intense weeks of tax season


 You'll ship across the stack, own features end to end, and see your work in front of some of the most demanding professional users in the world within days, not quarters.
   

  

**What You'll Be Responsible For**
* Building and maintaining fullstack features across our AI tax prep, planning, and review products
* Owning the UX and backend logic for the workflows tax professionals use every day
* Shipping fast, watching metrics, and deciding what to improve next, without being told
* Learning about LLMs and making them work for our customers to achieve higher accuracy and transparency
* Keeping the codebase clean, typed, and fast as we scale


**Your Hard Skillset**
* Comfortable in TypeScript, React, and Python: you've built complex, data-heavy UIs and backend services before
* Familiar with cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud and/or Azure
* Bonus if you've worked in fast-paced startups or regulated industries
* Even bigger bonus if you've taken a product from 0 to 1 and watched real users depend on it


**Your Soft Skillset**
* Comfortable being uncomfortable and making calls with incomplete data
* Empathetic and curious: building for the user, not just for clean code
* Highly collaborative across product, engineering, and tax
* Detail-oriented but pragmatic: you know when polish matters and when to ship
* You own your work and welcome the accountability that comes with it


**A championship team**
 We think of ourselves as a sports team. Incredibly high performance, incredibly high standards, and real success to show for it. Being a championship team means working with people who are deeply proud of the work they do and have great fun doing it together.
   

  

 We measure employee happiness constantly, and our eNPS is +60. We don't say that to brag. We say it because a team playing at this tempo only holds together if people genuinely love being on it. Every four months, the whole company comes together for an offsite.
   

  

**What Filed Stands For**
 Not posters. Not corporate language. Real operating standards.
   

  

* No problem is someone else's problem If you see it, it's yours. Bugs, customer confusion, missed expectations, internal friction. We don't pass problems sideways and we don't hide behind roles. You fix the typo even if you didn't write it, jump into a customer issue even if it's not your department, escalate early, and close loops fully. Ownership means you drive resolution, not that you suffer silently or burn out doing everything alone.
* Waiting is not a strategy Momentum is our advantage. We don't wait for perfect information or stall because something is unclear. You ship a V1 instead of debating V5, test instead of theorize, run small experiments instead of requesting big approvals, and propose solutions instead of just naming blockers. Speed is powerful. Sloppiness is not, and recklessness has no place in a high-trust industry.
* We run toward the fire When something breaks, we move. Tax is high-stakes and trust is fragile. We acknowledge issues immediately, communicate clearly and often, prioritize customer-impacting problems fast, and stay on it until it's fully resolved. Firefighting is a strength, not panic, and never an excuse for preventable mistakes.
* We win on customer experience AI will commoditize. Features will copy. Pricing will compress. Experience won't. We respond faster than customers expect, communicate proactively, think like a partner rather than a ticketing system, and anticipate needs before they're raised. Overdelivering means raising the standard of care, not overpromising, hero culture, or burning the team out.


**Who This Suits**
 This is a very fun environment, but it only suits people who meet the criteria we're looking for:
   

  

* People who want to win
* People who have a point to prove
* People who want to write their own job descriptions


**How We Pay**
 Nothing at Filed is behind closed doors. Everyone here sees everyone else's salary, because we believe transparency creates trust, and trust is the foundation of excellent teamwork. Compensation isn't a negotiation. Depending on your location, everyone receives the same three offers, and all of our offers are above market benchmarking.
   

  

 This role is assessed at Level 4 (Senior). The salary and equity bandings are:
   

  

* Most Equity: 82,500 SEK per month + $180,000 of equity
* Great Equity: 90,000 SEK per month + $120,000 of equity
* Good Equity: 97,500 SEK per month + $60,000 of equity


 We run performance reviews every four months. Meet your goals and you can expect to double your equity by the end of your first year.
   

  

 One more thing, in the spirit of transparency: some people who apply for this role will be assessed at a different level. If the team determines your level of responsibility sits differently, we'll adjust the offer accordingly. If you're earlier in your journey than this role expects, that's not a problem. Apply to the Fullstack Engineer role instead.
   

  

**Benefits**
* A minimum of 30 days of holiday per year, whether you're in Europe or the US
* In the US: fully covered medical expenses on platinum-level plans, with 100% coverage for your dependents as well
* In Europe: the full set of mandatory benefits, and more on top
* Company-wide offsites every four months


**The process**
* Quick intro call (30 minutes)
* Technical walkthrough and async task (60 minutes)
* Final round with our team (120 minutes)


 In just 3.5 hours, you'll be wanting early access, just like the rest of our team, to get into the stack and start building a generational company, even before your first day.
   

  

**About Filed**
**Filed is the AI tax preparer trusted by America's accounting firms.**
 Taxes might seem boring, but they are the $5 trillion backbone of the US economy. Globally, nearly $15 trillion in taxes is collected every year. Behind every dollar of it sits a professional making judgment calls, and the industry that does this work is breaking under a talent shortage no one has solved. We're fixing it. Today, hundreds of firms run Filed inside the systems they already use, and we're backed by Northzone, Neo, Analog, and Raine.
   

  

 There has never been a more exciting time to work on a problem this complex. Join us while "I was there when it all started" is still true.

title: Founding Engineer (Forward-Deployed)
description:
**About Skeptical** 




 Most AI in production automates very little, whether the model is a custom classifier or a frontier LLM. A model makes a suggestion, a person checks it, and the queue is as long as it was before, because nobody can state when and how often the prediction is wrong. Skeptical addresses this. A team sets the error rate it is willing to accept. Skeptical's software then clears every decision that falls within it, automatically and in real time, and routes the remainder to human review. The error rate among cleared decisions, measured against the reviewers' decisions, stays at or below the chosen level, with a statistical guarantee. The approach requires no retraining and no changes to the customer's pipeline.
 



  





 We are a team out of KTH Royal Institute of Technology, and we are growing fast. The method comes from our own peer-reviewed, award-winning research. The hard part is making it hold in production, on real data, on live traffic, for years. 
 



  





**The role** 




 Help build the product and deploy it with our first customers. The role is split between infrastructure and time spent with design partners, understanding how their review queues work and getting them cleared.
 



  





**What you will do** 




 You will help build the core of the product: a service that takes a customer's AI predictions and error budget and returns, for each prediction, whether it clears or goes to review. Around it, the data pipelines that bring scores and review outcomes in, the recalibration and drift monitoring that keep the guarantee valid over time, and the interfaces customers work in.
 



  





 You will then deploy it inside design partner environments, in domains such as insurance claims, credit decisions, and aviation safety, and stay close while they use it. You will take ownership of the deployment and resolve the problems that appear in their systems together with the customer, and what you learn there feeds back into the product. You will work in a small team, with real ownership of what you build and how. Our aim is to build something we are proud of, and that requires people who want to be responsible for their part of it. 
 



  





**What we are looking for** 




 You have run a production system that other people depended on, and you know what that requires. You have deployed machine learning models in practice, whether classifiers and scoring pipelines or model-driven workflows with several steps, and you know what it takes to keep them running. You can read a paper on uncertainty quantification and turn it into working code, and you are comfortable deciding what to do next without being told.
 



  





 You are fluent in Python and SQL, and you have shipped production code in at least one statically typed language. You are at home with containers and at least one cloud, and you have built data pipelines that other services depended on.
 



  





 If you have wondered why models keep getting smarter while the pipelines that matter still require a person to check every output, you are probably the person we are looking for. Our answer is that AI has gotten smarter, but it has not become more trustworthy. We are building the layer that changes that, and we would like to work with people who think the question was worth asking.
 



  





**What we offer** 




 A founding title and the equity that comes with it. Ownership of a whole product surface rather than a component of one. A seat in every customer conversation that matters, and a real say in what the product becomes. Founders who have built production systems that the industry runs on, and who will work alongside you. A desk in central Stockholm and colleagues in the same room most days
 **.** 




  





**How to apply** 




 Tell us what you would do here and why you are the right person to help us solve this problem.
 
 Apply at skeptical.io/careers

You will take ownership of our compliance framework across NIS2, IT General Controls (ITGC), and ISO/IEC 27001:2022, ensuring that our policies, controls, and processes are not only compliant - but effective, scalable and aligned with our business goals.
   

  

**You Will Also**
* Design and operate an integrated compliance program that enables risk-based reporting to leadership and external stakeholders.
* Ensure our controls are well-designed, implemented, and operating effectively — with clear evidence and audit readiness.
* Coordinate internal and external audits and act as a trusted point of contact for auditors and regulators.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, Procurement, Finance, HR, and product/solution owners to translate standards into practical, business-friendly controls.
* Ensure ITGC governance is followed across key stakeholders, and coordinate control execution, evidence collection, and remediation tracking.
* Support OT Security in aligning NIS2 and ISO requirements with operational technology policies and roles.
* Deliver quarterly dashboards and insights to the IT Leadership Team and Group Leadership Team, supporting strategic decision-making.


**Who are we looking for?**
 To succeed in this role, you need to be based in the greater Stockholm area, as close collaboration with teams and stakeholders on-site is an important part of the role. We are looking for someone who thrives in a structured environment but knows how to navigate complexity. You bring a pragmatic approach to problem-solving, with a sharp eye for detail and a strong sense of structure. Your deep technical knowledge is matched by your ability to communicate clearly and concisely, whether you are presenting to leadership, collaborating with external auditors, or aligning with internal stakeholders. You build trust across departments, foster collaboration, and know how to turn regulatory frameworks into practical, business-friendly solutions that support both compliance and innovation.
   

  

* A university degree or equivalent experience.
* 7+ years of experience in information security, IT audit/assurance, or risk with at least 3 years leading compliance or assurance programs.
* Expertise in ISMS design and operation, ITGC domains, and control mapping.
* Bonus points for certifications such as ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, CISA, CISM, or CRISC.


**We Offer You**
 We are a modern, customer-oriented company that cares as much about our employees as we do about our customers. With us, you are offered a varied job in an international environment with constant new challenges and quick decisions. In addition to fair employment conditions according to collective agreements, we offer you:
   

  

* Flexible hybrid workplace. Watch the film about our office.
* Great development opportunities
* Great insurance and occupational pension terms
* Wellness allowance & opportunity to train at Arken's gym and indoor swimming pool
* Employee benefits through PostNord Plus - PostNord´s own personnel foundation


**About Us**
 PostNord is the leading supplier of communication and logistics solutions to, from, and within the Nordic region. We ensure the provision of a postal service to households and businesses in Sweden and Denmark. We aim to make everyday life easier and more sustainable for everyone who lives and works in the Nordic region. We are in a constant transformation and work consistently to develop both our offer and our employees, all to achieve our vision of being The favourite carrier of the Nordics. We are PostNord - a fantastic company to work and grow with. Read more at group.postnord.com
   

  

**Apply**
 Welcome to submit your application! The selection is ongoing, so please apply as soon as possible. If you have any questions or concerns, please email erkan.kahraman@postnord.com.
   

  

 We look forward to hearing from you!
   

  

 For union representatives, visit: www.postnord.com/fackliga

title: Project Manager - Facility Management
description:
**Own the delivery of EG MainManager, the Nordic region's leading property management solution, as we build our presence in Sweden.**
*Do you want to own projects from first customer conversation through to delivery, and be trusted to shape how we work along the way?*
*Are you energised by complex projects, close customer relationships, and a deep interest in the property industry?*
*Then you might be our new Project Manager for EG MainManager in Sweden.*
**About The Role**
 We're building our presence with EG MainManager, the Nordic region's leading property management solution, in the Swedish market - and we're looking for an experienced, driven Project Manager to play a central role in shaping that success. This isn't a role where you follow a path someone else has laid out. You're involved from sale to delivery and handover, and you own your projects from start to finish.
   

  

 You'll work closely with customers in property management, and beyond the project manager role, you'll often take on the role of functional solution architect and process expert - guiding customers toward better ways of working, challenging and advising them, not just delivering a system. You'll collaborate closely with our solution and technical experts to make sure customers get the best property management solution on the market.
   

  

 As one of the first people on board in this venture, you'll help build the working methods and delivery model that lay the foundation for continued growth in the Swedish market.
   

  

 The role is based in our Stockholm office, in a hybrid setup - though being in the office regularly matters to us, especially while we build this team and this market from the ground up.
   

  

**From Sale to Delivery**
* Project management, start to finish - Take part in the sales process with project insight from an early stage, then lead implementation projects end to end: planning, resourcing, timeline, budget and risk. You're the customer's main point of contact throughout, managing expectations, scope and any deviations. You identify and manage project risks, escalating when needed, and you run status meetings and steering committees, documenting decisions and deliverables.
* Functional solution architecture - Run needs analyses together with customers and translates them into concrete solutions in the system, guiding customers toward better, more efficient property management processes. You work closely with technical experts and development resources to ensure the right delivery, and feed real customer needs back to the product team.
* Building the delivery model - Help establish and improve implementation methodology, templates and best practice for the Swedish market. Document learnings from the first projects to create a repeatable, scalable process for future project managers and consultants to build on.
* Customer relationships - Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers during and after implementation, ensure a smooth handover to ongoing support, and act as an ambassador for the solution - helping build reference customers in Sweden.


**What You Bring**
 We care more about what you can do than what your CV looks like. You have a solid track record as a project manager, ideally from real estate, PropTech, ERP or similar business systems. You're motivated by complex, challenging projects, and you thrive in environments where you get to take ownership of a role that isn't fully defined yet.
   

  

* Proven experience leading complex projects end to end, ideally within real estate, PropTech, ERP or similar business systems
* Motivated, ambitious and self-driven - you take initiative and push projects and processes forward without waiting to be asked
* Natural leadership qualities - you take the lead with customers and internal stakeholders alike, even without formal authority over the people around you
* Structured, with a methodical approach and the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in parallel
* A clear, confident communicator - with customers at every level, and internally across the organisation
* Solution-oriented - you combine a helicopter view of project governance with the readiness to dig into detail when it matters
* Curious, with a good understanding of how organisations work, so you can navigate stakeholders and decisions on both the customer's side and EG's
* Hands-on experience using AI as a natural part of how you work and deliver projects
* Fluent in Swedish and English, spoken and written, and confident in customer meetings at every level


**What's in it for you?**
 At EG, you'll join an ambitious environment with a fast pace and real opportunities for professional and personal development, as a key person in a venture that genuinely matters - where your work has a direct impact on our position in the Swedish market.
   

  

**Real ownership -** 
 You own your projects end-to-end, from the sales process through delivery and handover, with genuine autonomy as one of the first people building this market.
   

  

**Meaningful impact -** 
 Your work has a direct, visible effect on EG's position in the Swedish property management market - from day one.
   

  

**Growth mandate -** 
 You help define the working methods, templates and delivery model that future project managers and consultants in Sweden will build on.
   

  

**AI-enabled leadership -** 
 You'll help shape how AI becomes a natural part of how we run projects and support customers - not as an add-on, but as part of how the team works.
   

  

**Collaborative culture -** 
 Close collaboration with our solution and technical experts and the product team, in a Nordic culture built on trust, openness and no politics.
   

  

**Our Values**
* Lead the Industry - We don't just serve our industries - we lead them. We bring deep expertise, set new standards, and help our customers stay ahead.
* Make it Happen - We take ownership, move fast, and deliver real impact. When we say we'll do something, it gets done - no excuses, no politics.
* Stronger Together - We are a global team shaped by Scandinavian values. The best software - and the best teams - are built on trust, openness, and collaboration across borders.


**We Look Forward to Hearing From You!**
 If you would like more information before you apply, please contact Director, Andreas Sinding-Larsen on +47 917 62 838. We evaluate applications on an ongoing basis and recruit when the right candidate is found, so please send your CV and application as soon as possible. All inquiries are handled confidentially.
   

  

**At EG, we build software that makes a difference.**
 Our industry-specific software help people and businesses work smarter every day. From doctors spending more time with patients to builders running safer, more efficient projects.
   

  

 Our software is built by peers from the industry and backed by EG's scale for stability, innovation, and security.
   

  

 If you're ambitious, curious, and take pride in ownership, you'll thrive here. You'll be trusted to grow your skills, shape meaningful solutions, and make an impact together with talented colleagues across borders.
   

  

 Join us in creating software that works for people - not software that makes people work.
   

  

 Curious what it's really like to work at EG? Explore life at EG, meet some of your future colleagues, and see our values in action: Working at EG
   

  

 See all our open positions here
   

  

 Learn more about EG here

title: Systemförvaltare med bakgrund inom vården till Digitala tjänster
description:
Nu behöver vi dig som är en erfaren medicinsk sekreterare eller undersköterska med goda kunskaper inom journalhantering, för ett spännande jobb som ger nytta för hela Region Stockholm. Sök redan idag!
   

  





****Om oss****




 Stockholms läns sjukvårdsområde (SLSO) är en del av Region Stockholm och tjänsten är placerad på SLSO på avdelning verksamhetsstöd Digitala tjänster, enheten Förvaltning och Support. 
   

  





****Vi erbjuder dig****




 Ett utvecklande och spännande arbete i en stor organisation. Goda möjligheter till personlig och professionell utveckling. Möjlighet att göra skillnad inom hälso- och sjukvården.
   

  





 Som medarbetare hos oss får du ta del av Region Stockholms förmånspaket där till exempel friskvårdstimme och friskvårdsersättning ingår. Möjlighet ges att arbeta hemma vissa dagar. 
   

  





 Förmåner hos Stockholms läns sjukvårdsområde
   

  





****Arbetsuppgifter****




 Du kommer primärt och initialt att arbeta med spärrhantering och loggutdrag i huvudjournalen TakeCare. Att lägga och häva spärra i patienters journaler samt att på patienters önskan ta ut loggutdrag ur TakeCare. I arbetet ingår också telefonkontakt med patienter som behöver hjälp att förstå hur systemet fungerar.
   

  





 Andra linjens support för TakeCare och andra system kan också bli aktuellt.
   

  





****Kvalifikationer****



* Vi söker dig som har utbildning och erfarenhet som medicinsk sekreterare eller undersköterska eller annan utbildning och erfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer relevant.
* Du har erfarenhet av lokal systemförvaltning och arbete i Region Stockholm.
* Erfarenhet inom roll som lokal systemförvaltare LSA eller likande.
* Gedigen erfarenhet av journalsystemet TakeCare
* Erfaren av patientkontakt, hantering av patienter med särskilda behov, även via telefon
* Kunnig i svenska, presentationsteknik och Office 365



 Meriterande:
 


* Kännedom om andra vårdstödjande system och digitala verktyg samt verksamhetskunskap och förståelse för hur en vårdorganisation i stort fungerar.
* Erfarenhet av journalsystemet Cambio Cosmic.
* Erfarenhet av arbete inom Stockholms läns sjukvårdsområde, SLSO
* Kunskaper inom informations- och IT-säkerhet.



**Personliga egenskaper**




 Vi söker dig som är du kommunikativ och van att samarbeta med både IT och verksamhet. Du är ansvarstagande, drivande och självgående med förmåga att prioritera komplexa uppgifter. Rollen kräver att du är lösningsfokuserad, flexibel och trivs i miljöer med höga kvalitetskrav och snabba leveranser. Som person är du nyfiken, engagerad och motiverad person som gärna tar en naturlig ledarroll.  Du är lugn och trygg och har erfarenhet av patientkontakt och vana att prata i telefon.
   

  





****Mer information och ansökan****




 Tillsvidareanställning, heltid. Vi kommer löpande att kalla till intervju under ansökningstiden. Sista ansökningsdag
 **18 oktober 2026**




 Välkommen med din ansökan!
   

  





 Tjänsten tillsätts under förutsättning att den inte behöver tas i anspråk för intern omplacering, enligt gällande regelverk.
   

  





**Vid patientnära arbete inom Stockholms läns sjukvårdsområde:**




  

 - tillämpas registerkontroll före beslut om anställning enligt SLSO:s övergripande anvisning för registerkontroll vid anställning.
   

  





  

 - ska medarbetare som kommer att ha patientkontakt genomgå nyanställningsundersökning, enligt gällande direktiv, vilket sker genom företagshälsovården innan anställning.
   

  





  

 - krävs, förutom svensk yrkeslegitimation, goda kunskaper i svenska språket motsvarande nivå C1 enligt den gemensamma europeiska referensramen (GERS). Samma krav är vägledande vad gäller icke-legitimerad personal med patientkontakt.
   

  





**Stockholms läns sjukvårdsområde (SLSO) är en av Sveriges största vårdgivare med 11 600 medarbetare. Vi erbjuder hälso- och sjukvård i Region Stockholms regi inom psykiatri, primärvård, geriatrik, ASIH, närakuter, somatisk specialistvård, habilitering och hälsa samt hjälpmedel. I samverkan med Karolinska Institutet bedriver vi forskning, utbildning och utveckling. Läs mer om SLSO här.**




****Att söka jobb i Region Stockholm****




 Vi eftersträvar jämställdhet och jämlikhet på vår arbetsplats och ser gärna sökande med olika bakgrund och förutsättningar.
   

  





 Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via detta system. Ansök genom att klicka på knappen ”Ansök”. Ansökningar per brev eller e-post beaktas inte. Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt säljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.
   

  





 Vårt rekryteringssystem kan inte hantera anonyma ansökningar eller sökande med skyddade personuppgifter. Om du har skyddade personuppgifter ber vi dig att kontakta den kontaktpersonen som finns angiven i annonsen. Din ansökan kommer då att hanteras utanför rekryteringssystemet. Du bör även vara försiktig med vilken information du lämnar i din ansökan och endast ta med information som är relevant för den aktuella befattningen.
   

  





 Region Stockholm ansvarar för hälso- och sjukvård, kollektivtrafik, regional utveckling och bidrar till kulturlivet. Varje dag, dygnet runt. I landets snabbaste växande region. Tillsammans skapar vi Europas attraktivaste storstadsregion.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**About Froda** 




 Founded in 2015, Froda’s mission is to democratize access to financing, giving small businesses the same growth opportunities as large ones. Through digital innovation, we’ve transformed the loan process from months to minutes, offering fair, fast, and accessible financing. Now, through embedded lending, we’re integrating our technology with global banks and fintechs, building the next generation of lending infrastructure. Join us in creating opportunities for small businesses to invest in their ideas to the best possible terms.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 As an Engineering Manager at Froda, you will lead 2–3 cross-functional product teams and ensure we deliver value clearly, predictably, and with high quality. Working closely with Product Managers and Tech Leads, you will create focus, remove obstacles, and build strong teams that can move fast while maintaining a healthy and reliable platform, working iteratively to ship, learn, and continuously improve our products and systems.
 



 Through close collaboration with your teams, you will help shape the technical direction of the areas you lead, connecting business needs with sustainable engineering decisions and ensuring we continuously improve how we build, ship, and learn from what we deliver.
 



  





**In this role, you will:** 



* Drive delivery across multiple teams by improving how teams plan, execute, and follow up on their work, ensuring priorities and commitments are realistic and aligned with business goals while supporting iterative delivery and continuous learning
* Identify and manage risks, dependencies, and capacity challenges early
* Support a healthy balance between product delivery and technical improvements
* Coach and develop engineers while fostering a sustainable and high-performing team environment
* Build strong cross-functional relationships across Product, Tech, Commercial, and Partnerships



  





**This role offers the opportunity to have a real impact on how teams collaborate, deliver, and evolve our platform at a fintech company with strong momentum and a stable foundation, backed by a banking license as a quality stamp.** 




**Who are you?** 




 We believe you are an engineering leader who thrives in dynamic, fast-moving environments. You enjoy creating clarity in complexity and building teams that deliver value continuously while improving how they work.
 



 You are confident in stakeholder dialogue, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and proactive in driving improvements rather than waiting for direction. You lead with calmness, ownership, and a strong sense of accountability.
 



 You are fluent in English, Swedish is a plus.
 



  





**We believe you have experience with:** 



* Leading engineering teams in a product-focused tech organization
* Driving delivery, planning, and execution across teams with a focus on predictability and quality
* A solid technical background that allows you to understand architectural trade-offs and engineering challenges
* Coaching and developing engineers through continuous feedback and performance follow-up
* Working closely with Product Managers and Tech Leads to balance scope, risk, and long-term improvements
* Improving development processes, ways of working, and engineering practices
* Navigating cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management



  





**What’s in it for you?** 




 At Froda, you’ll be part of a company that combines the best of both worlds – a fast-moving, high-energy culture with the stability and structure to support long-term success. We’re 100+ ambitious self-starters who genuinely care for each other and the work we do, all while having fun together.
 



 Here, you’ll have the opportunity to shape how we execute and scale engineering, influence both delivery and long-term platform evolution, and build high-performing teams with real ownership. With big ambitions and a rapidly evolving business, there’s plenty of room to grow, take initiative, and make a lasting impact on both our company and the industry.
 



  





**Furthermore, you’ll get:** 



* An opportunity to play a key role in scaling a fintech platform that powers funding for thousands of entrepreneurs
* A central leadership position in our tech organization, with real influence on how we work and deliver
* Fabulous office overlooking Stockholm
* We prioritize working in the office to maximize the positive impact of in-person collaboration, but we offer flexibility with work hours and remote work
* Competitive compensation package
* Insurance and pension plan



  





**This role is all about building the teams and execution that power funding for thousands of entrepreneurs, if you're excited by our mission, apply or tell a friend!**

title: Senior Test Manager – Next Generation Assortment Planning (NGAP)
description:
**About The Role**
 We are looking for a Senior Test Manager a strategic initiative within Next Generation Assortment Planning (NGAP)for one of our clients. You will develop and manage the overall test strategy and test plan, and make sure test activities are carried out effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
   

  

 You will work closely with the business, the IT organization and external vendors to ensure high quality and controlled risk before go-live.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
* Develop and manage the test strategy and test plan
* Plan and coordinate test activities between operations, IT and external suppliers
* Lead and support the project's testers and other participants in the testing work
* Lead system, integration and acceptance tests
* Ensure that test cases and acceptance criteria cover requirements, business processes and prioritized use cases
* Secure access to test data and test environments
* Own defect management, risk follow-up and quality reporting
* Report status and risks to project management
* Contribute to decision-making ahead of production launch


**Who you are**
 You are structured and methodical, independent and driven. You communicate clearly and are comfortable raising quality risks and challenges, even when they are unwelcome. You are collaborative and non-prestige, and you are used to building consensus between operations and IT.
   

  

**Requirements**
* At least 9 years of experience as a test manager
* Documented experience planning and leading test work across multiple test phases
* Experience with complex solutions with many integrations and dependencies

title: Project Manager – Global Time & Attendance & Absence System
description:
*Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact – on our colleagues, partners, customers and society. Together, we’re pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water and shipping.*
*As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.*
*Are you ready to drive innovation across regions?*
**About The Job**
 Alfa Laval is on the journey of a step-wise rolling out of Shared Services within the group. We have today 6 HR Shared Service Centers, spread across the globe, working with HR-related matters and providing the foundation for developing the HR related support for our employees. To support this strategic direction we are implementing a global Time, Attendance and Absence management system across our international matrix organization.
   

  

 We are now seeking an experienced Global Project Manager to lead the implementation of a system - a collaborative professional who thrives in change and wants to make a real impact across our global HR community.
   

  

 This is a complex global transformation requiring alignment across regions, business units and functions with different operational practices, regulatory obligations, collective agreements, payroll requirements and levels of technology maturity. The successful candidate will balance global standardization with justified local requirements while managing dependencies across HR, IT, payroll, finance, procurement, data privacy and local operations.
   

  

 You will establish the programme’s governance, requirements and implementation approach; coordinate system selection, process design, integrations, data migration, testing and regional deployment; and drive stakeholder alignment, change management and adoption. A central challenge will be navigating distributed decision-making and reconciling competing global, regional and local priorities without compromising compliance, payroll accuracy or operational continuity.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Participate in the RFP process and vendor selection process
* Drive end-to-end project delivery for global HR systems
* Collaborating with international teams and vendors
* Ensure seamless integration and compliance
* Manage timelines, budgets, and stakeholder expectations
* Report to steering committee when applicable
* Develop and drive Change Management plans throughout the project
* Have the authority to make decisions and manage the allocated resources, within given frame and budget
* You will manage very large project with high complexity or business impact, in accordance with Alfa Laval’s project methodology to reach desired outcome.


**What We’re Looking For**
* Proven leadership of complex, multi-country HR technology implementations
* Strong programme and project governance capabilities
* Proven experience in driving cross-functional HR System implementation project in a dynamic and global context, preferably from Time & Attendance & Absence system
* Ability to operate effectively within an international matrix organization
* Experience aligning global standards with country-specific legal and operational requirements
* Strong stakeholder management across HR, IT, payroll, vendors and business leadership
* A disciplined approach to risk, dependencies, data, testing, change and deployment
* Strong communication and leadership skills; decision-making will be key
* Ability to work across cultures and regions
* Relevant degree and certifications (PMP preferred)


**Why Join Us?**
* Work on impactful, global projects
* Be part of a diverse, international team
* Competitive compensation, benefits and future development opportunities


 Ready to make a difference? Apply now and help shape the future of our global HR operations!
   

  

**For more information, please contact**
 Haraldur Gudjonsson, Transformation Lead HR Shared Services at Haraldur.Gudjonsson@alfalaval.com
   

  

 or Frederik Ellegaard, Talent Acquisition Manager at frederik.ellegaard@alfalaval.com

 Johan Ranhög, Akademikerna, johan.ranhog@alfalaval.com
   

  

 Monica Anderberg, Unionen, monica.anderberg@alfalaval.com
   

  

 Stefan Sandell, Ledarna, stefan.sandell@alfalaval.com

 Please send your application no later than

 At Alfa Laval, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive and dynamic workplace that values diverse perspectives and experiences. While we typically welcome applicants from all locations, but for this particular role, we are prioritizing candidates who are currently residing in

 Du kommer att ansvara för och leda ett av delprojekten inom det lokala införandeprojektet samt stötta övriga delar av programmet vid behov. Rollen omfattar koordinering av analyser kopplade till arbetssätt och kliniska flöden, samordning av verksamhetens behov samt strukturering av dokumentation tillsammans med lokal förvaltning och berörda verksamheter.

title: Senior Product Manager, Data / ML
description:
Mentimeter is an engagement tool with a clear goal in mind. To make every leader better. Through real-time interactivity and clear visualizations, we get people to participate, engage and become more productive. Transforming all those passive meetings, airless classrooms and drawn out trainings into valuable insights and impactful moments.
   

  

 We truly believe that you achieve the best results by doing things together. And that successful leaders need to adopt a curious and collaborative mindset in order to get there. So with you at Mentimeter, you’ll be a big part of the ambition to help over 1 billion people listen, learn and work better together.
   

  

**About The Role**
 AI is changing how people create and consume content, and the Insights product area is where Mentimeter turns that shift into an advantage rather than something we retrofit later. It's the area that decides what every one of our users sees, learns and does next, to turn data into something valuable enough to come back for, and in turn drive retention and expansion for our business.
   

  

 As Senior Product Manager, Data / ML, you'll own the data and ML depth of Insights: the intelligence that turns every interaction into sharper results, insights and recommendations, pulls in context from inside and outside Mentimeter, and gets better the more it's used. With 300 million users' worth of interaction data behind it, the mandate is to turn that into a defensible asset. The data and ML is the means; a system that drives measurable outcomes for users and the business is the end.
   

  

 This is a senior, hands-on role with a clear mandate. You'll report to the Product Director of Insights: the Director owns the area's place in company strategy and its org shape, while you own the data and ML depth that delivers it. You'll work alongside the other product managers in the area, our Staff Engineers, our Science Lead, the Office of the CTO, and our data platform teams. The exact shape of the teams is still forming, and you'll help shape it.
   

  

 In your first year, success looks like a clear direction the area is bought into, and the first solid evidence that the system is compounding.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Own the data and ML direction**
* Set the data and ML direction for the area and get alignment behind it across product, engineering and leadership.
* Turn raw interaction data into immediately useful, actionable insight for users, at the individual level and aggregated up to the organization, measured by whether people come back and act on it.
* Keep recommendations grounded in science, not just patterns in the data, working closely with our Science Lead to keep what we surface credible and defensible.


**Build the intelligence platform, for UI and agents**
* Own the platform that generates insights and recommendations: opinionated, grounded in our thought leadership, and built so the rest of the suite can build on top of it.
* Make that intelligence usable two ways at once, surfaced directly in Mentimeter's UI and exposed so our AI companion and external agents can act on it, with a clean separation between the logic and context layer and the experience layer.
* Build the ranking and timing that gets the right insight to the right user at the right moment, getting sharper from what lands.
* Partner with Staff Engineers on the architecture and technical bets: you bring the product judgment and the outcomes the system must serve, they own the technical design.


**Make it learn, and prove it**
* Define the measurement and experimentation standards the area scales by, so we only scale what shows durable lift against a strong baseline.
* Show, with evidence, how the system's insights and recommendations get sharper over time as it learns from feedback, for example through reinforcement learning.
* Own how we ship AI well: anticipate failure modes, set quality bars, guard against feedback loops that reinforce errors, and roll back cleanly when the model is wrong.
* Make pragmatic calls on when to reach for ML, GenAI or something simpler, proving value before scaling.


**What We're Looking For**
**An experienced data / AI product leader**
* Several years leading data-driven or ML-backed products end to end, from discovery through rollout, ideally in B2B SaaS.
* Experience with recommendation engines or similar ranking and personalization systems is highly relevant, and familiarity with AI ecosystems and integration patterns such as MCP is a bonus.


**You build the data system, not just the surface**
* You've shipped data or AI products where the core value is the system itself, and you're comfortable reasoning about pipelines, models, and how data compounds over time.
* You've led shared-capability or platform work where the real win was adoption and alignment across teams, not just shipping features.


**Commercially minded and outcome-driven**
* You connect product decisions to business outcomes like retention, expansion and durable engagement, and treat data and ML as how you get there, not the point in itself.
* You have a bias for the simplest solution that works, you resist over-engineering, and you have good judgment on when advanced ML or GenAI is worth the trade-off.


**Rigorous and AI-native**
* Strong on experimentation, with real fluency in A/B testing, incrementality and causal inference.
* Fluent in shipping AI responsibly and well: eval sets, failure modes, and a clear sense of what "good enough" looks like before something goes live.


**A Leader Who Multiplies Others**
* You lead through influence and coaching, make progress in ambiguity through iterative learning and clear decision points, and bring out the best in the people around you.


 Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? Please apply anyway and let us know why you'd enjoy working in this role at Mentimeter.
   

  

**Practical details**
* This role is based in our Stockholm office, primarily onsite with the option to work from home twice per week.
* Swedish is not required. Daily work is carried out in English, and the Mentimeter team currently boasts 50+ nationalities.
* A cover letter is not required as part of your application.


**Compensation**
*At Mentimeter, we believe in fair and transparent compensation that grows with you. The salary range for this role is SEK 70,000–SEK 91,000 per month. It’s intentionally broad to reflect the different stages of growth within the role: from early development to deep expertise and meaningful impact.*
*Where an individual is placed within the range depends on factors such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, and alignment with the role’s requirements. We’re committed to supporting your growth. You’ll have ongoing development conversations with your manager, and your salary will evolve as you build skills and contribute to our mission.*
*In addition to your monthly salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package—learn more about it here:* 
 https://www.mentimeter.com/benefits/stockholm
 *.*
**What Mentimeter Can Offer**
 At Mentimeter we can offer a diverse and inclusive work environment supported by smart and driven colleagues. We believe in continuous professional development for all of our colleagues and therefore offer access to a leadership program (including external personal coach) and relevant education to ensure that we continue to be state-of-the-art when it comes to innovating and building Mentimeter. Your place will be in a growing company with lots of career opportunities, working on a beloved product used by more than 300 million people. It’s not all about work though, we also offer a very healthy view on work-life balance.
   

  

 All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package, including pension contributions. Learn more about our benefits by visiting our Benefits & Perks page
   

  

**AI and Hiring at Mentimeter**
 At Mentimeter, we believe AI helps us work smarter - but it never replaces the human assessment, curiosity, and personal connection that define our culture and our hiring. We use AI as a sparring partner: to bounce ideas, bring new perspectives, support structure, and make our work more efficient. But the meaning, decisions, and interactions always come from people.
   

  

* AI does not screen or decide on candidates.
* There is no automated filtering, ranking, or decision-making in our recruitment process. Every application is reviewed by a person.
* Hiring teams may use AI to support their work - for example, to structure notes, prepare interview questions, or organize their thinking.


 AI strengthens our work, but it does not define it. At Mentimeter, we’re not building an AI-driven hiring process - we’re building a people-first culture, where technology helps us listen, learn, and grow together.
   

  

**Culture at Mentimeter**
 At Mentimeter we believe in giving everyone a voice - regardless of who you are. So we build a platform that does just that. Our platform is not only our product but also our organization. A platform where people feel safe, where differences are embraced, a place where you can have fun. We strongly encourage applicants who are people of color, LGBTQ+, women, people with disabilities, and/or formerly incarcerated people, and a college degree is not strictly required. In order to give everyone a voice, we need to be as diverse as our users.
   

  

 Learn more about our culture by visiting our Culture page.
   

  

 Review our Privacy Policy for more information.

title: Enhetschef till enheten Utvecklingsstyrning
description:
****Ledningsstabens uppdrag****




 Ledningsstaben är navet i Arbetsförmedlingens styrning och ger generaldirektören och överdirektören ett samlat stöd i strategiska och myndighetsövergripande frågor. Staben skapar förutsättningar för ledningen att fatta beslut på rätt grund, i rätt tid och med avsedd effekt. Det innebär att bereda och kvalitetssäkra underlag till myndighetsledningen, väga samman perspektiv från verksamheten och säkerställa att beslut fattas utifrån ett tydligt helhetsperspektiv. Genom analys, samordning och uppföljning bidrar Ledningsstaben till att stärka myndighetens genomförandekraft.
   

  





****Enhetens uppdrag****




 Enheten Utvecklingsstyrning ansvarar för att myndigheten har en tydlig riktning för vad som ska utvecklas, varför det ska göras och vilka effekter som uppnås. Det innebär att säkerställa en ändamålsenlig utvecklingsprocess och huvudprocess som används i praktiken. Enheten är ett aktivt stöd och en pådrivande kraft i hela myndighetens utvecklingsarbete och arbetet utgår från att strategi, struktur, resurser och effekt hör ihop.
   

  





 Enheten ska vara ledningens och verksamhetens gemensamma motor för förändring; en funktion som håller ihop myndighetens utvecklingsagenda, säkrar effektstyrning och ser till att förändring faktiskt händer.
   

  





 Enheten ansvarar för myndighetens utvecklingsstyrningsmodell och styrrelationer
 


* Huvudprocess
* Portföljstyrning
* Plan för verksamhetsutveckling
* Effekthemtagning
* Ramverk för processmodeller och metoder inklusive stöd i förändringsledning
* Sammanhållande av utvecklingsrådet.



****Ditt uppdrag****




 Som chef för Enheten Utvecklingsstyrning ansvarar du för att sätta ramar och driva myndighetens utveckling framåt. Du omsätter myndighetens målbild och styrning till konkret utveckling och skapar förutsättningar för att arbetet genomförs i linjen. Du kommer också fungera som en myndighetsövergripande styrfunktion med ansvar för att hålla samman styrkedjan mellan verksamhetsplanering, processer, portföljer, arkitektur, information, produkter, förändringsledning och nyttorealisering, men utan att överta linjens eller sakägarens ansvar
   

  





 Du kommer bland annat att:
 


* Leda och prioritera myndighetens övergripande utvecklingsagenda i linje med myndighetens mål och styrning
* Driva utveckling och förändring genom verksamhetens chefer och skapa tydligt ansvar för genomförandet i linjen
* Etablera tydliga ramar, arbetssätt och prioriteringar för utvecklingsarbetet, budgetering samt följa upp resultat och effekter inklusive kostnader
* Skapa samordning och samsyn mellan verksamhet, IT och övriga centrala funktioner
* Utveckla och förvalta kartor, modeller och ramar som definierar och tydliggör förhållanden mellan linje, process, information, portfölj, produkt och IT
* Bereda, koordinera och på övergripande nivå styra myndighetens processer, informationshantering och utvecklingsverksamhet



****Vårt erbjudande****




 Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid som kan komma att inledas med sex månaders provanställning. Placeringsorten är Solna.
   

  





 Vi erbjuder dig möjligheten att arbeta på en arbetsplats där vi värdesätter balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Du får tillgång till ett generöst semesteravtal, flexibla arbetstider samt möjlighet att arbeta på distans upp till 49 procent på årsbasis. Hos oss ingår även friskvård under arbetstid och ett förmånligt friskvårdsbidrag.
   

  





 Som anställd på Arbetsförmedlingen har du också tillgång till kompetensutveckling och karriärmöjligheter inom myndigheten. Genom vårt arbete bidrar vi till ett inkluderande och hållbart samhälle, där du får möjlighet att göra en verklig skillnad för individer och för samhället i stort. 
   

  





 Mer om att jobba hos oss 
   

  





****Grundläggande krav****



* Minst tre års aktuell erfarenhet av chefskap med verksamhets- och personalansvar



 Eller
 


* Flerårig aktuell erfarenhet av att leda verksamhetsutveckling, digitalisering, IT-utveckling eller motsvarande i en större och komplex organisation



 Samt
 


* Relevant akademisk utbildning eller annan utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig
* Aktuell erfarenhet av strategisk portfölj-, process eller arkitekturstyrning
* Aktuell erfarenhet av att driva strategiska förändringsinitiativ från beslut till genomförande och effekt
* Erfarenhet av beredning och kvalitetssäkring
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta nära högsta ledning i större organisationer och omsätta strategiska mål till konkret utveckling
* Mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska i tal och skrift.



****Meriterande krav****



* Erfarenhet av chefskap och/eller ledarskap i en större statlig myndighet eller annan komplex offentlig organisation
* Erfarenhet av att utveckla styrmodeller och gemensamma arbetssätt för myndighetsövergripande utveckling
* Erfarenhet av att sätta ramar för styrning, budget, genomförande och uppföljning i större verksamheter



 Den statliga värdegrunden guidar oss i vårt dagliga arbete. Som anställd hos oss förväntas du arbeta rättvist, opartiskt och med hög integritet, samt bidra till att upprätthålla och stärka förtroendet för vår myndighet.  
   

  





 Utöver detta har du personlig förmåga och fallenhet att arbeta i enlighet med Arbetsförmedlingens ledarskapskriterier. Läs mer om den statliga värdegrunden och våra ledarskapskriterier på vår hemsida.
   

  





 Som ledare på Arbetsförmedlingen förväntas du vara:
   

  





**Ansvarstagande** 
 – ta ansvar för helheten, skapa tydlig riktning och goda förutsättningar.
   

  





**Handlingskraftig** 
 – omsätta beslut i handling, vara en tydlig och modig förebild.
   

  





**Resultatfokuserad** 
 – följa upp, utveckla och driva verksamheten mot gemensamma mål.
   

  





  
   

  





****Ansökan****




 Låter det här som en tjänst för dig?
 **Välkommen med din ansökan senast 2026-10-18.**




 Bifoga ditt CV där du specificerar årtal, månad och arbetsuppgifter för varje anställning, samt intyg som styrker kraven om utbildning och/eller arbetslivserfarenhet i din ansökan. 
   

  





 Det är viktigt att du besvarar urvalsfrågorna detaljerat och sanningsenligt, för att vi ska få en tydlig bild av din erfarenhet. Om efterfrågad information inte framgår riskerar du bli bortsållad i urvalet. Du behöver inte skicka in ett personligt brev.
   

  





 Under rekryteringsprocessen kan urvalstester förekomma. Vi kommer att hålla dig informerad genom hela rekryteringsprocessen. Mer om vår rekryteringsprocess. 
   

  





 Har du skyddade personuppgifter kontaktar du den rekryteringspartner som finns namngiven i annonsen så får du hjälp med att skicka in din ansökan.
   

  





 Vi arbetar aktivt för att vara en myndighet fri från diskriminering. Det är viktigt för oss att all kompetens tas tillvara och vi välkomnar alla sökande. Vi ser positivt på om du har kunskaper i något av våra nationella minoritetsspråk.
   

  





 Välkommen till oss – vi jobbar för ett Sverige i arbete! Här arbetar du på regeringens uppdrag för en väl fungerande arbetsmarknad. Målet är att korta tiden i arbetslöshet genom att matcha arbetssökande med arbetsgivare. Våra insatser riktas i första hand till dem som står längst ifrån arbetsmarknaden och till de arbetsgivare som är öppna för att anställa dem med störst behov av stöd. Vi motverkar felaktiga utbetalningar och brott mot välfärdssystemen så att våra skattemedel används effektivt till det de är till för. Vi samarbetar med många andra aktörer och tillsammans hittar vi lösningar som gör skillnad - för ett Sverige i arbete.
