Together, we’re pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water and shipping.
   

  

 As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.*
*Are you ready to drive innovation across regions?*
**About The Job**
 Alfa Laval is on the journey of a step-wise rolling out of Shared Services within the group.We have today 6 HR Shared Service Centers, spread across the globe, working with HR-related matters and providing the foundation for developing the HR related support for our employees. To support this strategic direction we are implementing a global Time, Attendance and Absence management system across our international matrix organization.
   

  

 We are now seeking an experienced Global Project Manager to lead the implementation of a new global payroll provider across multiple countries and regions - a collaborative professional who thrives in change and wants to make a real impact across our global HR community.
   

  

 This business-critical project requires coordination across an international matrix organization, where payroll processes, statutory requirements, employment practices, banking arrangements and technology landscapes vary by country. The Project Manager will work closely with global and local payroll teams, HR, IT, finance, tax, treasury, procurement and external providers to align global objectives with essential local requirements.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 You will manage the project from requirements definition and provider selection through design, implementation, country deployment and post-go-live stabilization. Responsibilities will include:
   

  

* Participate the RFP process and vendor selection process
* Coordinating provider selection, due diligence and implementation planning
* Establishing project scope, governance, plans and decision-making structures
* Liaise with international payroll vendors, internal teams, and regional stakeholders
* Managing timelines, budgets, risks, dependencies and stakeholder expectations
* Coordinating data migration, system integrations, testing and payroll reconciliation
* Planning parallel payroll runs, cutover, contingency measures and stabilization
* Ensuring that local compliance and operational requirements are identified and addressed
* Managing provider deliverables, issues, escalations and implementation performance
* Supporting change management and readiness across global and local teams
* Ensuring a controlled handover to the teams responsible for ongoing payroll operations and provider management
* Provide post-implementation support and continuous improvement


**What We’re Looking For**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, HR, or related field
* Proven project management experience in complex, multi-country environments
* Strong knowledge of payroll processes and their connections to HR, finance and technology
* Experience implementing payroll providers or comparable HR technology solutions
* Strong vendor and stakeholder-management capabilities
* The ability to navigate competing global, regional and local priorities
* A structured approach to governance, risk, data, testing, cutover and operational readiness
* PMP or similar certification is a plus.
* Strong understanding of time & attendance and absence management processes and how these connect to payroll.
* Ability to manage projects across multiple countries and cultures, ability to work in a global, multicultural environment.
* Strong communication and leadership skills; decision-making will be key


**Why Join Us?**
* Work on impactful, global projects
* Be part of a diverse, international team
* Competitive compensation, benefits and future development opportunities


 Ready to make a difference? Apply now and help shape the future of our global HR operations!
   

  

**For more information, please contact**
 Haraldur Gudjonsson, Transformation Lead HR Shared Services at Haraldur.Gudjonsson@alfalaval.com
   

  

 or Frederik Ellegaard, Talent Acquisition Manager at frederik.ellegaard@alfalaval.com
   

  

**For Union Information, Please Contact**

title: Business Development Manager - IBM Software
description:

**TD SYNNEX** 
 is a

 IBM is a strategic growth vendor for TD SYNNEX across Europe. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to the expansion of our IBM portfolio, helping partners accelerate their digital transformation through innovative IBM solutions.

title: Servicechef
description:
Onitio är en nordisk IT-koncern, ägd av det norska investmentbolaget Aars, med cirka 1500 anställda, varav 500 i Sverige.
   

  

 Med kontor från Malmö i söder till Luleå i norr kombinerar vi teknisk expertis med innovation och kundfokus. Vi arbetar aktivt för en hållbar framtid – exempelvis genom att 98 % av vår fordonsflotta består av elbilar.
   

  

 Hos oss blir du en del av ett dynamiskt och framgångsrikt team där vi värdesätter mångfald och inkludering. Vi anser att olika perspektiv skapar bättre lösningar och vi arbetar aktivt för att fler kvinnor ska trivas och utvecklas i IT-branschen!
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Vi söker en servicechef till vår verksamhet i Stockholm. Det här är en första linjens chefsroll med stort fokus på personal, ledarskap och rekrytering. Du har personalansvar för cirka 25 till 30 medarbetare och blir en viktig del av den fortsatta utvecklingen av verksamheten.
   

  

**För rollen är tidigare chefserfarenhet ett krav.** 
 Vi söker dig som redan har erfarenhet av att leda medarbetare och som är trygg i arbetsgivaransvar, personalfrågor och att fatta beslut som chef.
   

  

 I rollen leder och stöttar du dina medarbetare i vardagen. Eftersom många av våra medarbetare arbetar ute hos kund behöver du vara trygg i att leda på distans, samtidigt som du skapar nära relationer och ett närvarande ledarskap.
   

  

 En stor del av rollen handlar om personal och rekrytering. Du ansvarar för att rekrytera nya medarbetare, genomföra egna intervjuer och följa medarbetarna genom hela deras anställning. Du har även lönesättande ansvar och arbetar löpande med personalfrågor och utveckling av teamet.
   

  

 Du kommer även att ha kontakt med våra kunder och behöver vara trygg i att hantera dialogen på ett professionellt och lösningsorienterat sätt. Kundansvar är däremot inte huvudfokus i rollen, utan tyngdpunkten ligger på ledarskap och personal.
   

  

 Rollen befinner sig i en förändringsfas och vi söker därför dig som vill vara med och utveckla både arbetssätt och verksamhet framåt. Du behöver trivas i förändring, vara lösningsorienterad och ha förmågan att skapa struktur även när förutsättningarna förändras.
   

  

 Du utgår från vårt kontor i Bromma, där vi ser kontorsnärvaro som en viktig del av rollen, med möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån i viss omfattning. Resor kan förekomma.
   

  

 Vi söker dig som är strukturerad, organiserad och trygg i ditt ledarskap. Du har dokumenterad erfarenhet av personalansvar och rekrytering, är van vid kundkontakt och har B-körkort. Svenskakrav, i tal och skrift.
   

  

**Varför Onitio?**
 På Onitio är medarbetarna vår viktigaste tillgång. Vi erbjuder trygga anställningar, är kollektivavtalsanslutna via TechSverige (IT-avtalet) med tillhörande förmåner, och utöver detta erbjuds alla medarbetare friskvårdsbidrag (för närvarande om 4000 kr/kalenderår), rabattavtal hos ledande friskvårdsleverantörer och andra lokala förmåner.
   

  

 Kompetensutveckling är en självklar del av vår kultur. Genom utbildningar, certifieringar och karriärmöjligheter får du de verktyg du behöver för att växa – oavsett om du vill fördjupa din expertis eller bredda dina kunskaper. Vi sätter tillsammans individuella och meningsfulla mål för dig, och arbetar med din kompetensutveckling löpande under året där din närmaste chef finns till för att stötta dig.
   

  

**Vem vi söker**
 Våra värderingar visar egenskaper som vi på Onitio värdesätter:
   

  

* Brinner för kundnöjdhet och är lösningsorienterad då andra ser problem.
* Är pålitlig och ansvarstagande i att leverera det du lovar.
* Gillar att samarbeta och uppskattar en företagskultur där vi stöttar varandra och firar framgångar tillsammans.


 Vi söker en mångfald av kompetenser och bakgrunder. Har du erfarenhet inom IT är det en bonus, men vi värdesätter framför allt din vilja att lära och utvecklas tillsammans med oss!
   

  

**Ansökan**
 Oavsett bakgrund, kön, ålder eller erfarenhet – hos oss är du välkommen!
   

  

 Vill du vara med och forma framtidens IT-landskap? Skicka in din ansökan redan idag!
   

  

 Har du frågor? Kontakta Andreas Ståhl på andreas.stahl@onitio.com. Urvalet sker löpande, därför kan tjänsten komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum.
   

  

 Läs mer om oss på vår hemsida eller följ oss på LinkedIn.

title: Senior RFID & Card Production Specialist
description:
**About IN Groupe**
 A specialist in identity, secure transactions, and digital services, IN Groupe is the global leader in secure identity and trust services. Every day, our 4,000 employees across 40 countries work to ensure that everyone has access to a reliable and secure identity, both in the physical and digital worlds. With our solutions and our international network of 10 R&D centers, we support governments and businesses in more than 130 countries.
   

  

 Joining IN Groupe means helping to shape the future of the identity and secure transaction market. Become part of our international teams — driven by innovation and proud to design solutions that make life easier and protect personal data for millions of people around the world.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a highly skilled
 **Senior RFID & Card Production Specialist** 
 to serve as the technical authority for card production, RFID encoding, and access control solutions. This role combines hands-on technical expertise with strategic leadership, enabling you to influence product development, operational excellence, and innovation across the organization.
   

  

 As a trusted advisor, you will work closely with Product Owners, Technical Services, Operations, Engineering teams, and external stakeholders to deliver reliable, secure, and efficient solutions. You will play a key role in driving continuous improvement, resolving complex technical challenges, and ensuring the highest standards of quality and compliance.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Act as the primary expert and trusted advisor within card production and RFID encoding.
* Provide technical guidance, coaching, and knowledge sharing across teams.
* Support Product Owners with technical analysis, solution recommendations, and data-driven decision making.
* Analyze business processes and identify opportunities for operational and technical improvement.
* Lead and support strategic projects from planning through implementation.
* Develop, maintain, and improve technical standards, procedures, and documentation.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to resolve complex operational and technical issues.
* Monitor industry developments, emerging technologies, and market trends within RFID, card technologies, and access control.
* Recommend and implement innovative solutions that improve efficiency, quality, and customer value.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, quality standards, industry regulations, and security requirements.
* Facilitate workshops, training sessions, and knowledge-transfer activities.
* Act as an escalation point for technical investigations and problem resolution.
* Act as a trusted advisor to customers by providing insights into current system solutions, identifying improvement opportunities, and supporting business decisions.


**Required**
**Qualifications & Experience**
* Proven experience within RFID technologies and encoding solutions.
* Hands-on experience with production processes and related technologies.
* Strong knowledge of access control systems and credential technologies.
* Technical Services or customer-facing technical support experience.
* Demonstrated project management experience.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Experience in process improvement and operational excellence initiatives.
* Ability to translate complex technical topics into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Experience working in cross-functional and international environments.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.


**Preferred**
* Experience with secure credential management and identity technologies.
* Knowledge of manufacturing, personalization, or issuance processes for smart cards.
* Experience working with RFID standards, access control platforms, and system integrations.
* Familiarity with quality management frameworks and continuous improvement methodologies.

title: HR Business Analyst – Payroll Processes/HR-Systems
description:

Do you thrive in cross-functional projects and enjoy turning complex requirements into structured workflows? If so, this might be the perfect role for you!* 




  





**About the position** 




 Perido is looking for an HR Business Analyst with focus on Payroll Processes/HR-Systems for our client, an automotive company. The position is placed in Södertälje with hybrid working applied, three days on site.
 



  





**Your daily tasks** 




 As a HR Business Analyst, you will contribute expertise to the design, alignment, and implementation of project-driven changes. You will work closely with cross-functional stakeholders throughout the transformation lifecycle:
 


* Document, maintain, and update requirements for the new Payroll solution
* Translate Payroll requirements into clear process designs, workflows, and future-state solutions
* Support requirements gathering, impact analysis, and testing related to process and system changes
* Ensure process and requirements documentation is accurate, accessible, and up to date
* Develop and update user and administrator guides for the new solution
* Collaborate with project, business, HR, and change teams to support implementation readiness, rollout, and stabilization
* Support the implementation of new ways of working and ensure alignment between processes, system requirements, and change activities



  





**Your characteristics** 




 To succeed in this role, you are a collaborative and people-oriented professional who builds trust and creates alignment across diverse stakeholder groups. You have a structured and proactive approach, allowing you to manage complexity and maintain progress through clear follow-up and coordination. You are adaptable and resilient when priorities shift in an evolving project environment. Furthermore, you have a strong change perspective and understand how well-designed processes, clear documentation, and structured ways of working contribute to successful transformation and long-term adoption.
 



 Does this sound like an exciting challenge you would love to take on? We look forward to receiving your application, warmly welcome to apply today!

* Strong knowledge of Payroll and HR administration
* Good understanding of People & Culture processes, particularly Payroll and time-related processes

 Full-time, consulting assignment until 2027-12-31. Start 2026-10-19.

title: Project Manager DTO

title: Business Development Manager - Mobile B2B
description:
**Do you thrive on building relationships, closing deals, and driving growth?**
 The mobile market is evolving faster than ever. New technologies, AI-driven productivity, changing customer demands, and innovative business models are creating exciting opportunities for those who are passionate about business development and sales.
   

  

 We're looking for a Business Development Manager (Mobile B2B) to join our team and help drive growth for some of the industry's leading mobile vendors, including Google Pixel and other strategic brands within our product portfolio.
   

  

 This is a highly commercial role where success is measured by your ability to identify opportunities, build strategic partnerships, develop a strong sales pipeline, and deliver measurable business results across the Swedish market.
   

  

 You will act as an extension of our vendors' sales organizations while supporting reseller partners in winning new business, increasing market share, and helping customers adopt modern mobile workplace solutions.
   

  

**The Role**
 As a Business Development Manager, you will play a pivotal role in driving growth across assigned vendors and customer segments within the Mobile B2B market.
   

  

 Operating at the intersection of leading technology vendors, TD SYNNEX, and our network of reseller and telecom partners, you will help transform vendor ambitions into measurable commercial success. Through strong channel engagement, customer-facing activities, and strategic business planning, you will create growth opportunities and accelerate market adoption.
   

  

 This is a highly visible and entrepreneurial role that offers significant freedom, responsibility, and influence. You will be trusted to manage your own business, prioritize activities, and create momentum across customers, partners, and vendors. With this level of ownership comes the responsibility to meet vendor expectations and deliver against agreed targets and specific KPIs.
   

  

 Success requires a proactive mindset, commercial curiosity, and a strong drive to convert opportunities into results. You will work toward clearly defined business objectives and KPIs, with performance measured on an ongoing basis.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Vendor & Business Development**
* Translate vendor strategies and objectives into actionable business plans.
* Drive growth and market share development across assigned vendors and customer segments.
* Manage vendor relationships and contribute to Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and strategic planning activities.
* Provide market insights, competitive intelligence, and commercial recommendations to vendors.
* Support the execution of vendor-funded marketing activities, incentives, and growth programs.


**Channel Development & Sales Execution**
* Develop and strengthen strategic relationships across the reseller and telecom partner ecosystem.
* Enable and support partner sales teams through training, customer engagement, and joint business activities.
* Conduct customer meetings and partner engagements to generate new business opportunities and accelerate sales cycles.
* Increase vendor visibility and presence both internally within TD SYNNEX and externally across the market.
* Drive strategic sales opportunities and build a healthy, sustainable pipeline.


**Commercial & Financial Management**
* Negotiate commercial agreements, incentives, discounts, and other business terms.
* Contribute to purchasing, pricing, sales, and inventory strategies.
* Understand and actively manage the commercial drivers of the business, including gross margin, vendor rebates, working capital, inventory turn, and profitability.
* Use forecasting, pipeline management, and market analysis to support sound business decisions.
* Balance growth, availability, and financial performance to create long-term value for vendors, partners, and TD SYNNEX.
* Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline management on a weekly basis.


**Who Are You?**
 You are a commercially driven sales professional with a passion for building relationships, identifying opportunities, and creating profitable business growth.
   

  

 You understand that modern mobility is about more than devices. You can connect customer needs with business value and work effectively with vendors, partners, and end customers to drive successful outcomes.
   

  

 Whether you're presenting to decision-makers, negotiating a commercial agreement, or developing a joint business plan with a partner, you know how to build credibility and move opportunities forward.
   

  

**To Be Successful In This Role, You Should Have**
* 3-5 years of experience in sales, business development, channel management, or a related commercial role within IT, telecom, mobility, or technology.
* A strong network among resellers, operators, vendors, and key decision-makers in the Swedish market.
* A proven track record of building pipeline, driving growth, and delivering sales results.
* Strong commercial acumen and a solid understanding of distributor economics, including profitability, rebates, margins, working capital, inventory management, and business planning.
* Experience working with vendor relationships and managing multiple stakeholders.
* A results-oriented mindset with a strong drive to win new business and exceed targets.
* Excellent planning and organizational skills, with the ability to independently manage your workload and deliver against predefined KPIs.
* Experience working with CRM platforms and sales management tools.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills in both Swedish and English, written and verbal.
* A valid driver's license and willingness to travel within Sweden.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience from an IT distributor, mobile vendor, telecom operator, or reseller organization.
* Familiarity with enterprise mobility solutions, mobile device management platforms, or modern workplace technologies.
* Experience working with Google Pixel for Business, Android Enterprise, or similar enterprise mobility offerings.


**What We Offer**
* A key role in one of the fastest-growing areas of the technology industry.
* The opportunity to work with some of the world's leading mobile technology brands.
* Freedom to drive your own business while making a real impact on growth, profitability, and market share.
* A dynamic, entrepreneurial environment where initiative, collaboration, and results are valued.

title: AI Manufacturing Solutions Consultant - Stockholm - 10 months
description:
AI Manufacturing Solutions Consultant
   

  

  

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced AI Manufacturing specialist to support the development and deployment of advanced AI-driven initiatives across a large-scale manufacturing organisation. The successful consultant will play a key role in identifying opportunities to enhance operational efficiency through predictive analytics, digital twin technologies, and production optimisation solutions.
   

 This position is ideal for a professional with a strong manufacturing background who can bridge the gap between industrial operations and emerging AI technologies.
   

  

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Assess manufacturing operations and identify high-value AI use cases
* Lead and support Predictive Maintenance initiatives to improve equipment reliability and reduce downtime
* Design and enhance Digital Twin capabilities to enable simulation and operational optimisation
* Work closely with plant operations, engineering, and technology teams to implement AI-driven solutions
* Analyse production data to identify opportunities for process improvement and operational efficiency gains
* Support the development of AI roadmaps, business cases, and implementation strategies
* Collaborate with stakeholders across multiple manufacturing sites
* Ensure AI solutions align with operational and business objectives


 Required Experience
   

  

* Significant experience within manufacturing, industrial operations, or smart factory environments
* Proven track record delivering AI, machine learning, or advanced analytics projects in manufacturing
* Hands-on experience with Predictive Maintenance frameworks and asset optimisation
* Strong knowledge of Digital Twins and industrial IoT ecosystems
* Experience improving manufacturing performance through data-driven optimisation
* Understanding of production systems, manufacturing execution processes, and operational excellence principles
* Excellent stakeholder engagement and consulting skills


 Candidate Profile
   

  

* Strong manufacturing domain expert with AI implementation experience
* Comfortable engaging with both technical and business stakeholders
* Proactive, solution-oriented, and able to work independently in international environments
* Europe-based and available for occasional travel

title: Medical Operations - Global
description:
**Build something monumental for Healthcare!**
 At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.
   

  

 We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!
   

  

**About The Role**
 We’re building the clinical co-pilot of the future - empowering clinicians, enhancing care delivery, and scaling impact. As part of our
 **Global Medical Operations team** 
 , you’ll play a pivotal role in rolling out Tandem’s AI clinical operating system to some of the most influential healthcare organisations worldwide.
   

  

 This is a highly visible, global role where you’ll engage directly with executives, medical leaders, and end-users. You’ll bring clinical insight into how our tools are implemented on the ground - from onboarding new organisations and refining workflows to shaping the product through continuous feedback. You’ll be at the forefront of transforming healthcare delivery, ensuring Tandem becomes an indispensable part of daily patient care for clinicians across the globe.
   

  

 What You Will Do
   

  

* Lead live product demos for prospective clients and support global commercial efforts.
* Design and adapt workflows and templates for diverse markets and large-scale customers.
* Partner with product, engineering, and commercial teams to deliver smooth rollouts and seamless workflow integration.
* Represent Tandem at international conferences, workshops, and customer events.
* Guide clinicians through onboarding, training, and day-to-day support.
* Troubleshoot and solve problems to ensure clinicians get maximum value from Tandem.
* Build templates and prompts, contributing to the ongoing evolution of Tandem’s AI assistant.
* Manage clinical safety incidents and optimise internal operations for safe scaling.


 What You Bring
   

  

* Clinical experience in healthcare (e.g. general practice, hospital, private practice).
* Exposure to consulting, corporate, or startup environments.
* A passion for technology, AI, and their potential to transform care.
* Strong communication skills — equally comfortable with executives, engineers, and frontline clinicians.
* Organisational strength and a process-driven mindset.
* Ownership, curiosity, and initiative in a fast-paced environment.
* Flexibility to travel up to 25% and step in during critical moments.
* Multilingual skills (highly valued).


 Bonus Points
   

  

* Experience with prompting or large language models (LLMs).
* Background in healthtech or SaaS.
* Familiarity with EU clinical safety or digital health regulations.
* Track record in implementation projects or customer rollouts.


 Location
   

  

 We believe the best ideas happen when we’re together. This role is based in our vibrant HQ in the Epicenter building in the heart of Stockholm where you will work primarily from our office to collaborate, connect, and build our culture.
   

  

 How to Apply
   

  

 We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.
   

  

 Our interview process consists of 4 stages:
   

  

* Screening interview with Talent Acquisition
* First interview with a global commercial colleague
* Follow up interview with some of our Medical Operations team members including a sales demo and prompting task
* Working Day - Join us in the Stockholm office for a day to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.


**Benefits**
* Competitive salary & company stock options
* 25 days/year of paid vacation
* 5,000 SEK wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag)
* Social and team-building activities (off-sites, after works, winter/summer parties)
* An opportunity to make a real positive impact in the world of healthcare
* Work with some of the best minds in AI, healthcare, and engineering.


*We review our benefits packages on a regular basis and might modify our benefits from time to time.*
**Culture at Tandem**
 At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.
   

  

 Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.
   

  

 Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.
   

  

 We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.
   

  

*Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.*

title: Channel Sales Manager, Sweden
description:
**Who We Are**
 Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.
   

  

 We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.
   

  

 You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a
 **Channel Sales Manager (Bilingual - Swedish/English)** 
 , you'll be pivotal in scaling Verkada's reach and impact by developing and managing a network of high-performing reseller partners. You'll be responsible for driving net new business through the channel—building pipeline and executing strategic plans that result in measurable growth.
   

  

 This individual contributor role requires strategic thinking and hands-on execution as you collaborate across sales, marketing, and partner teams to grow Verkada’s presence in Sweden.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 In this role, you’ll be at the heart of Verkada’s mission, working hand-in-hand with our sales teams to drive growth and success with channel partners. You’ll be responsible for building pipeline and generating net new business through reseller partners while executing a best-in-class channel strategy. Here’s what you’ll own:
   

  

* Drive Net New Pipeline: Proactively identify and generate pipeline with net new end-user customers through strategic reseller partners. Collaborate closely with field sales teams to co-sell and close high-value opportunities.
* Execute Regional Channel Strategy: Develop and manage a focused partner business plan for your territory that aligns with Verkada’s overall GTM objectives and quarterly sales targets.
* Empower Our Partners: Train and enable partner executives, sales teams, and technical stakeholders on Verkada’s full product portfolio, programs, and campaigns to ensure deep engagement and capability across all levels.
* Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work closely with Verkada’s internal sales, marketing, and pre-sales teams to drive joint activities, including partner events, demand generation campaigns, and customer-facing initiatives.
* Lead with Insight: Conduct regular QBRs and ad-hoc business reviews with partners to align on priorities, track performance, celebrate wins, and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Strengthen the Channel Ecosystem: Influence partner sales teams to prioritize Verkada in key deals and business planning efforts. Leverage insights from the field to recommend improvements to Verkada’s channel tools, incentives, and partner program offerings.
* Drive Awareness and Demand: Lead and participate in regional in-person and virtual events to grow Verkada’s brand awareness, build community, and strengthen relationships with key partner contacts and stakeholders.
* Operate Strategically and Tactically: Own the full lifecycle of partner engagement in your region—from onboarding and enablement to pipeline development and revenue realization.
* This role requires regular travel, estimated to be more than 50% of the time, including both domestic and international destinations as needed. The successful candidate must be comfortable with frequent travel to support business operations, customer and partner engagements and team collaboration.
* This role requires regular travel, estimated to be more than 50% of the time, including both domestic and international destinations as needed. The successful candidate must be comfortable with frequent travel to support business operations, customer and partner engagements and team collaboration.


**What You Bring**
* Experience & Success: 7+ years of channel sales or partner management experience with a strong track record of building new business via Security Integrators or IT VAR partners. Recognition, such as President’s Club, is a plus.
* Strategic & Creative Thinking: A process-driven approach, complemented by innovative thinking to create scalable, partner-focused initiatives.
* Relationship-Builder: Ability to influence and engage across all levels—from partner sales reps to executive leadership.
* Technical Fluency: Comfortable navigating product discussions and sales operations. Proficiency in Salesforce, Excel, and business intelligence tools.
* Clear Communicator: Strong verbal and written communication skills with sharp attention to detail and a professional presence.
* Local to Sweden: Must reside in Sweden and be open to 50% travel as well as being present in our Verkada office.


**Sweden Employee Benefits**
 Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:
   

  

* Flexible allowances to purchase medical & life related coverage that meet your individual needs

**Verkada Is An Equal Opportunity Employer**
 As an equal opportunity employer, Verkada is committed to providing employment opportunities to all individuals. All applicants for positions at Verkada will be treated without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (Stockholm, EU only)
description:
Anyfin is building the next generation of consumer finance. We’re profitable, scaling quickly, and now operating with a banking license which opens up a lot of technical complexity.
   

  

 We’re looking for a senior fullstack engineer who enjoys moving fast, taking real ownership, and building things that actually have an impact.
   

  

 If that sounds like your kind of environment, keep reading. Because honestly, it’s not a role for everyone.
   

  

**Small team, high responsibility**
 We hire carefully. We’re not a company that grows by adding headcount everywhere, we grow by keeping the bar high and building a team where every person matters.
   

  

 This isn’t a place where you disappear into a big org. If you join, you’ll have real influence on what we build and how we build it.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 You’ll work across the stack, end to end:
   

  

* Build and ship features across backend, web and mobile.
* Own projects from idea to production (and beyond).
* Make product and technical decisions, not just implement tasks.
* Build systems that scale with real users and real money.
* Work closely with product and design, in person, every week.


 Our main stack is TypeScript, Node.js, React, React Native.
   

  

**How We Think About Building**
 We’re pragmatic. We like speed, but we also care about building things that last.
   

  

 AI isn’t a side tool here. It’s embedded in how we work helping engineers move faster, reduce friction and focus on solving meaningful problems.
   

  

 We’re looking for engineers who are curious about that shift and want to be part of it, rather than people who feel like good engineering means doing everything the hard way.
   

  

 No ego. Just good judgment and high output.
   

  

**You’ll thrive here if you…**
* Have solid fullstack experience.
* Take responsibility naturally and don’t wait to be told what to do.
* Enjoy messy problems and figuring things out as you go.
* Like being in an ambitious and collaborative team.
* Want to build, not just maintain.


**You’re Comfortable With Things Like**
* Backend microservice architecture and API design.
* React-based frontend work.
* Databases, CI/CD, cloud (GCP).
* Shipping real products to real users.


**A few practical notes**
* Stockholm based.
* EU work authorization required.


**Why Anyfin?**
 Because this is one of those moments where a company is about to level up: Banking license secured, expansion ahead and a lot to build.
   

  

 If you want to be part of a small, high-trust team doing meaningful work, we’d love to hear from you. Apply only if you want the responsibility that comes with real impact.
   

  

 Anyfin is a fintech on a mission to simplify loan repayments and improve the financial well-being of millions. We help consumers reduce the costs of high-interest loans, and take control of their repayment plan.

title: Senior nätverkstekniker med expertis inom Cisco

Du får en central roll i flera pågående och kommande utvecklingsprojekt, med fokus på bland annat kontorsflyttar och livscykelhantering av accessnätverket.

title: Master thesis: Coarse-grained reconfigurable arrays (CGRA)
description:
**Join our Team**
**About this opportunity:**
 Are you curious about what comes after the CPU? This master's thesis explores coarse-grained reconfigurable arrays (CGRAs), a class of processors where the program is not a sequence of instructions, but a computational graph mapped spatially onto a fabric of compute elements. CGRAs promise high-power efficiency and rapid reconfiguration, which makes them a highly interesting candidate both for the real-time signal processing at the heart of tomorrow's cellular networks and for the AI workloads increasingly embedded in them.
   

  

 The work is carried out within our 6G testbed program, where we build cellular network prototypes for future standards and evaluate alternative compute platforms for real-time, high-performance computation. You will get hands-on access to a pre-commercial CGRA device with accompanying tools and be among the first to find out what this architecture is really like to program, integrate, and run baseband and AI workloads on. Since the technology is new, the exact research question will be shaped together with you once you have first-hand experience with the architecture and its tools.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Implement classic baseband kernels and / or AI workloads on the CGRA and verify them against bit-exact reference models
* Investigate the programming model: how a computational-graph target changes development, debugging, testing, and CI compared to a CPU
* Investigate the CPU–CGRA boundary: shared memory, pointer passing, and asynchronous offload primitives
* Characterize the architecture: how DSP and AI kernels map onto the fabric, reconfiguration cost, timing determinism, and power and performance versus a CPU/GPU baseline


**The skills you bring:**
* Proficiency in C/C++ for embedded systems and comfort with linear algebra
* Interest in computer architecture, compilers, or digital hardware; no prior CGRA knowledge is expected
* Curiosity about signal processing, wireless systems, and machine learning inference; prior experience in these areas is a plus but not required

 Vi är ett entreprenördrivet IT företag, med både produktkunskap och försäljning (Techster AB) och konsultativa tjänster (Techster Solutions AB). Det innebär att vi är mycket öppna för nya tekniska lösningar, kunskapsutbyte och ständigt lärande. Att ha roligt och samtidigt behålla den familjära andan utan hierarkier är lika viktigt.
   

  

 Vi vill skapa det konsultbolag som du alltid velat jobba för, men kanske inte hittat ännu. Redan idag har vi en blandning av seniora och yngre medarbetare, såväl som män och kvinnor. Det vill vi fortsätta att bygga på. Så välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Forskningsassistent inom beräkningsbaserad protein- och peptiddesign
description:
**Institutionen för molekylär biovetenskap, Wenner-Grens institut (MBW)** 
 bedriver experimentell grundforskning inom molekylär cellbiologi, intergrativ biologi och infektions- och immunbiologi. Forskningsmiljön präglas av en modern och avancerad metodik och har en stark internationell profil. MBW är en av de större institutionerna inom Naturvetenskapliga fakulteten vid Stockholms universitet med drygt 30 forskargrupper och ca 180 anställda varav 65 är doktorander. Mer information om oss finns på: Institutionen för molekylär biovetenskap, Wenner-Grens institut
   

  





**Arbetsuppgifter**




 Som forskningsassistent inom beräkningsbiologi och maskininlärning kommer dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter att inkludera:
 


* Utveckla, benchmarka och köra djupinlärningspipelines för strukturförutsägelse, konformationsprovtagning och
 *de novo* 
 peptid-/proteindesign.
* Utföra strukturmodellering riktad mot komplexa membranproteiner, GPCR:er och cykliska peptider.
* Hantera beräkningsarbetsflöden och jobbkörningar i klustermiljöer för höpresterande beräkningar (HPC).
* Analysera biofysiska data, underhålla rena källkodsarkiv (Git) samt presentera resultat inom forskargruppen.



**Kvalifikationer**




 Vi söker dig som:
   

  





**Krav:** 



* Masterexamen (MSc) inom bioinformatik, beräkningsbiologi, datavetenskap, biofysik eller annat relevant kvantitativt område.
* Mycket goda programmeringskunskaper i Python samt erfarenhet av ramverk för djupinlärning (PyTorch eller JAX).
* God förståelse för strukturbiologiska principer samt erfarenhet av moderna verktyg för strukturförutsägelse (t.ex. AlphaFold, ESMFold, PyMOL).
* Förmåga att arbeta självständigt, felsöka tekniska problem och snabbt anpassa dig till nya arbetsflöden.
* Mycket goda kunskaper i engelska i både tal och skrift.



**Meriterande:** 



* Erfarenhet av att köra beräkningsjobb i HPC-miljöer (Linux / SLURM).
* Bakgrund inom molekylärdynamik, GPCR-strukturbiologi eller modellering av cykliska peptider.
* God vana av mjukvaruutvecklingssed (versionshantering, containerisering med Docker/Singularity).



**Om anställningen**




 Anställningen är tidsbegränsad på sex månader och avser projektbaserat arbete. Stockholms universitet tillämpar individuell lönesättning. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.
   

  





**Vi erbjuder**




 Hos oss får du dynamiken i samspelet mellan högre utbildning och forskning som gör Stockholms universitet till en spännande och kreativ miljö. Du arbetar i en internationell miljö och får förmånliga villkor. Universitetet ligger beläget i Nationalstadsparken med goda förbindelser till city.
   

  





 Stockholms universitet värnar om att vara en arbetsplats som är fri från diskriminering och ger lika rättigheter och möjligheter för alla.
   

  





**Kontakt**




 Ytterligare information lämnas av Patrick Bryant, patrick.bryant@su.se
   

  





**Ansökan**




 Du söker anställningen via Stockholms universitets rekryteringssystem. Du som sökande ansvarar för att ansökan är komplett och att den är universitetet tillhanda senast sista ansökningsdag.
   

  





 Anvisningar för sökande finns på webbsidan: att söka en anställning.
   

  





 Stockholms universitet bidrar till det hållbara demokratiska samhällets utveckling genom kunskap, upplysning och sanningssökande.

title: Vårdadministratör/koordinator till Meliva Considra AB
description:
Är du en driven och strukturerad administratör med god vana av journalsystem och vårdens digitala flöden? Vill du ha en nyckelroll där du kombinerar verksamhetskoordinering med att vara klinikens lokala systemadministratör (LSA) för Take Care? Då är det dig vi söker till vårt team på Meliva Considra!
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Som vårdadministratör/koordinator är du klinikens administrativa nav och LSA (Lokal Systemadministratör) för journalsystemet Take Care. Du arbetar i nära samverkan med verksamhetschefer, enhetschefer, medicinskt ledningsansvarig och vårdpersonalen för att säkerställa att den dagliga driften och systemmiljön fungerar optimalt.
   

  

 Tjänsten är bred och rymmer allt från systemadministration, behörigheter och bemanningskoordinering till fakturering och kvalitetsuppföljning. Du har många kontaktytor – internt inom kliniken och Melivas centrala stödfunktioner, samt externt mot regioner (Region Stockholm, VGR) och leverantörer.
   

  

**Du Ansvarar Bland Annat För**
**LSA för Take Care & systemadministration:**
* Agera lokal systemadministratör (LSA) för journalsystemet TakeCare; hantera behörigheter, enheter, journalmallar.
* Vara administratör och superuser för övriga vård- och stödsystem.
* Beställa och hantera behörigheter gentemot Region Stockholm (t.ex. SITHS-kort, SAM, vårdfaktura).


**Personaladministration & Onboarding**
* Samordna onboarding och offboarding för personal.


**Bemannings- Och ST-läkarplanering**
* Samordna planeringen för ST-läkare (schema, handledare, STÖK-blanketter och månatliga underlag för vidarefakturering).


**Ekonomi, Fakturering & Avtalshantering**
* Hantera fakturering av ST-tjänster, kuratorsbesök, vårdfakturor och EU-patienter.
* Ha löpande dialog och avstämningar med ekonomiteamet.


**Statistik, Kvalitet & Rapportering**
* Rapportera väntetider månadsvis i Utbudstjänsten och sammanställa avfallsstatistik kvartalsvis.
* Utföra månatliga SALA-loggkontroller.


**Lokal IT, Information & Utbildning**
* Samordna lokal IT-utrustning och fungera som kontaktperson för digitala verktyg och AI-stöd (t.ex. Tandem, Omilon).


**Vi Erbjuder Dig**
 Hos Meliva får du en central och ansvarsfull roll där ditt arbete direkt underlättar arbetet för läkare, sjuksköterskor och ledning. Vi erbjuder en engagerad arbetsplats med trevliga kollegor och ett öppet arbetsklimat där utveckling och förbättringar uppmuntras. Vi har kollektivavtal.
   

  

**Vi Söker Dig Som**
 Vi söker dig som är självgående, noggrann och trygg i IT- och journalsystem. Du har en naturlig servicekänsla, trivs med breda kontaktytor och motiveras av att hålla ordning på struktur samt behörigheter.
   

  

**Kvalifikationer**
* Utbildning som vårdadministratör/medicinsk sekreterare, eller motsvarande relevant erfarenhet av vårdadministration/koordinering.
* Erfarenhet av Take Care, gärna med vana eller god förståelse för rollen som lokal systemadministratör (LSA).
* Mycket god systemvana i vårdadministrativa verktyg.
* God förståelse för administrativ ekonomi, fakturering och underlagshantering.
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift.


**Meriterande**
* Formell LSA-utbildning för Take Care.
* Erfarenhet av EK (Elektronisk medarbetarkatalog), TeleQ, 1177 e-tjänster, SAM eller Utbudstjänsten.
* Erfarenhet av beställar- och samordningsroller kopplade till Region Stockholm.


**Om Meliva**
 Meliva är en bred vårdgrupp med vårdcentraler, BVC, specialistvård och företagshälsa som växer på den svenska marknaden. Som en del av det finska vårdföretaget Mehiläinen har vi lång erfarenhet av att driva vård med hög kvalitet – både fysiskt och digitalt. Vi bygger framtidens vård – mänsklig, lokal och hållbar.
   

  

 Vår strategi utgår från att kvalitet i vården börjar med dem som ger den. Därför sätter vi arbetsmiljö, ledarskap och kompetens i centrum – inte i marginalen. Vår vision är att vara vårdens bästa arbetsgivare, för att skapa bättre vård för patienten och en välfärd som håller i längden.
   

  

**Om anställningen**
 Omfattning: Heltid
   

  

 Anställningsform: Tjänsten är ett vikariat (föräldraledighet) på heltid under 12 månader med start enligt överenskommelse.
   

  

 Placering: Vi finns i Nacka, på Norrmalm samt Södermalm. Placeringsort Södermalm/Rosenlunds sjukhus.
   

  

 Lön: Enligt överenskommelse
   

  

 Intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan därför tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Vänta inte med din ansökan!
   

  

**Kontakt**
 Vid frågor är du varmt välkommen att kontakta:
   

  

 Namn: Sara Lins
   

  

 Roll: Verksamhetschef
   

  

 Mail: sara.lins@meliva.se

title: Enhetschef till avdelningen för signalunderrättelser
description:
*Vill du göra samhällsnytta och bidra till Sveriges oberoende i världen? Vi söker enhetschefer till avdelningen för signalunderrättelser. På FRA är varje arbetsuppgift en del av något större. Är du den vi söker kan vi erbjuda ett varierande arbete i en kunskapsintensiv miljö där du får vara med och göra skillnad varje dag.*
 Ditt uppdrag
   

  

 Som enhetschef hör du till ett kontor inom avdelningen för signalunderrättelser och en enhet som verkar inom området rysk militär verksamhet. Avdelningen för signalunderrättelser arbetar med att bearbeta och analysera inhämtat material i syfte att rapportera unika och efterfrågade underrättelser till våra uppdragsgivare.
   

  

 I rollen leder du en grupp analytiker som har uppgiften att rapportera underrättelser i olika tidstempon till FRA:s uppdragsgivare. Du ansvarar för enhetens utgående underrättelseproduktion och har särskilt ansvar för att underrättelseproduktionen och arbetet vid enheten sker i enlighet med gällande inriktning, tillstånd och lagstiftning. Du tillser att enhetens medarbetare har rätt förutsättningar genom tillgång till verktyg, information och kompetensutveckling. Rollen innefattar personal-, budget- och arbetsmiljöansvar.
   

  

 Som enhetschef har du en viktig roll som tydlig kommunikatör och ansvarar för att utveckla arbetet på enheten. Verksamhetsansvaret koordinerar du med andra chefer och ledare på den berörda sektionen och kontoret. Du har många kontakter inom avdelningen och myndigheten, men också externa kontakter med myndighetens uppdragsgivare. Du ingår i sektionens ledningsgrupp och rapporterar till sektionschefen.
   

  

 Tjänstens karaktär innebär förtroendearbetstid och tjänsteresor inrikes och utrikes kan förekomma.
   

  

 Du kan
   

  

**Vi Söker Dig Som Har**
* Akademisk examen inom exempelvis statsvetenskap, teknik, juridik, krigsvetenskap, ekonomi, eller annat relevant område och/eller förvärvat motsvarande kunskaper genom arbetslivet
* Erfarenhet av en roll som ledare
* God datorvana
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift


**Vi Ser Det Som Meriterande Om Du Har**
* Utbildning från försvarssektorn.
* Erfarenhet av en roll med personalansvar
* Erfarenhet från försvars- och/eller tekniksektorn
* Tidigare arbetat med underrättelseverksamhet
* Kompetens inom och/eller intresse för militära frågor
* Kunskap inom radio, telekom och/eller förståelse för teknik


 Du är
   

  

**Vi Söker Dig Med Följande Egenskaper**
* Ledarskap - Du leder, motiverar och förser andra med befogenheter som krävs för att effektivt nå gemensamma mål. Samordnar grupper och blir en referenspunkt för andra. Skapar engagemang och delaktighet.
* Tydlig - Du kommunicerar på ett tydligt sätt. Säkerställer att budskap når fram och att förväntningarna är klara för alla berörda parter. Påminner och följer upp.
* Flexibel - Du har lätt för att anpassa sig till ändrade omständigheter. Kan snabbt ändra sitt synsätt och förhållningssätt. Ser möjligheterna i förändringar.
* Integritet - Du har väl grundade och tydliga värderingar och förmåga att tänka begreppsmässigt på frågor ur ett etiskt perspektiv. Styrs av etik och värderingar i avgörande situationer i arbetet.


 Om FRA
   

  

 FRA har omvärlden som sin arena där varje arbetsuppgift är en del av något större. På ett eller annat sätt får du som medarbetare vara med och bidra till att skydda Sveriges integritet och oberoende i världen. Du är med och gör skillnad på riktigt, varje dag.
   

  

 Vår uppgift som underrättelsetjänst är att skydda Sverige mot de allvarligaste hot som kan riktas mot ett samhälle – militära angrepp, terrorism och cyberattacker. Vi skyddar det viktigaste vi har – vår trygghet, vår demokrati och vårt sätt att leva. Vi är experter på cyberområdet och signalspaning samt en larmklocka för militära hot.
   

  

 FRA leder sedan 2024 Nationellt cybersäkerhetscenter, NCSC vars uppdrag är att utveckla och stärka Sveriges förmåga att förebygga, upptäcka och hantera cyberhot.
   

  

 Som nyanställd på FRA får du en omfattande introduktionsutbildning och kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling, vilket ger dig möjlighet att utveckla dina färdigheter och bli ännu bättre på det du brinner för. Vår organisation är mångfacetterad och består av olika kompetenser och personligheter, där varje individ har unika egenskaper och förutsättningar. Vi strävar efter att skapa en miljö där alla känner sig välkomna och trygga. Utöver en stimulerande arbetsmiljö erbjuder vi också ett attraktivt förmånspaket, som du kan läsa mer om på www.fra.se . För mer information om Nationellt cybersäkerhetscenter besök www.ncsc.se
   

  

 För din trygghet. För vår demokrati. Varje dag. Året om.
   

  

 Mer information
   

  

 Arbetsplatsen är belägen i närheten av Drottningholm, ca 10 min från Brommaplan. Svenskt medborgarskap är ett krav då anställning vid FRA innebär placering i säkerhetsklass. Ett krav för att få anställning är godkänd säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll. Säkerhetsprövningen kommer att genomföras i enlighet med bestämmelser i säkerhetsskyddslagen. Med anställning följer en skyldighet att krigsplaceras. Vi tillämpar sex månaders provanställning. För mer information är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef på rekrytering@fra.se. Fackliga företrädare nås på 010-557 46 00.
   

  

 Vi tar emot ansökningar via www.fra.se
 **senast 2026-10-25.**
 Referensnummer
 **2026FRA1889-2.**
 Då vi inför denna rekrytering redan tagit ställning till de rekryteringskanaler vi önskar använda undanber vi oss att bli kontaktade för ytterligare erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp.
   

  

 Sökord:
 *Ledarskap, Underrättelseverksamhet, Försvar & Säkerhet, radio, telekolm, signalunderättelser*

title: Specialist Account Executive (Simulation)
description:
**Siemens Digital Industries Software** 
 is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.
   

  

 We're looking for a driven Account Executive to lead the expansion of our
 **Simulation and Test Solutions** 
 across the Nordic region. This is a high-performance sales role with clear revenue ambitions. You'll own Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) growth across a portfolio of strategic accounts and be accountable for results. You'll expand our simulation footprint across a portfolio of key strategic accounts in the Nordics, working closely with customers to unlock the full value of our simulation portfolio and helping them realize the competitive advantage that best-in-class simulation enables. The acquisition of Altair has made Simcenter the most complete simulation portfolio in the industry, covering structural, fluid, electromagnetic, and systems simulation. You'll have the full breadth of that portfolio behind you.
   

  

 Are you ready to make an impact in the simulation software space?
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and execute comprehensive account plansfor your key accounts, working closely with internal teams to expand Simcenter adoption and grow customer investment
* Identify and pursue new business opportunitiesacross a defined set of target accounts, bringing fresh approaches to customer acquisition and competitive displacement
* Present value-based messagingaround our Simcenter simulation portfolio, helping customers understand how these solutions address their specific engineering challenges
* Lead technical sales conversationswith key decision-makers, navigating complex buying cycles and building trust through deep product knowledge
* Work closely with Customer Success, Marketing, and Renewals teamsto ensure smooth customer onboarding and create pathways for long-term account growth
* Monitor pipeline health, forecast accurately, and contribute to strategic territory planning that supports regional growth objectives


**Qualifications**
* Significant experience in technical sales or engineering consultancy within the simulation software space, with hands-on familiarity with Simcenter or comparable solutions in Simulation.
* Confidence to discuss engineering challenges and value at any level, from department manager to C-suite while equally comfortable collaborating with internal pre-sales and support teams to position and deliver the right solution to deliver value for our valued customers.
* Demonstrated track record of managing and growing enterprise accounts, navigating complex multi-stakeholder buying cycles, and closing multi-year deals.
* Demonstrated success in new business development, with the ability to identify opportunities, win new logos, and successfully compete against established players
* Proven track record in account management, with the ability to grow existing customer relationships and expand their investment over time
* Exceptional communication and negotiation skillsthat enable confident engagement with stakeholders at all levels, helping to navigate complex sales cycles and drive meaningful outcomes
* University degreein Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or a related technical field
* Fluent in English, spoken and written
* Willingness to travel across the region as needed


**Nice to have**
* Familiarity with the broader PLM ecosystem and how simulation integrates into product development workflows
* Familiarity with EDA products and electronics and semiconductors


**Why Us?**
 At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
   

  

**Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion**
 We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.
   

  

**Compensation & Benefits**
 The primary locations for this opportunity are
 **Sweden, Denmark and Finland** 
 . The applicable salary ranges for these locations are:
   

  

 Min 947.800 - Max 1.800.900 SEK (Sweden)
   

  

 Min 812.000 - Max 1.623.900 CZK (Denmark)
   

  

 Min 86.500 - Max 173.000 EUR (Finland)
   

  

 This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation. The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate's job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. Siemens offers health and wellness benefits to employees; you can access the benefits available in your country via the link: https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/
   

  

 This position may also be posted in additional locations beyond those specified above. For such locations, the applicable salary ranges and benefits will be disclosed by the Talent Acquisition Partner at the time of initial contact, in accordance with local legal requirements.
   

  

**Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday**

title: Program Manager - Principal
description:
**This is Worldline**
 Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are looking for a Program Manager in the Payments Merchant Risk domain, responsible for managing and reducing due diligence backlogs related to merchant onboarding and monitoring. You'll be at the heart of merchant risk and payments operations, taking ownership of ODD backlog management while driving operational transformation. The position offers high-impact visibility with measurable results, strategic ownership of backlog improvement initiatives, and exposure to complex EU regulatory environments with opportunities to drive automation and process innovation.
   

  

**Day-to-Day Responsibilities**
* Backlog Management: Own and prioritize ODD backlog of merchant periodic reviews, monitor KPIs, and implement reduction strategies
* Project Management: Lead backlog reduction initiatives, define project scope and timelines, coordinate cross-functional teams
* Merchant Risk & Due Diligence: Ensure proper ODD execution, oversee AML/CTF and Name Screening compliance assessments
* Process Improvement: Identify inefficiencies, drive continuous improvement using Lean/Six Sigma methodologies
* Stakeholder Management: Act as main contact for internal teams, provide senior management updates, align departmental priorities
* Data & Reporting: Track key metrics, build dashboards, use data insights for process optimization
* Program Steering Committee: Ensure timely and accurate updates to entity Steering Committee in clear and understandable format, and secure timely escalation of issues requiring steering committee decision making
* Regulatory Compliance: Ensure adherence to AML and card scheme rules, support audits, maintain documentation


**Who Are We Looking For**
 We look for big thinkers. People who can drive positive change, step up and show what’s next – people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. In practice this means:
   

  

* Minimum of 3 years of experience in payments, risk, compliance, or operations with experience managing operational backlogs or transformation projects
* Background in merchant onboarding or due diligence is highly valued
* Knowledge of merchant risk, AML/KYC, and fraud prevention
* Proficiency with project tools (Jira, Asana), data analysis capabilities (Excel, SQL, BI dashboards), familiarity with payment platforms and risk systems.


**Shape the evolution**
 We are pushing towards the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for big thinkers to join our journey. People with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Here you’ll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on the society. And with our empowering culture, strong technology and extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career. Wherever you decide to go. Join our global team of over 18,000 innovators across 40+ countries, and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own.
   

  

 Learn more about life at Worldline at jobs.worldline.com
   

  

 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as an individual with a disability, or any applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Teamledare till arkivfunktionen på utbildningsförvaltningen
description:
**Välkommen till oss** 




  





**Vill du leda och utveckla ett kvalificerat arkivarieteam i Sveriges största utbildningsverksamhet? Vi söker nu en engagerad och utvecklingsinriktad teamledare till arkivfunktionen på Enheten för arkiv, registratur och förvaltningsservice (ARF-enheten).** 




  





 ARF-enheten är en del av avdelningen för personal och kompetensförsörjning och spelar en viktig roll i att stödja förvaltningen och skolorna i frågor som rör informationshantering, arkiv och offentlighet. Vi arbetar för en modern, rättssäker och effektiv informationshantering och en god offentlighetsstruktur. Här arbetar cirka 20 medarbetare bestående av arkivarier, registratorer, jurist, administratör/kommunikatör, en samordnare för registraturet, arkivassistent och vaktmästare. Verksamheten leds av en enhetschef.
 



  





**Vi erbjuder dig** 




  





 Här får du en central roll i att stärka och framtidssäkra informationshanteringen i en verksamhet som gör skillnad för tusentals elever varje dag. Du blir en del av ett team med kompetenta kollegor och en härlig stämning. Som medarbetare i Stockholms stad erbjuds du tillsvidareanställning från start, vilket ger dig en trygg grund och goda möjligheter att utvecklas hos oss. Arbetsplatsen präglas av kompetens, samarbete och ett öppet klimat där du kan lära nytt och växa i din yrkesroll. Vi sitter centralt i lokaler på Hantverkargatan på Kungsholmen. Mer om Stockholms stad förmåner hitta du här.
 



  





**Din roll** 




  





 Som teamledare för arkivfunktionen har du en nyckelroll i att skapa struktur, framdrift och kvalitet i arkivfunktionens arbete. Rollen är både operativ och strategisk där du ansvarar för att leda, samordna och följa upp verksamheten samtidigt som du driver förbättringar och utveckling i takt med digitaliseringen.
 



  





 Du leder ett team bestående av fem arkivarier och en arkivassistent. Tillsammans med teamledare för registraturet, jurist och kommunikationsresurs utgör du en viktig del i utvecklingen av utbildningsförvaltningens informationshantering.
 



  





 I din roll ansvarar du för att:
 


* leda, planera och samordna det dagliga arbetet inom arkivfunktionen.
* initiera, genomföra och följa upp verksamhetsplanering och verksamhetsuppföljning.
* driva utveckling av arbetssätt och processer inom arkiv- och informationshantering.
* säkerställa arkivkrav i samband med införande, förvaltning och avveckling av it‑tjänster.
* arbeta med informationsvärdering, gallring och styrande dokument samt förvalta och utveckla hanteringsanvisningar.
* ge service, råd och stöd till centrala förvaltningen, skolorna genom platsbesök samt andra myndigheter och allmänheten.
* bidra till utbildningen i informationshantering till olika målgrupper; medverka i planeringen på kort och lång sikt om vilka utbildningar som behövs och vid behov genomföra utbildningar och delta i informationsträffar.
* lämnar ut allmänna handlingar och gör sekretessbedömningar.
* omvärldsbevaka och omsätter förändringar i praktiken.



  





**Din kompetens och erfarenhet** 




  





 Du som söker har:
 


* kandidatexamen med minst 60 poäng arkivvetenskap.
* flerårig erfarenhet av strategiskt och operativt arbete som arkivarie inom offentlig verksamhet.
* erfarenhet av digital informationshantering, digitalisering och verksamhetsutveckling.
* god förmåga att uttrycka dig välformulerat och tydligt i tal och skrift på svenska
* erfarenhet av att hålla i utbildningar inom arkivområdet.



  





 Det är meriterande för tjänsten är om du har:
 


* erfarenhet av ledande roll inom området informationshantering, som exempelvis teamledare, projektledare, samordnare eller liknande.
* erfarenhet av att ställa arkivkrav i samband med it‑utveckling.
* erfarenhet av att ha genomfört utredningar av bevarande och gallring.
* erfarenhet av att arbeta med bevarande och gallring av digital information.



  





 För att lyckas i rollen som teamledare för arkivfunktionen har du viljan och förmågan att coacha andra och främjar ett gott samarbete, internt såväl som externt. Du har en pedagogisk framtoning och ett strukturerat arbetssätt samt en förmåga att självständigt initiera och driva förbättringsarbete. Du är kommunikativ, nytänkande, proaktiv och drivande i utvecklingsarbete.
 



  





 Du är flexibel och har förmåga att styra om arbetsuppgifter utifrån ändrade prioriteringar eller förändrade förutsättningar. Du trivs med att jobba i team och stötta kollegor.
 



  





 I denna rekrytering kommer vi lägga stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper, motivation och engagemang för uppdraget.
 



  





**Övrigt** 




  





 Vid bedömningen av din ansökan kommer vi endast att utgå ifrån ditt CV och ett antal frågor du får besvara i samband med att du söker tjänsten. Vi önskar att du svarar konkret och kortfattat på frågorna och att det finns en tydlig koppling mellan dina svar och ditt CV.
 



  





 Arbetspsykologiska tester kommer att ingå i den senare delen av rekryteringsprocessen.

title: Account Executive - Sweden - Nordics
description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.
 



 What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.
 



 Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.
 



 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
 
 our wins – big and small.
 



 Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!
 



 Anaplan is seeking an
 **ENTERPRISE ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE** 
 in Sweden, to drive its growth and expand its presence in the Nordics area.
 



 In this role, you will take your proven track record of selling sophisticated technology solutions and account management and sell an incredibly versatile platform. Our sales team is helping industry leaders understand the impact of Anaplan products and how our connected planning solution is ending siloed decision-making. You will help our customers achieve their immediate business goals while setting their business up for the future.
 



 This role will be a catalyst to Anaplan’s continued growth while leading digital transformation. Reporting directly to the RVP of Sales. You will have mostly greenfield accounts. This type of territory requires someone to further build our footprint by hunting and locking in new logo accounts as well as rapidly growing opportunities within the current customer base.
 



**Your Impact** 



* Engaging with targeted prospects to identify broken business processes and position Anaplan’s unique ability to solve the problem,
* Build Anaplan’s business value throughout the selling engagement. Navigating sophisticated prospect environments to align the prospect around the Anaplan solution,
* Conduct highly effective presentations from Director through SVP and key C-suite level decision makers including CFOs, CROs, and senior leaders in supply chain, workforce, and other business functions,
* Develop customers and own opportunity management start-to-finish across multiple customer targets and functions,
* Apply Anaplan’s value-based selling methodology and tools to run sales processes and accurately forecast business,
* Employ outstanding account leadership skills to identify account expansion opportunities by cross-selling and up-selling opportunities within targeted accounts,
* Perform strategic sales planning, leading to accurate forecasting of the business,
* Work with cross-functional members of Sales Development Reps, Marketing, Solution Consultants, and the Customer Success teams.



**Your Qualifications** 



* Extensive experience in consultative sales to Fortune 2000 companies, ideally in SaaS solutions Enterprise Software
* 'Hunter' with a strong growth mindset, motivated by developing new business essential
* Experience in Industrial verticals, Retail, Energy, Manufacturing and Business preferred
* Shown success selling into Vice President / Senior Vice President buyers,
* Track record of overachieving sales quota & targets, including demonstrated history of multiple high six-figure annual contract value (ACV) deals (services and/or software),
* Demonstrated network in your industry territory, with a mix of some customers and implementation partners,
* Demonstrated experience with sophisticated partner & internal team organisations,
* Domain understanding (Supply Chain, FP&A, Workforce Planning & Sales) and knowledge of how these functions plan, process work and make decisions,
* Strong, demonstrated opportunity management practices (e.g. sales process, qualification, executive presentation skills, quote presentation and negotiation), and ability to balance multiple (3-5) opportunities at once,
* Business, Finance, Economics, related BS/BA degree or relevant years of experience.
* Fluency in Swedish and English



**Preferred Skills** 



* Experience with Outreach, SFDC, LinkedIn Sales Navigator a plus,
* Account Planning experience Altify, MEDDPICC, Miller Heiman.
* Based In sweden, understands Enterprise Sales SAAS market



**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)** 




 We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!
 



 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  
 



**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer** 
  
 



 It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.
 



 Anaplan does not:  
 


* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.



 All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

 andidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled
 

 in accordance with
 

 our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to
 

 assist
 

 our team in evaluating qualifications.
