title: Critical Environment CMMS Technician
description:
Overview
  
As a Critical Environment CMMS Technician, you will support the operational integrity of Microsoft’s datacenters by managing maintenance systems, coordinating vendors, supporting procurement activities, and ensuring compliance with maintenance and operational standards.
  
You will serve as the primary owner of the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS), ensuring preventive and corrective maintenance activities are accurately scheduled, tracked, documented, and completed. Working closely with technicians, operations teams, and external vendors, you will help maintain accurate asset data, work orders, purchase orders, maintenance plans, and compliance records.
  
Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) team powers the infrastructure behind services such as Azure, Microsoft 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and Bing. Our global portfolio spans more than 400 datacenters across 32 countries, supporting billions of customers and millions of businesses worldwide.
  
At Microsoft, we embrace a growth mindset, value collaboration, and are committed to empowering every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more.
  
Responsibilities
  
Build, manage, and maintain Planned Preventive Maintenance (PPM) schedules within the CMMS, ensuring alignment with Critical Environment standards.
  
Serve as the primary point of contact for CMMS-related support, guidance, and issue resolution.
  
Provide training and support to operational teams on CMMS processes, standards, and best practices.
  
Ensure consistent CMMS utilization and data management practices across the campus.
  
Monitor system performance, data quality, compliance, and maintenance record accuracy.
  
Generate and communicate CMMS performance metrics and KPIs to Datacenter management.
  
Identify compliance risks, process gaps, and opportunities for operational improvement.
  
Analyse maintenance and asset data to identify trends, risks, and optimisation opportunities.
  
Develop and maintain maintenance plans and task schedules within the CMMS.
  
Manage asset, equipment, location, and inventory records to ensure system accuracy.
  
Coordinate procurement activities, including reviewing quotations, creating purchase orders, tracking deliveries, recording receipts, and processing invoices.
  
Monitor compliance and operational performance through Power BI dashboards and reporting tools.
  
Ensure processes, documentation, and systems remain aligned with current operational standards and requirements.
  
Provide administrative support to technicians, including ticket creation, tracking, and system updates.
  
Support vendor onboarding activities, ensuring all required documentation and registrations are completed.
  
Coordinate and schedule third-party preventive maintenance activities and vendor service visits.
  
Maintain a strong focus on safety, security, compliance, and quality while carrying out all responsibilities.
  
Embody Microsoft’s culture and values in all aspects of work.
  
  

Required Qualifications
  
Experience using a Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) or similar work order management platform.
  
Understanding of maintenance workflows and work order lifecycle management.
  
Strong organisational, coordination, and communication skills with high attention to detail.
  
Demonstrated commitment to safety, compliance, quality, and accountability.
  
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, mission-critical environment.
  
Proactive and collaborative approach with strong stakeholder management skills.
  
Experience working with operational processes, documentation, data management, and Microsoft 365 tools.
  
Continuous improvement mindset with strong problem-solving capabilities.
  
  

Preferred Qualifications
  
Experience working in Datacenter Operations, Critical Environments, or other mission-critical facilities.
  
Experience coordinating vendors, contractors, and maintenance service providers.
  
Experience supporting asset management, inventory management, procurement, or facilities operations.
  
High School Diploma, Technical Trade Certification (Electrical, HVAC, Mechanical, Marine Engineering, or similar), or equivalent practical experience.
  
Experience in high-availability or critical infrastructure environments such as datacenters, hospitals, manufacturing, pharmaceutical facilities, utilities, oil and gas, or related industries.
  
  

Background Check Requirements
  
Ability to meet Microsoft, customer, and/or government security screening requirements is required for this role.
  
This position requires successful completion of the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire or transfer and every two years thereafter.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
In a world where products and software can be replicated overnight, intellectual property is one of the last durable moats. Stilta builds agentic AI for intellectual property, giving legal and IP teams software that can reason across massive document sets, surface evidence, and produce litigation-grade work faster and more reliably.


We recently raised a $10.5M seed round led by Andreessen Horowitz, with participation from Y Combinator and operators from companies including OpenAI, Legora, and Lovable. We already work with major IP firms and Fortune 500 companies, and we’re at the very beginning of defining what great AI-native software for intellectual property looks like.

**The role**
------------


You'll own the platform every Stilta agent runs on. Our customers hand us long-running, document-heavy work - agents reasoning for hours across millions of pages - and the infrastructure underneath must be fast, secure and invisible to the people relying on it.


You'll shape how we scale from hundreds to thousands of concurrent agent sessions, set the bar for reliability and security, and make the architectural calls the rest of engineering builds on for years to come.

  

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Design and run the Kubernetes platform behind large-scale agent swarms - scheduling, autoscaling and isolation across customers
* Build the systems that keep agent sessions fast and resilient under heavy, unpredictable load
* Own our infrastructure as code and the path to production on Azure, with enterprise-grade security, compliance and data residency built in rather than bolted on
* Make storage and data pipelines durable and performant for workloads spanning millions of documents
* Build observability that tells us why something is failing, not just that it is

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* You've designed and scaled distributed systems in production, and you have well-earned opinions on what makes them reliable. You take ownership end to end and want to set the standard for the team that follows
* Deep expertise in Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure and infrastructure as code. We run on Azure with Terraform; equivalent depth elsewhere counts
* You're a software engineer first - strong in TypeScript and/or Python, and comfortable building the services that run the platform, not just configuring them
* You treat reliability, performance and cost as product decisions, and you instrument before you guess
* Bonus: experience running AI or inference-heavy workloads at scale, or with enterprise security and compliance

 *Stilta are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, or background. Selection for this role will be based solely on suitability for the position and does not discriminate on any protected characteristic.*

title: Engagerad kommunikatör till Farsta Stadsdelsförvaltning
description:
Stockholm – vår huvudstad med miljoner drömmar, förväntningar och ambitioner. Vi jobbar för alla som lever här idag och i framtiden. Nu söker vi dig som vill tänka stort, nytt och annorlunda med oss – för stockholmarna.


Vår del av staden ligger mellan sjöarna Drevviken och Magelungen. Här arbetar Farsta stadsdelsförvaltning, 1400 engagerade medarbetare som nu behöver en ny kollega. Hos oss får du nära till både tunnelbana och pendeltåg, butiker och restauranger. Och nära till ett bad på sommaren och långfärdskridskor på vintern.  



**Stockholms Stad, Farsta SDF, Stabsenheten**


Stockholm – vår huvudstad med miljoner drömmar, förväntningar och ambitioner. Vi jobbar för alla som lever här idag och i framtiden. Nu söker vi dig som vill tänka stort, nytt och annorlunda med oss – för stockholmarna.


Vår del av staden ligger mellan sjöarna Drevviken och Magelungen. Här arbetar Farsta stadsdelsförvaltning, 1400 engagerade medarbetare som nu behöver en ny kollega. Hos oss får du nära till både tunnelbana och pendeltåg, butiker och restauranger. Och nära till ett bad på sommaren och långfärdskridskor på vintern.


Är du en kommunikatör som tycker om ett varierande arbete, är självgående och vill arbeta för ett Stockholm för alla? Då kan du vara rätt person för oss på Farsta stadsdelsförvaltning, då vi söker en kommunikatör till stabsenheten.

**Din arbetsplats**


Som kommunikatör hos oss kommer du ingå i stabsenheten. Stabsenheten ansvarar för förvaltningens övergripande planering och styrning samt att stötta förvaltningens verksamheter i deras uppdrag. I stabens uppdrag ingår att leda och samordna horisontell samverkan inom flera områden samt att bidra i styrningen utifrån stadsgemensamma styrdokument. På enheten blir du en del av ett kompetent och tvärfunktionellt team med kollegor inom nämndkansli, arkiv, IT, digitalisering, informationssäkerhet, säkerhet, trygghet och prevention, ILS-samordning samt internservice. Du rapporterar till stabschef.

**Din roll som kommunikatör**


Som kommunikatör hos oss bidrar du till att göra information tydlig, tillgänglig och användbar för olika målgrupper. Uppdraget utgår från stadens kommunikationsprogram. Du kommer arbeta förvaltningsövergripande och ge kommunikationsstöd både i utvecklingsarbete och löpande uppdrag. Uppdragen varierar och du behöver vara beredd att kliva in där det behövs.


I din roll som kommunikatör erbjuds du ett omväxlande uppdrag där du arbetar taktiskt och operativt för att stötta verksamheterna. Du arbetar med kommunikation i våra interna och externa kanaler, bland annat på intranätet och sociala medier. I samarbete med verksamheterna säkerställer du att innehållet är relevant kvalitetssäkrat, tillgängligt och anpassat efter målgruppernas behov. Uppdraget innefattar bland annat att:

* planera, genomföra och följa upp kommunikationsinsatser
* utveckla det operativa kommunikationsarbetet
* huvudredaktör för förvaltningens webb och intranät
* säkerställa att information når berörda parter och målgrupper
* genomföra utbildningsinsatser
* skapa innehåll till intranät, sociala medier mm
* ta fram kommunikations- och aktivitetsplaner
* skapa kommunikationsmaterial

**Din kompetens och erfarenhet**


Till den här tjänsten söker vi dig som har

* högskoleexamen inom medie- och kommunikationsvetenskap, annan utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer som likvärdig eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet
* aktuell och flerårig erfarenhet av operativt och taktiskt kommunikationsarbete
* goda kunskaper om olika sociala medier
* goda kunskaper i det svenska språket samt intresse och mycket god förmåga att anpassa och skapa text och innehåll för olika behov, kanaler och målgrupper.
* goda kunskaper i Office och Adobe Creative Cloud-program som InDesign och Photoshop.
* erfarenhet av att vara beställare av kommunikationstjänster

**Det är meriterande om du har**

* erfarenhet av arbete i en politiskt styrd organisation, gärna i en kommun


För att lyckas i rollen behöver du vara bra på att skapa förtroendefulla samarbeten och trivas med att arbeta nära olika delar av verksamheten. Du har god förståelse för den offentliga sektorns särart.


Du ansvarar för dina uppdrag, driver arbetet framåt och kan växla mellan ett taktiskt helhetsperspektiv och operativt genomförande. Eftersom uppdragen varierar behöver du också vara flexibel och trivas i en miljö där nya behov kan uppstå. Vi ser även att du är pedagogisk och inlyssnande i din kommunikation och har lätt för att samarbeta i en struktur där dina kollegor har olika roller. Du har ett prestigelöst och flexibelt förhållningssätt och tycker om ett varierande arbete.

**Vad erbjuder vi?**


Hos oss kliver du in i ett meningsfullt arbete där du verkligen gör skillnad- på en arbetsplats där det är lätt att trivas. Du blir en del av en arbetsplats som präglas av hög och bred kompetens, god arbetsmiljö och ständig utveckling med stockholmarna i fokus. Vi värdesätter samarbete, engagemang och en god stämning på jobbet. Hos oss får du förmånen att arbeta tillsammans med en mängd olika samhällsnära verksamheter som är viktiga för stadsdelens invånare. Du får även goda möjligheter till stöd och samverkan med ett större nätverk av kompetenta kollegor inom Stockholms stad.


Utöver detta erbjuder vi dig goda anställningsförmåner som kompetensutveckling, friskvårdsbidrag, bra flextidsvillkor, vinter- samt sommararbetstid och semesterväxling.  

Läs mer om våra förmåner och Stockholms stad som arbetsgivare.

**Övrigt**


Vi kommer att intervjua löpande. Ett arbetsprov kan tillkomma i slutet av processen.


Stockholms stad arbetar med kompetensbaserad rekrytering som syftar till att se till varje persons kompetens och därmed motverka diskriminering.  

  

Tänk på att aldrig ladda upp registerutdrag från Polisen (Dataskyddsförordningen, GDPR) i samband med din ansökan.  

Från och med 1 september 2026 ska du inte längre bifoga ett personligt brev när du söker jobb hos oss.  

  



För att få arbeta hos Stockholms stad med barn, ungdomar, äldre och personer med funktionsnedsättning inkl. arbete i deras hem, behöver du uppvisa ett utdrag ur belastningsregistret i slutet av rekryteringsprocessen. Vid ledande eller kritisk befattning kan även utdrag ur belastningsregistret bli aktuellt. Utdraget ska inte vara äldre än sex månader från utfärdandedatum.

title: PostDoc in Scientific Imaging Data Reduction and Compression
description:
Lund University was founded in 1666 and is repeatedly ranked among the world’s top universities. The University has around 46 000 students and 8 500 staff based in Lund, Helsingborg and Malmö. We are united in our efforts to understand, explain and improve our world and the human condition. Lund University welcomes applicants with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We regard equality, equal opportunities and diversity as a strength and an asset.

### **The Scientific Data Group**


You will join the Scientific Data Group within the Technical Division of MAX IV Laboratory. We develop and operate high-performance data acquisition systems for cutting-edge detectors and provide data processing, visualisation and analysis solutions that enable researchers to rapidly interpret results from X-ray scattering, imaging and spectroscopy experiments. Our systems routinely handle data rates of several GB/s and support large-scale scientific data workflows. To support sustainable data management at next-generation photon science facilities, we are seeking a Postdoctoral Researcher to advance scientific data reduction and compression workflows for tomography and imaging applications in collaboration with European research infrastructures.

### **The Position**


The rapid growth of data volumes generated by modern imaging experiments is creating significant challenges for data storage, transfer, processing and long-term preservation. Through a collaborative European initiative involving leading photon science facilities, MAX IV is developing sustainable approaches to scientific data reduction and scientifically validated lossy-compression methods for tomography and imaging applications.


As a PostDoc you will contribute to the evaluation, development, validation and deployment of advanced data reduction and compression methodologies for large-scale imaging datasets. Working at the interface between scientific computing, image analysis and research infrastructures, you will collaborate closely with scientists, software engineers, beamline scientists and computing specialists across the European photon science community.


The project is carried out in close collaboration with leading European photon science facilities through the LEAPS community. The position offers a unique opportunity to engage directly with MAX IV's full-field X-ray imaging and tomography activities. These span the established tomography capabilities at DanMAX and ForMAX, together with the development of TomoWISE, a dedicated next-generation tomography beamline currently under construction. The successful candidate will work closely with scientists and engineers developing future imaging capabilities at MAX IV while collaborating with experts in tomography, scientific computing, data management and research software engineering across Europe.


Your work will contribute to practical solutions that significantly reduce data volumes while preserving scientific quality and reproducibility. The project combines scientific research, software development and international collaboration, offering opportunities to influence community-wide best practices for data handling at large-scale research facilities. Activities include benchmarking and validating compression algorithms, developing software tools and workflows, establishing quality metrics and best practices, collaborating with partner facilities, organising workshops and training activities, and disseminating results through publications and presentations.

#### **Your primary responsibilities will include**

* Evaluate and benchmark data reduction and lossy-compression methods using representative tomography and imaging datasets from MAX IV and collaborating facilities.
* Develop software tools, workflows and validation methodologies that support the adoption of compression technologies in scientific environments.
* Collaborate with beamline scientists to evaluate the impact of data reduction methods on scientific outcomes and data quality.
* Contribute to community guidelines, best practices and knowledge resources related to scientific data reduction, compression and FAIR data management.
* Work with researchers and technical experts at European photon science facilities to facilitate knowledge exchange and technology transfer.
* Support and coordinate project workshops, training activities and dissemination events.
* Disseminate project outcomes through reports, technical documentation, presentations, workshops, and scientific publications, as appropriate.

### **To be successful in this role you need to have the following qualifications**

* A PhD in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Scientific Computing, Image Processing, Data Science, or a closely related discipline.
* Demonstrated experience in scientific programming, scientific software development, or data-intensive computing.
* Experience with Python and at least one high-performance programming language such as C++, Rust, or Julia.
* Experience working with large-scale scientific datasets, image processing, computational imaging, tomography data analysis, or data compression.
* Experience with Linux-based computing environments and modern software development practices, including version control and collaborative software development.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to work effectively in an interdisciplinary and international research environment

### **The following qualifications are considered an advantage**

* Experience with synchrotron, neutron, electron microscopy, medical imaging, or other large-scale imaging facilities.
* Experience with scientific data formats and technologies such as HDF5, NeXus and Zarr.
* Knowledge of FAIR data principles and research data management.
* Experience with high-performance computing, cloud computing, GPU acceleration, or distributed data processing.
* Experience participating in international scientific collaborations and/or multi-institutional  

research projects.

### **Eligibility**


Appointment to the position of postdoc requires that the applicant has a PhD or an international degree deemed equivalent to a PhD, within the subject of the position, completed no more than three years before the application deadline. Under special circumstances the PhD can have been completed previous to the aforementioned three years.

### **Further information**


This is a full-time, fixed-term employment for two years. A postdoctoral fellow is employed under a period of at least two years and at most three years. The period of employment is determined in accordance with the agreement “Avtal om tidsbegränsad anställning som postdoktor-2022-02-01” (“Agreement on fixed-term employment as a post-doctoral fellow, 2022-02-01”).

### **What we offer**


When you join our MAX IV team, you enter a world of cutting-edge science. We make the invisible visible by supporting scientists from all over the world, generating scientific results for the benefit of society. We offer you a multicultural work environment with great opportunities for personal development with respect for a healthy work-life balance.

*Would you like to work in a challenging and supporting environment? Then join us and take the opportunity to make a real difference!*

### **For further information, please visit:**


https://www.lunduniversity.lu.se/about-lund-university/work-lund-university


www.sweden.se


https://www.maxiv.lu.se/about-us/careers/compensation-benefits/

  

MAX IV is a Swedish national large-scale research infrastructure hosted by Lund University. It provides scientists from Sweden and abroad, with intense x-rays and state-of-the-art instrumentation for research in areas such as engineering, physics, structural biology, chemistry and nanotechnology. Its 16 beamlines receive up to 2 000 scientists annually, conducting ground-breaking experiments in materials and life sciences using the brilliant X-rays.


The ICT teams at MAX IV are placed under the Technical Division and deliver solutions to the whole MAX IV organisation in the areas of electronics, software, infrastructure and scientific data. This is a dynamic and highly challenging environment and requires close collaboration with the beamline staff in order to understand the needs and be effective in forming solutions. We are around 50 people in total who work in 4 domains in a well-organised and agile way. We hold values of lean management, knowledge spread, user autonomy, continuous improvement and flexibility as guiding principles for our work.


We kindly decline all sales and marketing contacts.

title: Platform Engineer, Cloud Tools
description:
We are looking for a **Senior Platform Engineer** to join team Cloud Tools. This is a role for someone who enjoys building and maintaining shared services, talking to users and taking responsibility for quality in production.


Cloud Tools is part of the Enablers department and provides tools and services for CI/CD, source control and artifact management for internal developers. The team’s mission is to make everyday development easier across WirelessCar.


You will join a team where people speak their minds, challenge each other and support one another when things get difficult. Different perspectives are welcomed, and the team works closely together to find solutions and move things forward.

#### **About WirelessCar**


WirelessCar empowers the future of mobility by connecting vehicles and delivering cutting-edge digital services. Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Sweden, we have a strong global presence with offices in the U.S., China, Germany, India, and Japan, offering a truly global workplace with exciting opportunities for career growth.


Owned by Volkswagen Group, today we connect over 17 million vehicles across 100+ countries and partner with leading OEMs, including Volvo, Jaguar Land Rover, Volkswagen Group, Nissan, and Subaru.

#### **About the Role**


You will be a part of a team that develops and operates a mature and stable CI/CD solution. We are moving towards a new phase, and **much of the focus** will be on delivering source code management where configuration and governance can scale with shifting needs. The roadmap also includes extending the current artifact management to allow for new forms of collaboration.


AWS is central to the technical environment, and the team mainly develops in Go and Python. The team also maintains frontend tooling built with Angular.


Most of Cloud Tools’ users are Java developers, so **Java ecosystem** experience can help you understand the users’ needs and technical challenges.


The services come with 24/7 production responsibility. Support calls are very rare, but being ready to respond remains part of the role.

#### **Your Impact**


As part of Cloud Tools, you will:

* Operate and improve proven and mature CI/CD tooling
* Keep shared services reliable, secure and efficient
* Manage technical lifecycle and reduce unnecessary complexity
* Develop and maintain solutions using a variety of languages and technologies
* Work with GitHub and artifact management
* Talk to users and turn their needs into practical improvements
* Take responsibility for quality, reliability and production
* Help the team make sound decisions during a period of change

#### **What We're Looking For**

##### **We are looking for experienced Platform Engineers who:**

* Enjoys working closely with users and colleagues across the company and communicates clearly and effectively.
* Is confident sharing their perspective, challenging ideas and staying calm when things go wrong.
* Has experience working with shared platforms, tools or services.
* Is curious and enjoys investigating unfamiliar problems and technologies.
* Is comfortable working with AWS.
* Has experience working with CI/CD platforms.
* Has solid programming experience and can work across different languages and codebases, such as Go or Python and similar languages used in backend or platform engineering.
* Has good knowledge of GitHub and understands artifact management.
* Cares about quality and takes ownership beyond individual tasks.
* Enjoys working closely with the team in Gothenburg on a regular basis.


For external candidates, experience from a company-wide enabling or internal platform context is particularly relevant.

**It Would Be a Plus if You Have**

* Experience with Angular
* Experience with the **Java ecosystem**
* Interested in or experience in using Kubernetes
* Experience with PostgreSQL

#### **Why WirelessCar?**


At WirelessCar, you’ll have the trust and freedom to take ownership, share ideas and make an impact. We value collaboration, curiosity and different perspectives, and believe people do their best work when they have room to grow.


Cloud Tools works closely with development teams across the company, giving you the opportunity to understand their challenges and see the effect of your work.

**When you join WirelessCar, you can expect:**

* **Freedom to make an impact** – Take ownership and help shape what we do.
* **Collaboration across borders** – Work with talented people and perspectives from around the world.
* **Room to grow** – Develop your skills, explore new areas and learn along the way.
* **Space for ideas** – Challenge the way we work and turn ideas into action.
* **A supportive environment** – We care about each other and create space to contribute, grow and do your best work.


At WirelessCar, we want you to **enjoy what you do, feel proud of what you contribute and have fun along the way.**

#### **What We Offer**

* **Health & wellbeing –** Wellness contribution and initiatives that support your health and wellbeing.
* **Work-life balance –** Generous holiday, additional time off through our working time reduction, and parental leave compensation.
* **Financial benefits –** Competitive pension and insurance benefits, bonus and profit-sharing opportunities.
* **Technology & mobility –** Flexible options for technology, as well as company car and bike leasing.
* **A great everyday experience –** Weekly breakfasts and opportunities to connect and spend time with colleagues.

#### **What to Expect**


We aim to make our recruitment process clear and transparent, giving you a clear understanding of what to expect at each stage.

**1. Initial screening**A first conversation with Talent Acquisition about your experience and motivation.

**2. Assessment & interview**Depending on the role, you may complete an assessment and meet with the Hiring Manager or relevant team members.

**3. Role-specific interviews**Further conversations to explore your skills and experience in more depth.

**4. Final steps**References and, where required, background checks before moving forward with an offer.

**5. Offer**If we both feel it’s the right match, we’ll discuss the final details and make you an offer.

*The exact process may vary depending on the role and location.*

#### **Ready to join the ride?**


Sound interesting? We’d love to hear from you!


If this sounds interesting, we would like to hear from you. You do not need to match every point, but you should be curious, ready to learn, take responsibility and contribute to the team.

* No cover letter needed – just a few questions to help us better understand your experience, skills and motivation.
* Please submit your application in English, our company language.
* A valid work permit is required.
* **Not quite the right role for you? No worries!**


Connect with us to join our talent community and stay in the loop about future opportunities at WirelessCar.


Follow us on LinkedIn to keep up with our latest news, people and opportunities.

title: Principal Engineer
description:
Come help us create engineering excellence to serve the readers of some of the strongest media brands in the Nordics. We reach millions of readers every day. This is an opportunity to work across all our teams and tech stacks in a high leverage role with plenty of autonomy.


Aller Media is on a journey to unify tech stacks across four countries into our newly built platform. This is the key to our success in digitizing our products, trying out new formats and modernizing the whole business. You will join us at a critical moment and play a big part in our success.

### **About the role**


As a Principal Engineer your job will be to lift all of product engineering. You will work with developer experience, tooling, engineering strategy, architecture and helping teams to solve thorny problems. Success is mostly achieved through others. You will be given a lot of trust and autonomy. This is an individual contributor role with plenty of leadership, but no personnel responsibility.

#### **Key responsibilities**

* Identify risks and friction points across the whole engineering organization. Work with reducing this friction and minimize the risks.
* Write code. Not focusing on the critical path but rather building things that help the whole engineering organization improve. This could be tools, observability or auxiliary applications that have a broad impact.
* Measure and improve developer experience
* Take part in forming and implementing a tech strategy
* Help teams solve problems both through advisory and hands on
* Act as a role model and mentor to other engineers as well as sponsor and promoter of technical initiatives
* Be a trusted advisor and go to collaborator to help with exploration, technical understanding and prototyping
* Solve ambiguous, high-risk, high-trust problems that the normal team structure is not built to for
### **What you bring**

* Have spent many years as a software engineer, building digital products.
* Previously held technical leadership roles like staff/principal engineer, architect, tech lead or similar.
* Used to navigate with high trust and high agency
* Very good communication skills. Even though we work with technology, most problems we encounter are interpersonal
* Understanding systems thinking. Being able to zoom out of technical problems to understand the bigger context and the impact of tradeoffs of a technical solution
* You like to contribute hands on. Writing code and working with cloud infrastructure. As we work with many different tech stacks, supported by AI, your favorite coding language matters less. * Have become fluent in using AI agents and understand how their introduction is changing the software development lifecycle.

We regularly come together for after work, lunches, workouts and other activities that help us build relationships and have fun together.

### **We’re excited to hear from you!**


Please note that this position is within Aller Media Nordic, by clicking apply for this position you will be redirected to the Aller Media Nordic career page. Please apply with your CV and let us know a bit more about why you’re interested in the position and Aller Media. Only applications submitted via the link will be taken into consideration. Du har personalansvar för medarbetare inom flera discipliner och skapar förutsättningar för att teamen ska kunna leverera med hög kvalitet. Du driver utvecklingen av arbetssätt och processer inom mjukvaruutveckling och säkerställer att teamen arbetar enligt etablerade tekniska riktlinjer. title: System Administrator | Infrastructure & Cloud
description:
Do you want to help keep the infrastructure behind Tre stable, secure, and ready for what’s next? As a System Administrator, you’ll play an important role in operating, developing, and securing the infrastructure services that keep our organization running, both in the cloud and on-premises. Here, you’ll combine deep technical expertise with problem-solving, automation, and security in an environment where technology truly makes a difference. About the role In this role, you’ll help ensure that our infrastructure is stable, secure, and available both in day-to-day operations and when the unexpected happens. You’ll work hands-on with incidents, maintenance, and configuration changes, making sure our services work seamlessly together. When an alert goes off or an incident occurs, you’ll be part of troubleshooting and resolving the issue, helping us get back on track quickly.
  
  

We’re always looking for smarter ways to work. That’s why automation, scripting, and AI are a natural part of the role. You’ll use tools and languages such as PowerShell, Bash, and Python to streamline management and configuration, automate repetitive tasks, and make troubleshooting faster and more effective.
  
  

Security is at the heart of the role. You’ll work with everything from access management, patching, and Windows Server hardening to protecting our Active Directory environment. This includes reviewing privileged accounts, managing delegated permissions, and identifying and preventing risks and attacks against our directory services.
  
  

Together with colleagues across IT, security, and the wider business, you’ll help build a robust and secure technical environment that enables Tre to keep moving forward. In short, this is a role where you can put your technical curiosity to work: building, improving, and securing the infrastructure behind a business that keeps Sweden connected.
  
  

You can look forward to…
  
  

Combine operational work with long-term development. You’ll handle ongoing requests through our ticketing system while also having the opportunity to drive and contribute to development initiatives.
  
  

Act as a technical point of contact for other teams across Tre, providing support and guidance on our infrastructure services and helping colleagues find the right solutions.
  
  

Help shape a new area and a new role, with the opportunity to influence how we work and establish the foundations for the future.
  
  

Be part of one of Sweden’s best workplaces – yes, we’ve been recognized as a Great Place to Work several years in a row!
  
  

Here’s how hiring manager Thomas describes his leadership style: “For me, it’s important to be a trusting and coaching leader who leads by clear example. I believe in a pragmatic leadership style where I give the team the space and trust to use their technical expertise, while providing clarity and the right conditions for them to succeed.”
  
  

Who are you? To succeed in this role, we’re looking for someone with several years of experience as a System Administrator or in a similar role, preferably combined with a relevant university or higher education degree.
  
  

You have solid knowledge of Microsoft AD, Azure, and Microsoft products and services, and you are fluent in English. Knowledge of Swedish is a plus. Experience with networking, Linux, and storage is also an advantage.
  
  

We’re looking for someone who combines strong technical expertise with a solution-oriented mindset and enjoys both maintaining and developing our IT infrastructure. You’re self-driven and take ownership, while also enjoying working as part of a team and supporting your colleagues. You’re not afraid to challenge existing ways of working, think differently, and find smarter solutions.
  
  

You’re detail-oriented and understand the importance of considering decisions and their potential consequences, particularly when changes may impact other parts of the organization. At the same time, you’re pragmatic and know when it’s time to turn ideas into action.
  
  

Welcome with your application! We are accepting applications through this advertisement and will hold interviews on an ongoing basis. A cover letter is not required, but we would like you to attach a CV and answer the questions we have asked below when you apply. We use tests to ensure objective assessments are connected with selection. The position may be filled before the application deadline. Background checks are carried out on the final candidate.
  
  

Vi drivs av att hela tiden försöka göra saker bättre, på nya och annorlunda sätt. Vi ser oss själva som en avgörande del av Sveriges samhällsstruktur, eftersom vi vet att pålitlig uppkoppling är en viktig grundsten i dagens digitala värld.
  
  

Tre föddes som utmanare och är en organisation i ständig rörelse. Vi strävar efter att vara i framkant i allt vi gör. Vi är övertygade om att det är människorna och kulturen på Tre som är avgörande för vår utveckling.
  
  

När du startar din resa på Tre finns det oändliga möjligheter att växa och utvecklas med oss.
  
  

WE THINK LIKE CHALLENGERS - I en föränderlig värld, är vi på Tre nyfikna och ständigt öppna för nya lösningar. På Tre anpassar vi vägen framåt allt eftersom vi provar och lär oss vad som funkar bäst.
  
  

WE WORK LIKE CHAMPIONS - På Tre gör vi alltid vårt bästa. Vi känner ägandeskap för vår uppgift, sätter tydliga mål och håller fokus på det som gör mest nytta för affären.
  
  

WE ACT LIKE BUDDIES - På Tre är vi schyssta kollegor. Vi samarbetar med varandra över team och funktioner, vi bollar idéer, ger och tar emot feedback.

title: Director of Partner Acquisition
description:
About Gridheart
  
Gridheart AB is a leading Nordic distributor of cloud infrastructure and cybersecurity solutions. We enable Managed Service Providers (MSPs) to grow their businesses by providing them with best-in-class technology platforms, vendor partnerships, and go-to-market support. Our operations span seven countries: Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland, Iceland, the United Kingdom, and Ireland.
  
Headquartered in Kista, Stockholm, we work closely with market-leading vendors including Acronis, and serve a growing network of MSP partners across Northern Europe.
  
About the Role
  
We are looking for a Director of Partner Acquisition to lead our efforts in identifying, recruiting, and onboarding new MSP partners across our markets. This is a senior commercial role with full ownership of the partner acquisition pipeline, from first contact through to signed agreement and early activation.
  
You will report directly to the CEO and play a central role in driving Gridheart's growth strategy. The position is based at our headquarters in Kista, Stockholm, and work will be carried out from the office with regular travel across the Nordic and UK markets.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
* Develop and execute a scalable partner acquisition strategy across the Nordics, UK, and Ireland
* Own the full pipeline from prospecting and outreach to contract signing and partner activation
* Identify and engage prospective MSP partners through direct outreach, networking, and industry events
* Build and maintain relationships with decision-makers at target companies (CEOs, CTOs, business development leads)
* Collaborate with marketing and technical teams to develop compelling value propositions and sales materials
* Represent Gridheart at industry conferences, trade shows, and partner events
* Report pipeline progress, conversion metrics, and market insights to the leadership team
* Work closely with the partner management team to ensure smooth handover and successful onboarding of new partners


Qualifications and Requirements
  
  

**Required:**  

* Minimum 5 years of experience in B2B sales, channel sales, or partner/business development within the IT or technology sector
* Proven track record of building and managing a partner or reseller pipeline
* Strong understanding of the MSP/cloud/cybersecurity market landscape
* Experience working across multiple countries or regions
* Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
* Fluent in English (written and spoken)
* University degree or equivalent professional experience
* Willingness to travel regularly across the Nordics and UK/Ireland


**Desirable:**  

* Experience from the Nordic IT channel or distribution market
* Existing network of MSP contacts in the Nordics and UK
* Proficiency in one or more Scandinavian languages
* Experience with vendor programmes from companies such as Acronis, Microsoft, or similar
* Familiarity with cloud marketplaces and subscription-based business models

title: Data Center Engineering Operations - 2027 Internship
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Want to be part of the team that keeps the world's largest cloud running? As a Data Center Engineering Operations Technician Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will get hands-on experience maintaining the critical electrical, mechanical, and safety systems inside Amazon's data centers — and your work will directly impact millions of customers worldwide.  

This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Engineering Operations Technician position, subject to available roles and business needs.  

  

Who Should Apply  

This internship is for students in the final year of a Bachelor's degree or vocational training programme in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, graduating in 2027/2028.  

  

About the Role  

As an intern, you will join the Infrastructure Operations team and work to ensure that the data center's mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems operate at 100% availability while maintaining first-class customer service to the teams and groups within the data centers.  

  

The Engineering Operations team is Amazon's front-line responders for hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. You will work with equipment that supports mission-critical servers and must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. This equipment includes, but is not limited to:  

* Stand-by diesel generators and switchgear
* Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPSs) and Power Distribution Units (PDUs)
* Air Handling Units (AHUs), chillers, and cooling towers
* Chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, and Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs)
* Building automation systems
* Fire and life safety equipment


You will also help drive innovation while reducing operational costs in the facilities — your fresh perspective matters.  

  

What You Will Do  

* Maintain mechanical and electrical equipment
* Assist with root cause analysis of equipment failures
* Troubleshoot facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
* Ensure all safety procedures are followed while performing work
* Take daily operational readings of all mechanical and electrical equipment
* Use internal Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) to manage building workflows and perform rack installations
* Coordinate body movements when using tools or equipment, and reach and stretch to position equipment and fixtures

  

Physical Requirements  

This role involves physical activity, including:  

* Walking job sites on uneven terrain, including extended site rounds that may involve long distances
* Using hands to manipulate small wires and objects
* Pushing or pulling heavy objects into position
* Working in a noisy environment


If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation during the application or hiring process, visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information.  

  

Internship Structure  

Internship start dates are in January or February 2027, depending on school terms. This is a paid, full-time internship lasting 20 consecutive weeks. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily.  

This role operates on a 12-hour rotating shift pattern (rotating three to four day work weeks), which may include both day and night shifts. Work support could include occasional travel to more than one site location (less than 25% of the time).  

  

Please note that full-time Engineering Operations Technician roles also operate on a rotating shift pattern, which may include days, nights, weekends, and public holidays. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work during the internship and upon transitioning to a full-time position.  

  

Diverse Experiences

As a Data Center Engineering Operations Technician Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will get hands-on experience maintaining the critical electrical, mechanical, and safety systems inside Amazon's data centers — and your work will directly impact millions of customers worldwide.  

This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Engineering Operations Technician position, subject to available roles and business needs.  

  

Who Should Apply  

This internship is for students in the final year of a Bachelor's degree or vocational training programme in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, graduating in 2027/2028.  

  

About the Role  

As an intern, you will join the Infrastructure Operations team and work to ensure that the data center's mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems operate at 100% availability while maintaining first-class customer service to the teams and groups within the data centers.  

  

The Engineering Operations team is Amazon's front-line responders for hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. You will work with equipment that supports mission-critical servers and must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. This equipment includes, but is not limited to:  

* Stand-by diesel generators and switchgear
* Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPSs) and Power Distribution Units (PDUs)
* Air Handling Units (AHUs), chillers, and cooling towers
* Chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, and Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs)
* Building automation systems
* Fire and life safety equipment


You will also help drive innovation while reducing operational costs in the facilities — your fresh perspective matters.

* Maintain mechanical and electrical equipment
* Assist with root cause analysis of equipment failures
* Troubleshoot facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
* Ensure all safety procedures are followed while performing work
* Take daily operational readings of all mechanical and electrical equipment
* Use internal Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) to manage building workflows and perform rack installations
* Coordinate body movements when using tools or equipment, and reach and stretch to position equipment and fixtures

This role involves physical activity, including:  

* Walking job sites on uneven terrain, including extended site rounds that may involve long distances
* Using hands to manipulate small wires and objects

description:
* Urval sker löpande

**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------

Do you want to help keep the infrastructure behind Tre stable, secure, and ready for what’s next? As a System Administrator, you’ll play an important role in operating, developing, and securing the infrastructure services that keep our organization running, both in the cloud and on-premises. Here, you’ll combine deep technical expertise with problem-solving, automation, and security in an environment where technology truly makes a difference.
  

  

**About the role**  

In this role, you’ll help ensure that our infrastructure is stable, secure, and available both in day-to-day operations and when the unexpected happens. You’ll work hands-on with incidents, maintenance, and configuration changes, making sure our services work seamlessly together. When an alert goes off or an incident occurs, you’ll be part of troubleshooting and resolving the issue, helping us get back on track quickly.


We’re always looking for smarter ways to work. That’s why automation, scripting, and AI are a natural part of the role. You’ll use tools and languages such as PowerShell, Bash, and Python to streamline management and configuration, automate repetitive tasks, and make troubleshooting faster and more effective.


Security is at the heart of the role. You’ll work with everything from access management, patching, and Windows Server hardening to protecting our Active Directory environment. This includes reviewing privileged accounts, managing delegated permissions, and identifying and preventing risks and attacks against our directory services.


Together with colleagues across IT, security, and the wider business, you’ll help build a robust and secure technical environment that enables Tre to keep moving forward. In short, this is a role where you can put your technical curiosity to work: building, improving, and securing the infrastructure behind a business that keeps Sweden connected.

  

**You can look forward to…**

* Combine operational work with long-term development. You’ll handle ongoing requests through our ticketing system while also having the opportunity to drive and contribute to development initiatives.
* Act as a technical point of contact for other teams across Tre, providing support and guidance on our infrastructure services and helping colleagues find the right solutions.
* Help shape a new area and a new role, with the opportunity to influence how we work and establish the foundations for the future.
* Be part of one of Sweden’s best workplaces – yes, we’ve been recognized as a Great Place to Work several years in a row!

**Here’s how hiring manager Thomas describes his leadership style:**  

“For me, it’s important to be a trusting and coaching leader who leads by clear example. I believe in a pragmatic leadership style where I give the team the space and trust to use their technical expertise, while providing clarity and the right conditions for them to succeed.”

Gruppchef

Jayasri Battola
Utvecklare
*"The great work culture and the technology made me choose Tre. Working alongside great people in mixed team setups, with both experienced and new talents, along with the latest and greatest tools and technologies like Cloud and Azure."*
**Kvalifikationer**
-------------------

**Who are you?**
  

To succeed in this role, we’re looking for someone with several years of experience as a System Administrator or in a similar role, preferably combined with a relevant university or higher education degree.


You have solid knowledge of Microsoft AD, Azure, and Microsoft products and services, and you are fluent in English. Knowledge of Swedish is a plus. Experience with networking, Linux, and storage is also an advantage.


We’re looking for someone who combines strong technical expertise with a solution-oriented mindset and enjoys both maintaining and developing our IT infrastructure. You’re self-driven and take ownership, while also enjoying working as part of a team and supporting your colleagues. You’re not afraid to challenge existing ways of working, think differently, and find smarter solutions.


You’re detail-oriented and understand the importance of considering decisions and their potential consequences, particularly when changes may impact other parts of the organization. At the same time, you’re pragmatic and know when it’s time to turn ideas into action.


**Welcome with your application!**  

  

We are accepting applications through this advertisement and will hold interviews on an ongoing basis. A cover letter is not required, but we would like you to attach a CV and answer the questions we have asked below when you apply. We use tests to ensure objective assessments are connected with selection. The position may be filled before the application deadline. Background checks are carried out on the final candidate.

Vi drivs av att hela tiden försöka göra saker bättre, på nya och annorlunda sätt. Vi ser oss själva som en avgörande del av Sveriges samhällsstruktur, eftersom vi vet att pålitlig uppkoppling är en viktig grundsten i dagens digitala värld.

title: Microsoft Sales Executive
description:
**Company Description**  

Devoteam is a Microsoft Partner in the Nordics, helping customers get more value from Microsoft Cloud.


We combine strong Microsoft capabilities with expertise across cloud, platform engineering, security, data and managed services.


We are now looking for a Microsoft Sales Executive who already knows the ecosystem and can help us grow the business across the Nordics.  



  

  

**Job Description**  

We are looking for someone who already knows how the Microsoft game works. You know the Microsoft field. You understand the partner model, CSP, co-sell and how opportunities are created together with Microsoft.

**This is a hunter role.**  

Your job is to open new accounts, create pipeline and close business. You will own a defined set of named accounts across the Nordics, with clear territory and account ownership.


You will work closely with Microsoft and with our own experts across Cloud, Platform Engineering, Security and Managed Services to build opportunities that go beyond licensing.

  

**What you will do**

* Build new business across a defined portfolio of Nordic accounts.
* Develop relationships with Microsoft sellers, specialists and partner teams.
* Create joint pipelines through account mapping, co-sell and direct customer engagement.
* Own the full sales cycle from first conversation to signed deal.
* Build and structure CSP opportunities where relevant.
* Turn Microsoft relationships into larger consulting, cloud, security and managed services engagements.
* Work closely with our technical teams to shape solutions around real customer needs.
* Build long-term relationships with customers and expand existing accounts.
* Keep a strong view of your territory, pipeline and next opportunities.

  

**Territory**


You will work with named accounts across clearly defined and protected territories in the Nordic region.  

**Our main focus is enterprise customers within:**

* Manufacturing
* Retail
* Financial Services


There will also be opportunities in other sectors where we see a strong fit.  



  

  

**Qualifications**  

We are not looking for someone who wants to learn Microsoft sales from scratch. We are looking for someone who has already done it.

**What matters to us**

* You know Microsoft in the Nordics
* You already have relationships in the Microsoft ecosystem and understand how to work with the field to create business.
* You have a proven track record of opening new accounts, creating opportunities and closing complex technology deals.
* You understand CSP and cloud commercial models
* You know how Microsoft cloud deals are structured and how to build commercial opportunities around them.
* You can sell beyond licensing
* You understand how to connect Microsoft technology with consulting, migration, platform engineering, security and managed services.
* You can work with technical people
* You do not need to be an engineer, but you can understand customer challenges and work with experts to turn them into a strong proposition.
* You can sell to senior stakeholders  

You are comfortable working with CIOs, CTOs, IT leaders and business decision-makers.
* You take ownership
* You know your accounts, your pipeline and what needs to happen next.
* You speak fluent English
* A Nordic language is a strong advantage.

  

**The profile we are looking for**  

  

**A simple way to describe it:** If we put you in a room with the Microsoft organisation in Sweden or the Nordics tomorrow, you should already know the people in the room.


And they should know you.  



  

  

**Additional Information** **What you get**

* Clear account ownership and protected territories.
* Direct access to strong Microsoft technical expertise.
* The ability to sell across several capabilities, not just one service.
* A Nordic role with room to build.
* Hybrid and flexible working.
* Access to training and certifications through Devoteam Academy.
* Opportunities across Devoteam’s international network.

 **If you know the Microsoft ecosystem, know how to create business with it and like building from scratch, we want to talk.**

title: Enterprise Architect
description:
**Join us as our new Enterprise Architect**


Are you an experienced Enterprise Architect with a passion for shaping modern, scalable and business-driven IT landscapes?


We are looking for a pragmatic and business-oriented Enterprise Architect to join Hultafors Group and play a key role in defining and driving our enterprise architecture across the Group.


As Enterprise Architect, you will work at the intersection of business and IT, creating structure, direction and architectural principles that enable Hultafors Group to continue its digital transformation. You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across the organization and help ensure that our technology landscape supports both current business needs and our long-term strategic ambitions.


You will be part of an international organization with strong ambitions and an ongoing journey towards a more modern, integrated and scalable digital landscape.

**The Opportunity**


In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining Hultafors Group's enterprise architecture and ensuring alignment between business strategy, processes, information and technology. You will take a holistic view of our IT landscape and help define target architectures, principles and roadmaps that guide future investments and transformation initiatives. Hultafors Group operates in a complex and decentralized environment with multiple business units, brands and technology platforms. You will therefore play an important role in simplifying and harmonizing the landscape while respecting the different needs of our businesses.


You will work closely with IT leadership, business stakeholders, solution architects, application specialists and external partners to translate strategic objectives into practical architectural direction.  

  

**Main Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain the overall enterprise architecture, principles and governance for Hultafors Group.
* Define target architectures and roadmaps aligned with business and IT strategy.
* Create transparency across the application and technology landscape and drive modernization, consolidation and simplification Own and continuously improve the enterprise security risk framework and security maturity assessments.
* Guide architectural decisions across major transformation initiatives and technology investments.
* Ensure alignment across business capabilities, applications, data, integrations and infrastructure.
* Provide architectural direction for core business platforms such as ERP, CRM, PIM and PLM.
* Drive architectural principles for integrations, APIs, cloud and modern technology platforms.
* Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, IT teams and external partners to translate business needs into sustainable and scalable solutions.

**About You**


We believe you are an experienced Enterprise Architect or Senior Solution Architect with a broad understanding of both business and technology.


You are comfortable working in complex environments with multiple systems, business units and stakeholders, and you have the ability to move between strategic discussions and practical architectural decisions.


You understand that enterprise architecture is not only about technology. You are curious about the business, able to understand processes and capabilities, and skilled at translating business needs into technology direction.


You are pragmatic and collaborative in your approach. Rather than creating architecture in isolation, you enjoy working closely with both business and IT to create solutions and principles that can actually be implemented.


We also believe you have experience within several of the following areas:

* Enterprise architecture and architecture governance
* Application and integration architecture
* ERP and other enterprise business systems
* Cloud platforms and modern infrastructure
* APIs, integrations and event-driven architecture
* Security architecture and security-by-design principles
* Data and information architecture
* Digital transformation and legacy modernization.
* Architecture frameworks such as TOGAF or similar
* Agile ways of working and frameworks such as SAFe
* Working in international or decentralized organizations


Experience from manufacturing, wholesale, retail or other organizations with complex supply chains and business system landscapes is considered an advantage.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
* A collaborative and inclusive work environment characterized by Trust, Collaboration and Drive.
* An international work environment.
* An opportunity to contribute to Hultafors Group reaching the vision: “improving how the world works”

**Location:** Gothenburg or Stockholm (Hybrid work possible)

**How to Apply**


If you are excited about shaping the future enterprise architecture of Hultafors Group and want to contribute to our continued digital transformation, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your application and CV as soon as possible. Applications will be reviewed continuously.

Arbeta när det passar dig och på den arbetsplats du trivs bäst. Arbetet varierar om du arbetar själv på hotellet eller med kollegor. Tjänsten passar dig som vill kombinera med studier eller annat arbete.
  
Vem är du? Är du en nattuggla som trivs bäst när alla andra sover? Arbetar du kanske redan på ett hotell som nattreceptionist men vill arbeta extra under din lediga vecka? Eller vill du jobba några extra pass dagtid?

Som person ser vi att du är flexibel, serviceminded och ordningsam. Du behöver kunna kommunicera obehindrat på engelska i tal och skrift. Varför ska du jobba på RA Hospitality? Att jobba hos oss är framförallt väldigt roligt! Vem vill inte ha hundratals härliga kollegor och möjlighet att jobba på massor av spännande arbetsplatser?
  
Erfarenhet - Hos oss får du snabbt erfarenheter som annars tar flera år att uppnå. Jobba på allt från en till 30 olika arbetsplatser, hos oss finns alla möjligheter! Lär känna nya branschkollegor och skaffa dig ett brett nätverk i branschen!
  
Flexibelt schema - Jobba eller vara ledig? Hos oss får du sms-förfrågningar och väljer själv hur mycket, när och vart du vill jobba. Vi erbjuder både heltid, deltid och extraanställningar!
  
Personalaktiviteter - Få vänner för livet! Vi hittar på massa kul tillsammans för att stärka gemenskapen och visa vår uppskattning.
